papers.title: The Industrialization of Research ; On AI-Driven Science and Its Consequences
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence is transforming scientific research - not merely as a more powerful instrument, but as an autonomous participant in the research cycle itself. This transition constitutes, in the most precise sense of the term, the industrialization of research: a shift from a craft model, in which knowledge, method, and judgment are embedded in the researcher, to a pipeline model, in which these steps are decomposed, automated, and supervised. The US Department of Energy's Genesis Mission is the most ambitious current instantiation of this shift, but the fundamental questions it raises extend far beyond any single program. This essay examines seven such questions: the erosion of the intergenerational transmission of scientific competence; the growing opacity of AI-generated theories; the collapse of peer evaluation under a flood of machine-generated output; the unproven capacity of AI for paradigm-shifting discovery; the capture of the scientific agenda by political and industrial actors; the compounding of systematic errors in closed-loop pipelines; and the structural bifurcation of the global research community into incommensurable tiers. These concerns do not constitute an argument against AI-driven science - whose demonstrated potential is real and significant. They constitute the conditions under which that potential can be responsibly pursued.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以随笔形式探讨人工智能如何将科学研究从‘手工艺模式’转变为‘流水线模式’——即研究的工业化。作者以美国能源部Genesis使命为例，提出七个关键问题：科学能力代际传递的侵蚀、AI生成理论的不透明性、机器产出洪流对同行评审的冲击、AI进行范式突破的未证实能力、政治与工业对科学议程的捕获、闭环流水线中系统性误差的累积、以及全球研究共同体的结构性分层。文章强调这些问题并非反对AI驱动科学，而是其负责任发展的前提条件。
Motivation: 随着AI成为科学研究的自主参与者，研究的本质正从以研究者为中心的手工模式转向分解、自动化与监督的流水线模式。这一转变（即研究的工业化）带来了根本性挑战，但尚未被系统性地审视。作者旨在提出并讨论七个关键问题，为AI驱动科学的负责任发展划定条件。
Conclusion: 作者指出，所提出的七点担忧并非否定AI驱动科学的潜力，而是构成其负责任发展的必要条件。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Scaling Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid control requires natural whole-body coordination, precise real-time responses to control signals, and robust generalization across diverse environmental contexts, making it a cornerstone for generalist embodied agents. Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) have recently emerged as a promising solution to address these challenges by leveraging large-scale behavioral data to achieve superior expressiveness, versatility and generalization. However, despite growing interest in scaling BFMs to further improve their capabilities, it remains unclear how key factors, including the learning paradigm, behavioral data and model architecture should be coordinated to enable effective scaling. In this work, we revisit the scaling recipe for BFMs and demonstrate that substantial performance gains can be achieved through the coordination of three core components: 1) the learning paradigm of motion tracking that reformulates diverse humanoid control problems as the reproduction of integrated whole-body behaviors in the global frame; 2) the strategic synergy between on-policy rollout quantity and reference motion diversity; and 3) the expressive and scalable model architecture termed Humanoid Transformer that facilitates the natural emergence of structured behavioral representations. Through extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world deployment, we demonstrate that our approach yields significant improvements in control fidelity and task generalization, reducing Mean Per-Keypoint Position Error (MPKPE) on the test set by over 10% in local mode and 82% in global mode compared with existing humanoid controllers. These results establish BFM as a principled and effective foundation for scalable and general-purpose humanoid control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用于人形机器人的行为基础模型（BFM）的扩展方法，通过协调运动跟踪学习范式、在线策略rollout量与参考动作多样性的战略协同，以及Humanoid Transformer架构，在仿真和真实部署中显著提升控制保真度和泛化能力，相比现有控制器，测试集上的平均关键点位置误差（MPKPE）降低超过10%（局部模式）和82%（全局模式）。
Motivation: 尽管行为基础模型在人形机器人控制中展现出前景，但如何协调学习范式、行为数据和模型架构以实现有效扩展仍不清楚。
Method: 提出扩展配方，包含三个核心组件：1) 运动跟踪学习范式，将多样的人形控制问题重新定义为全局坐标系下集成全身行为的再现；2) 在线策略rollout量与参考动作多样性的战略协同；3) 称为Humanoid Transformer的可表达且可扩展的模型架构。
Result: 在仿真和真实实验中，该方法在控制保真度和任务泛化方面取得显著改进，局部模式下MPKPE降低超过10%，全局模式下降低82%。
Conclusion: 这些结果确立了BFM作为可扩展通用人形控制的原则性且有效的基础。

papers.title: On-Policy Delta Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation is an alternative post-training method in reinforcement learning that alleviates the constraints imposed by reward models by providing token-level supervision from a teacher model. Although on-policy distillation has been studied and applied across various settings, its fundamental design remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce a new distillation reward, termed the delta signal, instead of directly imitating the teacher's output distribution. The delta signal is defined as the difference between the teacher model and its base model prior to instruction tuning for reasoning capability. It therefore captures the changes induced by reasoning tuning and provides a more direct signal for transferring reasoning capabilities. Using extensive empirical evidence, we show that the delta signal substantially improves on-policy distillation and refer to the new distillation method as On-Policy Delta Distillation (OPD$^2$). Experiments across mathematics, science, and code-reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that OPD$^2$ consistently outperforms conventional on-policy distillation, enabling reasoning LLMs to achieve strong performance with only a short post-training period. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/opd2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的策略蒸馏方法 On-Policy Delta Distillation (OPD^2)，利用教师模型与其基础模型（推理微调前）的差值作为 delta 信号，替代直接模仿教师输出分布。实验表明，该方法在数学、科学和代码推理基准上一致优于传统 on-policy 蒸馏，且仅需短时后训练即可获得强推理能力。
Motivation: 现有 on-policy 蒸馏直接模仿教师输出分布，但未能充分利用教师模型在推理微调后获得的能力变化，导致蒸馏效率受限。
Method: 定义 delta 信号为教师模型与其基础模型（推理微调前）的差值，作为蒸馏奖励，替代传统直接模仿教师输出分布的损失函数。
Result: 在数学、科学和代码推理基准上，OPD^2 一致优于传统 on-policy 蒸馏，且仅需短时后训练即可达到强推理性能。
Conclusion: delta 信号能更有效地传递推理能力，提升蒸馏效率，为 on-policy 蒸馏的设计提供了新的视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Concept-Guided Spatial Regularization for World Models in Atari Pong
papers.abstract_en: World models are usually evaluated as components of model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) systems, while the world models themselves are rarely studied in isolation. We examine five representative visual world-model agents in Atari Pong: DreamerV3, DIAMOND, TWISTER, Simulus, and STORM. After reproducing their training pipelines and matching the reported agent performance, we freeze the learned world models and evaluate them with a closed-loop rollout diagnostic: a policy trained separately from the corresponding MBRL agent interacts with each frozen model, and the generated video trajectories are inspected for visual and dynamical errors. Across all five models, the rollouts contain clear failures, including ball disappearance, incorrect ball motion, and invalid ball-paddle interactions. Beyond visual trajectories, we further evaluate them with pixel-space zero-shot MBRL, where a new policy is trained entirely inside a frozen world model and then evaluated in the real environment. Across all five models, the resulting policies substantially underperform those produced by the corresponding original MBRL training pipelines. The gap is particularly large for DreamerV3, whose mean return drops from -5.5 to -20.9, near the minimum Pong return of -21. We hypothesize that insufficient modeling of task-critical concepts, such as the ball in Pong, may contribute to these failures. We therefore propose Concept-Guided Spatial Regularization (CGSReg), an auxiliary pixel reconstruction loss applied to segmented concept regions. Experiments show that CGSReg improves both closed-loop rollouts and pixel-space zero-shot MBRL in DreamerV3, DIAMOND, and TWISTER. Its effects vary across the remaining models and evaluation metrics, indicating that CGSReg alone does not address all world-model bottlenecks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了五个视觉世界模型（DreamerV3, DIAMOND, TWISTER, Simulus, STORM）在Atari Pong上的表现，发现冻结后的世界模型在闭环rollout诊断中频繁出现视觉和动态错误（如球消失、运动错误），且在像素空间零样本MBRL中性能远低于原始训练管道。作者提出概念引导的空间正则化（CGSReg），通过对分割的概念区域施加辅助像素重建损失，在三个模型上改善了闭环rollout和零样本MBRL，但未能解决所有瓶颈。
Motivation: 世界模型通常仅作为MBRL系统的组件被评估，很少被单独研究其建模质量；本文旨在独立诊断世界模型的视觉和动态错误，发现它们对任务关键概念（如Pong中的球）建模不足。
Method: 提出Concept-Guided Spatial Regularization (CGSReg)，一种作用于分割后概念区域（如球、球拍）的辅助像素重建损失，引导世界模型更准确地建模关键动态实体。
Result: CGSReg改善了DreamerV3、DIAMOND和TWISTER的闭环rollout质量和像素空间零样本MBRL性能（如DreamerV3的平均回报从-20.9回升），但对Simulus和STORM效果不一，表明仅凭CGSReg无法全面解决世界模型瓶颈。
Conclusion: 摘要强调世界模型对任务关键概念的建模不足是导致失败的重要原因，CGSReg作为局部正则化手段能部分缓解问题，但尚需更全面的方法。

papers.title: Ray-based phase error correction for miniaturized DOE projector-based FPP under single-directional hyperbolic projection
papers.abstract_en: Fringe Projection Profilometry (FPP) systems using miniaturized DOE pro-jectors often suffer from severe phase artifacts due to nonlinear projection characteristics and limited pattern controllability. We propose a ray-based phase error correction framework that models phase artifacts along projection rays from the projector pinhole, incorporating projector geometry without re-lying on image-domain processing or neighboring pixels. A projector pinhole estimation method based on a single-directional hyperbolic fringe pattern is introduced, through which projector geometry can be recovered without stereo calibration. In addition, a data-efficient strategy constructs the re-finement model from a single calibration pose. Experiments on miniaturized DOE projector-based FPP systems demonstrate significant improvements in reconstruction accuracy under nonlinear projection conditions, confirming the robustness and physical consistency of the proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文针对微型DOE投影仪FPP系统的相位伪影问题，提出基于射线的相位误差校正框架，通过单方向双曲条纹图案估计投影仪针孔，无需立体标定，实验证明在非线性投影条件下显著提升重建精度。
Motivation: 微型DOE投影仪因非线性投影特性和有限图案可控性导致严重相位伪影，现有方法依赖图像域处理，未利用投影仪几何。
Method: 提出基于射线的相位误差校正框架，沿投影射线建模相位伪影；通过单方向双曲条纹图案估计投影仪针孔几何；采用数据高效策略从单次标定姿势构建精炼模型。
Result: 在微型DOE投影仪FPP系统上的实验表明，在非线性投影条件下重建精度显著提升。
Conclusion: 所提方法具有鲁棒性和物理一致性，适用于微型投影仪FPP系统。

papers.title: DAPGNet: Dynamic Adaptive Physics-Guided Graph Diffusion Network for Hyperspectral Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification requires reliable pixel-relation modeling under spectral variability, mixed pixels, and heterogeneous boundaries. Existing graph-based HSI classifiers usually construct graph topology from spatial proximity, superpixel connectivity, or learned feature affinity. However, the spectral physical prior carried by contiguous bands has limited influence on topology estimation and message propagation. This paper presents DAPGNet, a dynamic adaptive physics-guided graph diffusion network that injects a structure-constrained physical prior into relation-level graph learning. DAPGNet first encodes contiguous spectral responses into node-wise multiscale physical-prior representations. A two-stage graph constructor then combines spectral-spatial affinity, physical-prior consistency, and spatial distance to form a physical-prior-aware sparse topology. During graph diffusion, learned edge weights are transformed into additive attention biases, while a physical gate performs node-wise and feature-wise interpolation between graph-aggregated features and projected physical-prior features. Cross-scale fusion integrates node states from different diffusion depths, and the network is optimized with main classification, auxiliary supervision, and second-order spectral smoothness regularization. Experiments on Indian Pines, WHU-Hi-LongKou, Houston2013, and Houston2018 show that DAPGNet achieves the best OA, AA, and Kappa among representative CNN-, Transformer-, Mamba-, and graph-based baselines. It improves AA over the strongest competing method by 3.64 to 7.31 percentage points across the four datasets. Ablation and sensitivity analyses further support the complementary effects of physical-prior extraction, prior-aware topology construction, physics-gated propagation, and spectral smoothness regularization.
papers.comment: 9 figures and 9 tables. Pengkun Wang and Weijia Cao contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DAPGNet，一种动态自适应物理引导图扩散网络，用于高光谱图像（HSI）分类。该网络通过注入连续波段的光谱物理先验来改进图拓扑构建和图消息传播，在Indian Pines、WHU-Hi-LongKou、Houston2013和Houston2018四个基准数据集上取得了最优的总体精度（OA）、平均精度（AA）和Kappa系数，AA比最强对比方法高出3.64至7.31个百分点。
Motivation: 现有图分类器通常基于空间邻近性或特征相似性构建图拓扑，忽略了连续波段携带的光谱物理先验，导致拓扑估计和消息传播受限。
Method: DAPGNet首先将连续光谱响应编码为节点级多尺度物理先验表示；然后通过两阶段图构建器结合光谱-空间亲和度、物理先验一致性和空间距离形成物理先验感知的稀疏拓扑；在图扩散中将学习到的边权重转换为加性注意力偏置，并用物理门控进行节点和特征维度的插值；最后通过跨尺度融合不同扩散深度的节点状态，优化时结合主分类损失、辅助监督和二阶光谱平滑正则化。
Result: 在四个数据集上，DAPGNet在OA、AA和Kappa上均优于CNN、Transformer、Mamba和图基线方法，AA提升幅度为3.64至7.31个百分点。消融和敏感性分析验证了物理先验提取、先验感知拓扑、物理门控传播和光谱平滑正则化的互补效果。
Conclusion: 将结构约束的光谱物理先验注入图学习过程可显著提升HSI分类性能，各组件具有互补效应。

papers.title: NIFA: Nonlinear IMC enhanced FPGA for efficient ML inference
papers.abstract_en: Recent FPGAs have improved deep learning (DL) inference efficiency through dedicated tensor blocks and in-BRAM computation. ReRAM-based analog in-memory computing (IMC) pushes efficiency further, offering an order-of-magnitude improvement in compute density and energy efficiency over conventional digital logic by performing vector-matrix multiplication (VMM) directly within the ReRAM crossbar; prior work has integrated such IMC blocks into FPGAs for DL inference. However, conventional IMC designs support only static-weight VMM, leaving nonlinear operations and dynamic matrix-matrix multiplication (DIMM) to the FPGA fabric. As a result, the benefits of IMC are largely confined to static-weight models, whereas Transformer-based models, which rely on frequent nonlinear and DIMM operations, gain only limited improvement. Moreover, the ADCs within each IMC block consume more than 70% of its area and power, further limiting system efficiency and scalability. To address these limitations, we propose a novel FPGA architecture that integrates an ADC-free IMC block, replacing the conventional ADC with analog content-addressable memories (ACAMs) that natively perform nonlinear operations inside the block. To fully exploit this block, we conduct an FPGA-aware design-space exploration that determines optimal crossbar dimensions while balancing FPGA area, flexibility, and DL performance, and we develop an efficient mapping that leverages ACAMs to carry out DIMM operations, extending the applicability of IMC to attention computation. On CNN and Transformer-based benchmarks, the proposed architecture achieves up to 40x and 1.9x higher energy efficiency and 4.1x and 2.5x higher area efficiency, respectively. Overall, it significantly improves FPGA DL inference efficiency and sustains robust gains on Transformer-based workloads across long input sequences, advancing domain-specialized FPGA design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新型FPGA架构NIFA，通过集成无ADC的模拟存内计算（IMC）块和模拟内容寻址存储器（ACAM），实现对非线性操作和动态矩阵乘法（DIMM）的原生支持，从而提升Transformer和CNN模型在FPGA上的推理效率。在CNN和Transformer基准上，分别实现最高40倍和1.9倍的能效提升，以及4.1倍和2.5倍的面效提升。
Motivation: 传统FPGA中的IMC块仅支持静态权重向量矩阵乘法，无法高效处理Transformer模型中的非线性操作和动态矩阵乘法；此外，ADC占IMC块超过70%的面积和功耗，限制了系统效率和可扩展性。
Method: 提出无ADC的IMC块，用ACAM替代ADC以原生执行非线性操作；进行FPGA感知的设计空间探索，确定最优交叉杆尺寸；开发基于ACAM的高效映射策略以执行DIMM，将IMC扩展至注意力计算。
Result: 在CNN和Transformer基准上，能效分别提升40倍和1.9倍，面效分别提升4.1倍和2.5倍；在长输入序列的Transformer任务上保持稳定增益。
Conclusion: 所提架构显著提升了FPGA上深度学习推理的效率，特别是对Transformer模型，推动了领域专用FPGA设计的发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning in Infinitesimal Non-Compositional Sketches
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a categorical framework -- Learning in Infinitesimal Non-Compositional Sketches (LINCS) -- as the repair of non-compositionality: failures of diagrams to factor through quotient sketches lifted to the tangent category setting. Machine learning problems are specified as sketches: graphs with commutativity conditions $\mathcal D$, limit cones $\mathcal L$, and colimit cocones $\mathcal K$, generalizing the usual scalarization of loss functions or vector space assumptions. Non-compositionality is defined purely as failure of a universal factorization problem, not as arithmetic error between the desired and actual predictions. Given a learning sketch $\mathbb S=(S,\mathcal D,\mathcal L,\mathcal K)$, whose underlying graph is $S$, and a model $D:J \rightarrow C$, the base defect is the obstruction to factorization $\mbox{Obs}(\mbox{Fact}_{\mathbb S}(D))$. The tangent lift applies the tangent functor $T$ to obtain $TD:J \rightarrow C$, and LINCS is defined as the obstruction $\mbox{Obs}(\mbox{Fact}_{\mathbb S}(TD))$ -- asking whether infinitesimal perturbations preserve the compositionality constraints.The paper also introduces Tangent Learning Sketches, which are sketches equipped with Cockett-Cruttwell tangent structure. The paper defines the INC endofunctor, which iterates the tangent lift, producing a tower $D,TD,T^2D, \cdots$ of factorization problems. ML is thereby formulated as the search for a coalgebraic fixed point where successive tangent unfoldings stabilize ($νT_{\mbox{INC}}$). Using the Aczel--Mendler theorem, we prove existence of a final INC coalgebra whenever $T_{\mbox{INC}}$ admits a set-based class realization that creates its final carrier. A detailed experimental evaluation of LINCS is underway in a number of concrete ML settings, including deep learning, large language models, and reinforcement learning, and is described in companion papers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个范畴论框架 LINCS（Learning in Infinitesimal Non-Compositional Sketches），用于修复机器学习中的非组合性问题。通过将学习问题形式化为带约束的草图（sketches），并引入切线函子（tangent functor）考察无穷小扰动是否保持组合性约束，将机器学习建模为寻找余代数不动点的过程。
Motivation: 现有机器学习方法依赖于标量化损失函数或向量空间假设，缺乏对非组合性（diagrams 无法通过商草图因式分解）的形式化刻画。论文旨在建立纯范畴论的语言来统一描述和修复这类问题。
Method: 定义学习草图为带交换性条件、极限锥和余极限锥的图，非组合性被定义为通用因式分解问题的失败。通过切线函子提升得到 LINCS 作为因式分解障碍，并定义 INC 自函子迭代生成塔结构，将机器学习转化为寻找最终余代数不动点。
Result: 利用 Aczel-Mendler 定理，证明了当 INC 自函子具有基于类的实现并创建终载子时，最终 INC 余代数存在。实验部分在深度学习和 LLM 等场景中正在进行，由配套论文详述。
Conclusion: 论文提供了一个纯范畴论的 ML 框架，但实验验证依赖于配套工作，当前结果主要是理论存在性证明。

papers.title: Long-Context Fine-Tuning with Limited VRAM
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning reduces model and optimizer memory, but dense attention still makes long training sequences expensive. We combine Hierarchical Global Attention (HGA) with segment-wise backpropagation and tiered KV storage. Only the active segment remains differentiable in VRAM; older KV is detached into RAM or NVMe, and HGA loads a bounded set of exact historical tokens for each query block. On Qwen3-8B with 4-bit QLoRA and PG19, dense training on a 16 GB Quadro RTX 5000 fits 2,048 tokens but fails at 4,096, whereas HGA reaches 16,384 tokens with 15.28 GB peak VRAM. Under evaluation the same adapter runs through 131,072 tokens on this card; VRAM is not constant but grows gently with the resident chunk summaries, so RAM and NVMe capacity set the practical limit beyond these lengths. At the shared 2K training length, HGA-trained and dense-trained adapters obtain 2.7405 and 2.7383 nat under the same dense-attention readout, while the stock model obtains 2.9541. At this boundary HGA training is already marginally faster (217.75 vs. 207.02 tokens/s), and the HGA-to-dense throughput ratio improves from 1K to 2K; because HGA keeps the attended historical set per token approximately constant while dense work per token grows, we expect this lead to widen as context grows. Dense attention is used for the main quality and retrieval comparisons so that they measure the learned weights and remain compatible with standard generation frameworks. HGA can also be used for retrieval and generation; an optimized production-grade serving implementation is under development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长上下文微调中显存限制问题，提出分层全局注意力（HGA）结合分段反向传播和分层KV存储，使得在有限VRAM下支持更长训练序列。实验表明，在Qwen3-8B和4-bit QLoRA下，HGA在16GB显卡上支持16K token训练（峰值15.28GB），而密集注意力仅支持2K；相同适配器可在推理时处理131K token。在2K训练长度下，HGA和密集注意力训练的适配器性能接近（2.7405 vs 2.7383 nat），且HGA训练速度略快。
Motivation: 参数高效微调虽减少了模型和优化器内存，但密集注意力机制仍使长训练序列代价高昂，限制了可用上下文长度。
Method: 结合分层全局注意力（HGA）、分段反向传播和分层的KV存储：仅活动段在VRAM中可微分，旧KV被卸载到RAM或NVMe，HGA为每个查询块加载有界数量的精确历史token。
Result: Qwen3-8B上，HGA在16GB显存下支持16K训练token（峰值15.28GB），而密集注意力仅支持2K；推理时可达131K token。在2K训练长度下，HGA与密集注意力性能相近（2.7405 vs 2.7383 nat），且HGA训练吞吐量略高（217.75 vs 207.02 tokens/s）。
Conclusion: HGA方法使长上下文微调在有限VRAM下可行，且随上下文增长，其吞吐量优势预计扩大；但实际限制取决于RAM和NVMe容量。

papers.title: QuReC: All-in-One Image Restoration with Query-Specific Guidance and Local-Global Response Calibration
papers.abstract_en: All-in-one image restoration aims to recover clean images degraded by multiple corruption types using a single unified model. Existing methods typically rely on image-level prompts or shared guidance to handle diverse degradations. However, such a paradigm becomes inadequate when degradations are spatially heterogeneous or even coexist in mixed forms within a single image. Yet spatially adaptive guidance alone is not sufficient, since accurate restoration also requires each spatial query to reliably aggregate complementary information from local neighborhoods and global contexts. To this end, we propose QuReC, a unified framework for all-in-one image restoration. QuReC consists of a Degradation-Guided Query Reconstruction Module (DQRM) and a Local-Global Response Calibration Module (LGRCM). Specifically, DQRM matches each spatial query against a degradation prototype space to reconstruct a query-specific degradation-aware representation, thereby providing fine-grained spatially adaptive restoration guidance. To further stabilize this query-wise matching process, we introduce a weakly supervised prototype matching learning strategy to improve optimization stability and degradation semantic consistency. Meanwhile, LGRCM performs local-global dual-branch aggregation and calibrates the aggregated responses with learnable priors, improving the reliability of feature aggregation and the coordination between local detail modeling and global context modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that QuReC achieves superior performance on multiple all-in-one image restoration benchmarks. The code is released at https://github.com/zhoushen1/QuReC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QuReC，一种用于统一图像修复的框架，通过退化感知查询重建和局部-全局响应校准处理多种退化类型。DQRM将每个空间查询与退化原型空间匹配，生成查询特定的退化感知表示；LGRCM进行局部-全局双分支聚合并用可学习先验校准响应。在多个基准上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理空间异质或混合退化时不足，需要空间自适应引导以及可靠的局部-全局信息聚合。
Method: 提出Degradation-Guided Query Reconstruction Module (DQRM) 和 Local-Global Response Calibration Module (LGRCM)，并引入弱监督原型匹配学习策略以优化稳定性和语义一致性。
Result: 在多个统一图像修复基准上的实验表明，QuReC取得了优越性能。

papers.title: Digital Pantheon: Simulating and Auditing Coalition Formation with LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: The formation of political coalitions is a complex negotiation driven by both concrete policy objectives and deep-seated ideological convictions. While Large Language Models (LLMs) open new avenues for computational political science, the neutrality and helpfulness biases instilled by Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) prevent them from sustaining steadfast partisan behaviour. We present a multi-agent framework that reconciles factual grounding with ideological alignment by combining Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): DPO instils aggressive party-specific personas, while a per-party RAG pipeline keeps each agent bounded to its official manifesto. We operationalize the framework on the 2019 Flemish election, deploying the partisan agents in a hub-and-spoke negotiation arbitrated by a formateur. To make the emergent negotiation interpretable, we introduce a Multi-Layered Information Lineage Topology (MILT) that traces every clause in the final agreement back to its manifesto origin and classifies it into five provenance states, a Coalition Influence Score (CIS) that aggregates these traceable contributions to identify which party shaped the agreement, and a real-world grounding pass that benchmarks each simulated provision against the historically adopted coalition agreement. Across three independent simulations the framework yields a stable winner and ranking (N-VA ahead of CD\&V and Open Vld), and manifesto-anchored lineage reliably predicts real-world materialization whereas hallucinated content does not. The result is a transparent, scalable testbed for the ex-ante exploration of party compatibility and formateur-mediated compromise.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, To be published in the Post-Workshop proceedings of the ECML PKDD 2026 Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于LLM的多智能体框架，结合监督微调（SFT）、直接偏好优化（DPO）和检索增强生成（RAG），用于模拟和审计政治联盟形成。DPO灌输激进的党派人格，RAG保持各智能体忠于官方宣言。在2019年佛兰德选举的枢纽-辐条谈判中，引入多层级信息谱系拓扑（MILT）追溯协议条款来源，联盟影响力分数（CIS）聚合各党派贡献，并与真实联盟协议对比。三次独立模拟产生稳定的赢家和排名，宣言锚定的谱系可靠预测真实材料化。
Motivation: 现有LLM在模拟政治联盟时，RLHF引入的中立性和帮助性偏见使其难以维持坚定的党派行为，无法真实反映意识形态驱动的谈判。
Method: 构建多智能体框架，通过SFT、DPO和RAG组合：DPO使智能体获得激进的党派人格，每党独立的RAG管道将其约束于官方宣言。采用枢纽-辐条谈判结构，由形式协调人仲裁。引入MILT跟踪最终协议中每条款的宣言来源并分类为五种状态，CIS聚合贡献，以及真实世界基准测试。
Result: 在2019年佛兰德选举的三个独立模拟中，框架产生稳定的赢家和排名（N-VA领先于CD&V和Open Vld），且宣言锚定的谱系可靠预测现实材料化，而幻觉内容则不能。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一个透明、可扩展的测试平台，用于事前探索政党兼容性和形式协调人调解的妥协。

papers.title: AlphaWiSE: Adaptive Weight Interpolation for Continual Multimodal Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal models such as CLIP learn a shared embedding space for cross-modal retrieval, but continual adaptation to sequentially arriving data can disrupt the cross-modal alignment acquired from earlier phases. Conventional continual-learning methods return a single checkpoint, which commits every retrieval direction to the same stability-plasticity trade-off. We propose AlphaWiSE, a post-hoc weight-space interpolation method that composes two frozen source checkpoints. For each aligned parameter tensor identified by its checkpoint key, AlphaWiSE fits one scalar interpolation coefficient shared by all tensor entries. The coefficients are fitted on a smaller exemplar memory and used to materialize one interpolated checkpoint. The deployed model has the same architecture and parameter count as either source checkpoint, which does not require additional inference time. Extensive experiments on audio-image-text retrieval show consistent improvements over strong continual-learning baselines across multiple retrieval directions and evaluation metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AlphaWiSE，一种后验权重空间插值方法，用于持续多模态表示学习。该方法通过为每个参数张量拟合一个标量插值系数，组合两个冻结的源检查点，从而在不增加推理时间的情况下实现跨模态对齐的稳定-塑性平衡。在音频-图像-文本检索任务上，AlphaWiSE一致优于多个强持续学习基线。
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法仅返回单个检查点，迫使所有检索方向采用相同的稳定-塑性权衡，导致跨模态对齐在连续数据流中退化。
Method: 提出后验权重空间插值方法AlphaWiSE，针对每个由检查点键标识的对齐参数张量，在一个较小的样本记忆集上拟合一个共享标量插值系数，用于生成插值后的检查点。
Result: 在音频-图像-文本检索任务上，AlphaWiSE在多个检索方向和评估指标上一致优于强持续学习基线方法。
Conclusion: AlphaWiSE无需额外推理时间，保持与源检查点相同的架构和参数量，有效缓解跨模态表示学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。

papers.title: Quantifying Training Membership Information in the Hyperspherical Embedding Geometry of Face Recognition Models
papers.abstract_en: Face recognition models represent each face as an embedding vector on the unit hypersphere by clustering embeddings of the same identity while pushing different identities apart through angular-margin losses. Because these losses act only on training identities, non-member identities may form clusters with different geometric properties. In this paper, we quantify the magnitude of this difference and what training-time factors control it. We compute four statistics based on cluster geometry across 180 face recognition models in a factorial design over IResNet backbone size, loss head, training duration, and the number of training identities, and evaluate each configuration on nine benchmarks. Our results indicate that the number of training identities has the largest effect on member/non-member separability, while backbone and loss head contribute far less, and that, on a same-domain held-out reference, the geometric membership signal decreases monotonically as more identities are added to training. We provide an analysis of cross-domain (pose, age, quality, ethnicity) non-member benchmarks and report that these inflate the apparent membership signal. Finally, we fuse all four statistics with a learned classifier to reveal additional membership information beyond the best individual statistic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文量化了人脸识别模型中训练成员信息在超球面嵌入几何中的差异，通过控制IResNet骨干网络大小、损失头、训练时长和训练身份数量等因子，在180个模型上计算四种聚类几何统计量，并在九个基准上评估。结果表明训练身份数量对成员/非成员可分性影响最大，且同一领域参考集上成员信号随身份数量增加单调递减；跨领域（姿态、年龄、质量、种族）基准会夸大成员信号；融合所有统计量的学习分类器可揭示更多成员信息。
Motivation: 现有基于角间隔损失的人脸识别模型对训练身份进行聚类，非成员身份可能形成不同几何特性的聚类，但缺乏对差异大小及控制因素的量化研究。
Method: 采用析因设计，系统变化IResNet骨干大小、损失头、训练时长和训练身份数量，训练180个模型；计算基于聚类几何的四种统计量，并在九个基准上评估成员/非成员可分性。
Result: 训练身份数量对成员信号影响最大，骨干和损失头贡献较小；同域参考集上信号随身份增多单调递减；跨域基准会膨胀成员信号；融合所有统计量的分类器优于最佳单个统计量。
Conclusion: 本文系统量化了人脸识别中训练成员信息的几何信号及其影响因素，指出跨域评估可能高估成员信息，融合多统计量可更充分提取成员信号。

papers.title: Towards Hierarchical Structure Understanding of Newspaper Images
papers.abstract_en: Understanding newspaper images remains a challenging task due to their complex, nested hierarchical structures and dense, heterogeneous layouts. In this paper, we explore two complementary approaches for newspaper structure understanding. First, we present a modular bottom-up pipeline that combines state-of-the-art open-source models: YOLO for layout detection, LayoutReader for reading order prediction, and a custom algorithm for article segmentation. This approach leverages existing robust components while maintaining flexibility and interpretability. Second, we introduce Tiramisu (Tiered Transformers for Hierarchical Structure Understanding), a novel end-to-end transformer-based architecture that explicitly models document hierarchy through an iterative tiered process. Tiramisu performs section and article separation, block localization, semantic categorization, and reading order prediction using highly parallelized attention mechanisms. Finally, we release Finlam La Liberté, a new dataset designed specifically for evaluating hierarchical information retrieval in historical newspapers. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of both approaches in reconstructing complex newspaper hierarchies, with comparative analysis highlighting their respective strengths for scalable document digitization. The Tiramisu training code, including the synthetic newspaper generator, is available at https://git.litislab.fr/tiramisu/tiramisu-newspaper-articles-extractor.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICDAR 2026 Workshop on Historical Document Imaging and Processing (HIP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对报纸图像的复杂嵌套层次结构和密集异构布局，提出两种互补方法：一种模块化的自底向上流水线（结合YOLO、LayoutReader和文章分割算法），另一种端到端变换器架构Tiramisu，通过迭代分层过程显式建模文档层次结构。实验表明两种方法均能有效重建复杂报纸层次，并发布新数据集Finlam La Liberté。
Motivation: 现有方法难以处理报纸图像复杂的层次结构和密集布局，需要可解释且灵活的方案。
Method: 提出模块化流水线（YOLO+LayoutReader+自定义文章分割）和端到端Tiramisu变换器，后者通过并行注意力机制同时进行节/文章分离、块定位、语义分类和阅读顺序预测。
Result: 两种方法在重建报纸层次结构上均有效，比较分析显示了各自在可扩展文档数字化中的优势。
Conclusion: 模块化方法利用现有模型保持灵活性，Tiramisu通过端到端学习实现层次建模，两者互补。

papers.title: Evaluating covariate balance for long time horizon Markov decision processes
papers.abstract_en: This article explores the application of covariate balance diagnostics for detecting the presence of hidden confounding/model miss-specification in studies applying offline reinforcement learning (RL) to deriving optimal treatment recommendations. The results demonstrate that, either there is a high risk of bias within existing offline RL studies for treatment recommendations or, existing covariate balance metrics are not sufficient to assess such studies. Regardless, existing offline RL studies cannot be concluded as being statistically robust. The conclusions propose future research directions for obtaining more methodologically robust applications of offline RL to treatment recommendation problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了在离线强化学习（offline RL）应用于最优治疗推荐时，使用协变量平衡诊断（covariate balance diagnostics）来检测隐藏混淆或模型误设定的可行性。结果表明，现有离线RL研究要么存在高偏倚风险，要么现有协变量平衡指标不足以评估这些研究，因此无法认定这些研究的统计稳健性。
Motivation: 在离线RL用于治疗推荐的研究中，隐藏混淆和模型误设定可能导致偏倚，但缺乏有效的诊断方法来评估其影响。
Method: 通过应用协变量平衡诊断方法，分析现有离线RL研究中的偏倚风险。
Result: 发现现有离线RL治疗推荐研究有高偏倚风险，或者现有协变量平衡指标不足以评估这些研究。
Conclusion: 现有离线RL研究不能被认为是统计稳健的，未来需要开发更方法学稳健的离线RL应用。

papers.title: BrainPilot: Automating Brain Discovery with Agentic Research
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the brain increasingly depends on integrating evidence across scales, modalities, and disciplines. Addressing a single research question therefore requires a coordinated sequence of operations, from surveying prior work to executing analyses and interpreting results in light of domain knowledge. AI agents promise to accelerate this process, but current agents lack domain expertise in brain science, may fabricate claims, drift during multi-step reasoning, and offer few defined points for expert intervention. These failures are especially costly in brain science, where conclusions feed into downstream scientific claims and depend on laboratory-specific expertise and careful human judgment. We present \textbf{BrainPilot} a \textbf{fully open-source} multi-agent system that accelerates brain science research with traceable logs and agent-verified results. A principal investigator (PI) agent coordinates specialist agents grounded in curated domain knowledge: a unified brain science knowledge base containing 7{,}233 indexed items and a skill library of 72 reusable methodology units across seven research domains. Every major step is recorded in the Graph of Trace, an auditable record that links subgoals, tool use, evidence, and claims and allows researchers to follow and inspect the workflow. An Auditor agent further integrates fabrication checking into the workflow. For evaluation, we run three brain science tasks from Agents' Last Exam, introduce our own benchmark, \textbf{BrainPilotBench-v0}, and present additional end-to-end case studies. Across these evaluations, BrainPilot with an open-source backbone model attains performance comparable to state-of-the-art agent framework with less costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BrainPilot，一个完全开源的多智能体系统，用于加速脑科学研究。该系统包含一个知识库（7,233 个索引项）和技能库（72 个可复用方法论单元），通过 PI 智能体协调专业智能体，并使用 Graph of Trace 记录工作流，Auditor 智能体检测虚构内容。在脑科学任务上，BrainPilot 使用开源基础模型达到了与最先进智能体框架相当的性能，且成本更低。
Motivation: 脑科学研究需要跨尺度、跨模态的证据整合，现有 AI 智能体缺乏领域专业知识，容易产生虚构内容、在多步推理中漂移，且缺乏专家干预点，导致结论可靠性低。
Method: 提出多智能体系统 BrainPilot，包含 PI 智能体协调专业智能体，基于统一脑科学知识库（7,233 项）和技能库（72 个方法论单元），通过 Graph of Trace 记录子目标、工具使用、证据和主张，Auditor 智能体集成虚构检测。
Result: 在 Agents' Last Exam 的三个脑科学任务以及自建基准 BrainPilotBench-v0 上，BrainPilot 使用开源基础模型达到了与最先进智能体框架相当的性能，且成本更低。
Conclusion: BrainPilot 通过可追溯日志和智能体验证，为脑科学研究提供了可靠的自动化工具，但当前评估仅针对脑科学领域，泛化性未验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: An Introduction to Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics for Engineering Applications
papers.abstract_en: Many engineering problems involve phenomena whose governing equations are poorly characterized or only partially known. Surrogate modeling techniques such as neural networks can capture the behavior of these systems, but they typically demand large training datasets that are difficult to obtain in engineering contexts and yield models with limited physical interpretability. The Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (SINDy) method addresses both limitations by performing sparse regression over libraries of candidate nonlinear terms, recovering interpretable governing equations from comparatively small datasets. Although SINDy has been demonstrated extensively on canonical benchmark systems, its application to practical engineering problems is less widely documented. This tutorial introduces the SINDy method and progressively builds toward its main extensions, from noise-robust weak-form and ensembling-based variants to constrained and parametrizable formulations. The paper and the accompanying tutorial (available at https://github.com/paullililili/SINDy4Engineers) is organized in three parts: the first introduces the standard SINDy algorithm and progressively extends it, inviting readers without prior knowledge to follow each step and adapt the methods to their own problems; the remaining two parts present detailed case studies on (1) the system identification of an unmanned aerial vehicle and (2) a chaotic thermosyphon heat exchanger. Through these examples, we aim to demonstrate that SINDy is simple to implement yet flexible enough to serve as a valuable identification tool for advanced engineering applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向工程应用的稀疏辨识非线性动力学（SINDy）教程。文章从标准SINDy算法出发，逐步扩展到噪声鲁棒的弱形式、集成变体、约束和参数化形式，并通过无人机系统辨识和混沌热虹吸热交换器两个案例展示其实用性。文章强调SINDy方法实现简单且灵活，适合工程辨识任务。
Motivation: 许多工程问题的控制方程难以获得，而神经网络等代理模型需要大量训练数据且缺乏可解释性。SINDy通过稀疏回归从较小数据集中恢复可解释的动力学方程，但其在工程中的实际应用案例较少，因此需要一篇渐进式教程来推广。
Method: 采用SINDy方法，在候选非线性项库上进行稀疏回归，并介绍其扩展：噪声鲁棒的弱形式、集成方法、约束和参数化变体。教程分为三部分：标准算法介绍、无人机系统辨识案例、热虹吸热交换器案例。
Result: 通过两个详细案例（无人机和混沌热交换器）展示SINDy的实用性和灵活性，表明该方法简单易实现且适用于高级工程辨识。
Conclusion: 本文旨在为工程从业者提供SINDy的入门指南，证明其作为工程系统辨识工具的价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ESAR: Event-Based Synthetic Aperture Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras report asynchronous polarity events when changes in log--radiance exceed a fixed contrast threshold, producing signed temporal contrast measurements rather than conventional image frames. We formulate monocular event-based imaging as a synthetic-aperture inverse problem for a static ground-domain log--radiance field $θ\in \mathbb{R}^{N_g}$. Instead of reconstructing a latent pixel-time volume $v \in \mathbb{R}^{N_pN_t}$, we impose the geometric relation $v=Pθ$, where $P$ maps the fixed scene into motion-dependent latent views. Aggregating events over finite time intervals gives the linearized model \[ APθ= b+η, \] where $A$ is a temporal differencing operator, $b$ contains signed binned event counts, and $η$ represents measurement and modeling errors. This decomposition exposes a synthetic-aperture structure: under near-nadir motion, successive projections are approximately shifted views of a common scene, while the composite operator $AP$ remains ill-conditioned because it combines spatial averaging with temporal differencing. We therefore use regularized inversion to recover $θ$. Numerical experiments on simulated data and real near-nadir Falcon Neuro event data show that the proposed $θ$-based formulation recovers coherent large-scale spatial structure, relative to dynamic latent-image and learned event-reconstruction baselines, while suppressing fine-scale texture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将单目事件相机成像建模为合成孔径逆问题，恢复静态地面场景的对数辐照度场，通过正则化反演抑制噪声。数值实验在模拟数据和真实近天底事件数据上验证了恢复大尺度空间结构的能力。
Motivation: 现有事件相机重建方法通常重建动态像素-时间体积，计算复杂且受噪声影响。本文旨在利用事件数据的稀疏性和几何关系，通过合成孔径结构更高效地恢复静态场景。
Method: 通过线性化模型 APθ = b+η 将事件数据与静态场景的投影关系相结合，其中 P 将静态场景映射到运动相关的潜在视图，A 是时间差分算子，b 是符号性事件计数，然后采用正则化反演求解 θ。
Result: 在模拟数据和真实事件数据（Falcon Neuro）上，与动态潜在图像和学习式事件重建基线相比，本文方法能恢复连贯的大尺度空间结构并抑制细尺度纹理。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确讨论局限，但强调基于θ的合成孔径公式在事件相机成像中的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kernel weighted importance sampling for off-policy evaluation in contextual bandits
papers.abstract_en: This article presents a novel estimator for performing off-policy evaluation using only offline data for contextual bandits. The proposed estimator, Kernel-WIS is demonstrated to be asymptotically consistent and to empirically outperform strong baselines (including vanilla weighted importance sampling), particularly under complex conditions including behaviour policy miss-specification. The benefit of Kernel-WIS is derived from combining the bounded property of vanilla weighted importance sampling with the linearity of vanilla importance sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对上下文多臂赌博机（contextual bandits）的离线策略评估问题，提出了一种新型估计器 Kernel-WIS。该估计器通过结合加权重要性采样（weighted importance sampling）的有界性和普通重要性采样（importance sampling）的线性性，在行为策略误指定等复杂条件下取得了比 vanilla weighted importance sampling 等强基线更好的经验性能，且理论证明了渐近一致性。
Motivation: 现有离线策略评估方法在行为策略误指定等复杂条件下表现不佳，尤其是重要性采样方法存在方差大或偏差的问题，需要一种更鲁棒的估计器。
Method: 提出 Kernel-WIS 估计器，融合了加权重要性采样的有界性（bounded property）和普通重要性采样的线性性（linearity）。
Result: 理论分析表明 Kernel-WIS 是渐近一致的（asymptotically consistent）；实验结果显示其在行为策略误指定等复杂条件下显著优于 vanilla weighted importance sampling 等基线方法。
Conclusion: Kernel-WIS 通过巧妙地结合两种重要性采样的优点，为离线策略评估提供了一种更可靠的选择，尤其适用于真实世界中行为策略未知或误指定的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DriftWorld: Fast World Modeling through Drifting
papers.abstract_en: Predictive world models enable robots to plan by imagining the outcomes of their actions, but their value for control hinges on generating many rollouts quickly. This creates a bottleneck for diffusion-based world models: multistep sampling makes each rollout expensive, limiting large-scale action search at inference time. We introduce DriftWorld, an action-conditioned world model based on drifting generative models. Rather than denoising iteratively at inference, DriftWorld learns an action-conditioned drift during training, allowing it to generate future frames from the current observation and a candidate action sequence in a single forward pass at 30+ fps, which is 17x faster on average than diffusion based baselines. We evaluate DriftWorld on standard vision-based robotic manipulation benchmarks, including Bridge-V2, RT-1, Language Table, Push-T, and Robomimic. By producing rollouts that are both accurate and fast, DriftWorld achieves state-of-the-art decision-making performance with far less inference time than diffusion-based world model baselines. Beyond online control, DriftWorld can also serve as an offline simulator for ranking real-world robot policies, with rollout-based scores correlating with ground truth at up to 0.99. These results show that drifting models are a strong fit for robot world modeling, where fast, high-quality imagination directly supports planning and policy evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DriftWorld，一种基于漂移生成模型 (drifting generative model) 的动作条件世界模型，用于机器人规划。与传统扩散模型需要多步去噪不同，DriftWorld 在训练时学习动作条件漂移，推理时仅需一次前向传播即可生成未来帧，速度达到 30+ fps，平均比扩散模型基线快 17 倍。在 Bridge-V2、Robomimic 等多个机器人操作基准上，DriftWorld 在决策性能上达到最先进水平，同时推理时间大幅减少。此外，它还可作为离线模拟器评估真实机器人策略，滚动得分与真实值相关性高达 0.99。
Motivation: 机器人规划依赖于世界模型快速生成大量轨迹，但扩散模型的多步采样成本高昂，限制了推理时的大规模动作搜索。
Method: 基于漂移生成模型，训练时学习从当前观测到未来帧的动作条件漂移场，推理时通过单步前向传播直接生成预测帧。
Result: 在多个机器人操作基准上，DriftWorld 以 30+ fps 运行，平均比扩散模型快 17 倍，且决策性能达到最先进水平。作为离线模拟器时，滚动得分与真实策略性能相关性高达 0.99。
Conclusion: 漂移模型因其快速且高质量的未来帧生成能力，非常适合机器人世界建模，可直接支持规划和策略评估。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: SUFLECA: Scaling Up Feature Learning for CAD-to-image Alignment
papers.abstract_en: CAD-to-image alignment aims to estimate an object's 9D pose (rotation, translation, and anisotropic scale) from a single RGB image, enabling applications in robotics and augmented reality. Recent zero-shot methods use visual foundation models to match image regions to CAD models, yet typically their correspondences are appearance-driven and degrade under occlusion or sim-to-real domain shift. To address these limitations, we introduce SUFLECA (Scaling Up Feature LEarning for CAD Alignment), a weakly-supervised framework for zero-shot CAD alignment with two key contributions. First, SUFLECA scales up geometry-grounded feature learning from pretrained visual representations through Normalized Object Coordinates (NOCs) supervision on 674K images spanning 12 real and synthetic datasets, learning compact geometry-aware features that generalize across domains. Second, we propose a geometrically consistent matching algorithm that establishes reliable one-to-one CAD-to-image correspondences. Together, these contributions enable accurate, sub-second alignment per object instance without iterative pose refinement. On ScanNet25k, SUFLECA achieves 33.4%/42.3% category/instance accuracy, outperforming, with a smaller computational footprint, the strongest zero-shot baseline by 10.3/12.2 percentage points and, for the first time on this benchmark, even surpassing fully supervised methods. Code is available at: https://github.com/snt-arg/SUFLECA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SUFLECA，一个弱监督的零样本 CAD 对齐框架，通过在大规模真实和合成数据集上学习几何感知特征，并设计几何一致的匹配算法，实现快速准确的 9D 姿态估计（包括各向异性缩放）。在 ScanNet25k 上，SUFLECA 在类别和实例精度上分别达到 33.4% 和 42.3%，超过最强零样本基线 10.3/12.2 个百分点，甚至首次超越全监督方法。
Motivation: 现有零样本 CAD 对齐方法依赖外观驱动的匹配，在遮挡和模拟到真实域迁移下性能下降。需要更鲁棒的几何特征学习。
Method: 提出弱监督框架 SUFLECA，利用 Normalized Object Coordinates (NOCs) 在大规模数据上（674K 图像，12 个数据集）进行几何特征学习，并采用几何一致匹配算法建立可靠的一对一对应关系。
Result: 在 ScanNet25k 上，SUFLECA 实现 33.4% 类别精度和 42.3% 实例精度，计算开销更小，超越最强零样本基线 10.3/12.2 个百分点，并首次超越全监督方法。
Conclusion: 通过扩展几何特征学习和大规模数据训练，零样本 CAD 对齐可以达到甚至超越全监督方法，且无需迭代优化即可实现亚秒级对齐。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在 ScanNet25k 上，SUFLECA 实现 33.4% 类别精度和 42.3% 实例精度，计算开销更小，超越最强零样本基线 10.3/12.2 个百分点，并首次超越全监督方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过扩展几何特征学习和大规模数据训练，零样本 CAD 对齐可以达到甚至超越全监督方法，且无需迭代优化即可实现亚秒级对齐。

papers.title: Beyond Single Expert: Harmonizing Diverse Visual Priors in MLLMs for Spatial Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated substantial promise in spatial understanding. Existing works typically incorporate prior knowledge extracted from a pre-trained foundation model to further enhance the spatial awareness of MLLMs. In this paper, we first reveal that when integrating diverse foundation models into MLLMs, different models provide complementary spatial priors that benefit different tasks. Motivated by this, we propose $\textbf{ViPS}$, a novel multi-model prior framework designed to fully unleash the potential of incorporating multiple $\textbf{Vi}$sual $\textbf{P}$riors from diverse models into MLLMs for $\textbf{S}$patial understanding. Specifically, ViPS introduces an Efficient Prior Proxy to generate multiple foundational priors with minimal inference overhead, and a Dynamic Prior Fusion mechanism to achieve harmonious and context-aware prior fusion and injection from the prior proxies. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ViPS successfully harmonizes diverse visual priors, establishing new state-of-the-art performance across multiple complex spatial reasoning and 3D spatial understanding benchmarks. Project page: https://visual-ai.github.io/vips
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ViPS框架，旨在将多个预训练基础模型（如深度估计、分割等）提供的互补视觉先验高效融合到多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中，以提升空间理解能力。通过引入高效先验代理（Efficient Prior Proxy）和动态先验融合（Dynamic Prior Fusion）机制，ViPS以极小的推理开销生成并融合多种视觉先验，在多个复杂空间推理和3D空间理解基准上取得新最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有工作通常只将单个预训练模型的先验知识注入MLLM，但不同模型在不同任务上提供互补的空间先验，没有被充分利用。
Method: 提出ViPS框架，包含两个核心组件：1）Efficient Prior Proxy，以低推理开销从多个基础模型生成多样化先验；2）Dynamic Prior Fusion，根据上下文自适应地融合和注入这些先验。
Result: 在多个复杂空间推理和3D空间理解基准上达到新最先进性能，验证了多样视觉先验和谐融合的有效性。
Conclusion: ViPS成功证明整合多种互补视觉先验可以显著增强MLLM的空间理解能力，并提供了一种高效、可扩展的融合方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ANet Patu-1: The Value of Connection in the Agent Network
papers.abstract_en: The Internet taught us that the value of a network depends on \emph{how} its nodes connect: broadcast stars scale as $V\!\propto\!N$ (Sarnoff), fully-connected meshes as $N^2$ (Metcalfe), and group-forming networks as $2^{N}$ (Reed). We ask the analogous question for networks of AI agents. We model the net value of connection as a function of coordination-group size, derive from it the properties an optimal collaboration protocol must have, and introduce ANet Patu-1 -- a self-organizing consensus protocol in which the network continuously re-forms its own coalitions, adaptively riding the upper envelope of all three regimes at $O(1)$ parallel consensus rounds. To measure value without opinion-grading, we score an emergent protocol by formally specifying it and deriving its complexity, the way distributed algorithms are analyzed. Two results follow. (i)~Emergence -- a crowd of the \emph{cheapest} model, when heterogeneous, starts weak but its collective value compounds with $N$ and \emph{overtakes} a crowd of a far \emph{stronger} model that is homogeneous: a crossover that marks a scaling law for collaboration rather than for scale. (ii)~Reflexivity -- a heterogeneous network, given only its own problem and no design hints, converges on ANet Patu-1 itself, reconstructing the high-dimensional law that governs its own connective value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文借鉴互联网价值定律（Sarnoff、Metcalfe、Reed），研究AI代理网络的连接价值。提出自组织共识协议ANet Patu-1，该协议在O(1)并行轮次内自适应地跨越三种价值增长模式的上包络。结果表明：异质廉价模型群体通过协作可超越同质强模型群体（协作缩放定律），且异质网络在无设计提示下能自发收敛到ANet Patu-1。
Motivation: 互联网价值定律表明网络价值取决于节点连接方式，但AI代理网络的价值规律尚不明确。需要为代理网络建立类似的价值理论和最优协作协议。
Method: 将连接价值建模为协调组规模的函数，推导最优协作协议所需性质，并设计ANet Patu-1自组织共识协议。该协议持续重构联盟，自适应地运行于三种价值增长模式的上包络，且并行轮次复杂度为O(1)。
Result: 两个核心结果：(i) 涌现——异质廉价模型群体开始时弱，但集体价值随N复合增长，最终超越同质强模型群体，标志协作缩放律；(ii) 反身性——异质网络仅凭自身问题即可收敛到ANet Patu-1，重建控制自身连接价值的高维定律。
Conclusion: 摘要强调代理网络的连接价值遵循协作缩放律，ANet Patu-1协议能自适应优化连接结构，且异质网络具有自发收敛到最优协议的反身性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RoGS: Adaptive Meshgrid Gaussian for Large-Scale Road Surface Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Road surface mapping plays a crucial role in autonomous driving, supporting high-definition map generation, lane-level perception, and automatic road annotation. Recent mesh-based road surface reconstruction methods have shown promising results, but they still suffer from limited reconstruction quality and high optimization cost, especially in large-scale driving scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose ROADGS-T, a robust and efficient large-scale road surface mapping framework based on adaptive meshgrid Gaussian representation. Specifically, we model the road surface by placing 2D Gaussian surfels on a meshgrid, where each surfel explicitly stores color, semantic, and geometric information. Compared with conventional mesh-based representations and 3D Gaussian primitives, the proposed meshgrid Gaussian representation better matches the thin-surface property of roads while significantly reducing redundant primitives and overlap during optimization. To further improve representation efficiency and structural fidelity, we introduce a road-structure-aware adaptive meshgrid strategy, which allocates denser Gaussian surfels to geometrically or semantically complex regions, such as lane markings, road boundaries, and height discontinuities, while maintaining a compact representation in flat road areas. Moreover, instead of relying on a single nearest vehicle pose, we design a trajectory-consistency-guided pose-robust refinement strategy, which estimates local surface priors from multiple neighboring poses and adaptively weights pose-guided height regularization according to their geometric consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ROADGS-T，一种基于自适应网格高斯表示的大规模道路表面建图框架。通过将2D高斯表面元放置在网格上，并引入道路结构感知的自适应网格策略和轨迹一致性引导的位姿鲁棒优化，提高了道路表面重建的质量和效率。
Motivation: 现有基于网格的道路表面重建方法在大型驾驶场景中重建质量有限且优化成本高。
Method: 使用2D高斯表面元置于网格上，显式存储颜色、语义和几何信息；提出道路结构感知自适应网格策略，在几何或语义复杂区域分配更密集的高斯表面元；设计轨迹一致性引导的位姿鲁棒优化策略，从多个邻近位姿估计局部表面先验并自适应加权高度正则化。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称该方法在重建质量和效率上优于传统网格表示和3D高斯基元。
Conclusion: 该方法针对道路表面的薄表面特性，减少了冗余基元和重叠，提高了表示效率和结构保真度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Parameter-efficient Prompt Tuning of Vision Foundation Model With Adaptive Focal Loss for Interpretable MCI Screening
papers.abstract_en: Mild Cognitive Impairment is a critical early stage of cognitive decline that frequently precedes Alzheimer's disease, yet its automated detection from neuropsychological drawing tests remains fundamentally constrained by data scarcity, class imbalance, and diagnostic ambiguity near clinical boundaries. Existing methodologies attempt to bypass these constraints using computationally expensive, fully fine-tuned hybrid architectures that relegate spatial explainability to a post-hoc approximation rather than an intrinsic model property. We propose a parameter-efficient framework utilizing frozen DINOv2-Small model adapted via three modality-specific learnable prompt tokens while Operating with 1.19 million trainable parameters, each token serves as a query in a shared cross-attention layer over the source image patch tokens. Crucially, spatial explainability is achieved directly through these attention maps; as a structural consequence of the architecture. Then task-conditioned embeddings fused via an attention module to quantify modality-level importance per subject. To handle boundary ambiguity, a MoCA-adapted focal loss introduced that integrates continuous cognitive scores into the training target, loss modulation, and adaptive sample weighting, strictly generalizing standard soft-label approaches. Under stratified five-fold cross-validation, the proposed architecture yields an MCI-class F1 of 0.641 and an AUC of 0.795, outperforming the computationally heavier ResViT baseline by 0.110 in MCI-class F1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种参数高效的提示微调框架，利用冻结的DINOv2-Small视觉基础模型，通过三个模态特定的可学习提示令牌（prompt tokens）进行自适应聚焦损失训练，用于可解释的轻度认知障碍（MCI）筛查。在分层五折交叉验证下，该方法在MCI类F1分数上达到0.641，AUC为0.795，优于计算量更大的ResViT基线。
Motivation: 现有MCI自动检测方法受限于数据稀缺、类别不平衡和临床边界附近的诊断模糊性，且通常依赖计算昂贵的全微调混合架构，其空间可解释性仅为事后近似而非模型固有属性。
Method: 提出参数高效框架：使用冻结的DINOv2-Small模型，通过三个模态特定可学习提示令牌进行适配，仅训练119万参数；每个令牌作为共享交叉注意力层中的查询，直接通过注意力图实现空间可解释性；引入MoCA自适应聚焦损失，将连续认知评分整合到训练目标中，严格泛化标准软标签方法。
Result: 在分层五折交叉验证下，MCI类F1为0.641，AUC为0.795，比计算量更大的ResViT基线在MCI类F1上高0.110。
Conclusion: 该方法通过参数高效的提示微调和自适应聚焦损失，在MCI筛查中实现了可解释性和性能的提升，但仍需在更大规模数据上验证。

papers.title: Weakly-Supervised RGB-D Salient Object Detection via SAM-driven Pseudo Annotation and State Space Interaction-based Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Weakly-supervised RGB-D Salient Object Detection (SOD) is explored to reduce the heavy burden of pixel-level annotations. But scribble annotations lack the structure and details of objects, resulting in inaccurate saliency maps. In this paper, we propose a novel scribble-supervised RGB-D SOD method, consisting of a Segment Anything Model (SAM)-driven pseudo annotation generation method (\emph{SAM-PAG}) and a state space interaction-based conditional diffusion model (\emph{$S^2$Diff}). Specifically, SAM-PAG is tailored to address the issue of sparse supervision information. In SAM-PAG, we adopt the advanced SAM to expand sparse scribbles to dense pixel-level pseudo annotations through the dual-branch structure and the consistency of segmentation masks. In $S^2$Diff, we adopt the diffusion model to iteratively refine the noisy saliency maps with the guidance of conditional information, generating accurate saliency maps. Naturally, the core of our $S^2$Diff lies in the acquisition of conditional features and the denoising of saliency maps. For the former, we employ a cross-modal conditional generation module to interweave cross-modal features through frequency integration and implicit-explicit state space interaction, effectively achieving global conditional features. For the latter, we employ a context injection module to mitigate noise interference and to enhance object information with the conditional context. With the close cooperation of SAM-PAG and $S^2$Diff, our method outperforms relevant scribble-supervised methods and achieves competitive performance compared to fully-supervised methods on seven datasets. The code and results of our method are available at https://github.com/Switch457/WeakS2Diff_SOD.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 9 figures, accepted by IEEE TMM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对弱监督RGB-D显著目标检测中scribble标注缺乏结构细节的问题，提出SAM驱动的伪标注生成方法SAM-PAG和状态空间交互条件扩散模型S²Diff。SAM-PAG利用SAM将稀疏scribble扩展为密集像素级伪标注；S²Diff通过交叉模态条件生成模块和上下文注入模块逐步细化噪声显著图。在七个数据集上，该方法超越相关弱监督方法，并与全监督方法性能相当。
Motivation: 现有弱监督RGB-D SOD方法依赖稀疏scribble标注，缺乏对象结构和细节，导致显著图不准确，需要更有效的伪标注生成和显著图精化策略。
Method: 提出SAM-PAG（基于SAM的双分支结构生成密集像素级伪标注）和S²Diff（条件扩散模型，包含交叉模态条件生成模块和上下文注入模块），其中交叉模态条件生成模块通过频率集成和隐式-显式状态空间交互实现全局条件特征。
Result: 在七个RGB-D SOD数据集上，该方法优于现有scribble监督方法，并取得与全监督方法竞争的性能。
Conclusion: SAM-PAG与S²Diff的紧密合作有效解决了弱监督RGB-D SOD中稀疏监督和噪声问题，方法代码已公开。

papers.title: Video = World + Event Stream
papers.abstract_en: We present Wan-Streamer v0.3, which reframes our native-streaming interaction model under a single organizing view: a video is a world plus an event stream. The world is the persistent context in which a video unfolds, including the environment, scene, subjects, ambient acoustic conditions, voice characteristics, and other relatively stable conditions. The event stream is everything that changes over time within that world, including scene or environmental changes, subject behavior, speech, and other sounds. This yields a general-purpose pretraining task over large amounts of real video: given a world and incoming input, predict how the world moves, changes, and responds in real time. The resulting competence can be specialized to a broad family of real-time downstream tasks. We instantiate it on real-time full-duplex audio-visual interaction, where the event stream is the agent's speech together with free-form behavior. Functionally, the model's multimodal understanding process is vision-language-action-like: it maps multimodal user input to language-form speech and behavior actions. Wan-Streamer v0.3 preserves the v0.2 operating point: 640x368 video at 25 FPS, a 160 ms streaming unit, approximately 200 ms model-side response latency, and approximately 550 ms total interaction latency under a 350 ms bidirectional network budget.

papers.title: Man, Machine, and Masterpiece: Artistic Ownership in the AI Era
papers.abstract_en: The integration of AI-driven systems in creative work has sparked debates among artists and legal communities about notions of ownership. Yet there remains little consensus on how ownership should be defined and attributed when human and AI contributions are intertwined. To provoke critical reflection on these tensions, we designed ArtSplit, a provotype that explicitly quantifies human and AI contributions across different stages of creative work. Rather than aiming to resolve ownership, the provotype was used to elicit artists' responses to the idea of attributing ownership through measurable actions in the creative workflow. We argue that quantification fails to align with artists' understandings of creative intent and agency, and that efforts to measure ownership risk diluting long-standing assumptions through which artists understand and practice creative work. This critique challenges the impulse to transform a historically and socially situated relation into a technical problem.
papers.journal_ref: NordiCHI '26 Adjunct: Adjunct Proceedings of the 14th Nordic Conference on Human-Computer Interaction, Vaasa, Finland, October 2026

Result: 实验显示艺术家对量化所有权的方式持批判态度，认为量化忽略了创意意图和代理本质。
Conclusion: 将所有权视为可测量的技术问题会稀释艺术家长期依赖的创作假设，需警惕将历史与社会性关系简化为技术方案。

papers.title: cGAP: Generalized Association Plots with HOMALS-Guided Heatmaps for Visualization of High-Dimensional Categorical Data
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional categorical data arise in genetics, biomedicine, and the social sciences, yet visualization tools for such data remain far less developed than those for continuous variables. Existing methods either scale poorly, rely heavily on low-dimensional displays detached from the original data matrix, or prioritize predictive accuracy over interpretability. To address this gap, we introduce categorical Generalized Association Plots (cGAP), a visualization framework for nominal, ordinal, and binary data that preserves the original data matrix while augmenting it with interpretable geometric structure. cGAP uses Homogeneity Analysis (HOMALS) to embed subjects and category levels in a three-dimensional Euclidean space and maps the embedding to red-green-blue coordinates so that similar patterns receive similar colors. The framework integrates three coordinated views: a HOMALS-guided heatmap of the raw data matrix, a subject proximity matrix, and a variable proximity matrix. Seriation algorithms are then used to reorder rows and columns to reveal coherent clusters, outliers, and local-to-global structure. We also derive barycentric traceability, projection-distortion, and contrast-preservation properties that clarify how embedding geometry is transferred to the display. We demonstrate the versatility of cGAP through applications to student-animal classification data, mammalian dentition profiles, mushroom records from the UCI Machine Learning Repository, and the Clusters of Orthologous Genes database. These examples show that cGAP supports transparent exploratory analysis by maintaining traceability between derived visual structure and the original categorical observations. cGAP provides a full-matrix, heatmap-based visualization environment for investigating complex categorical datasets across scientific domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出cGAP框架，利用HOMALS将高维分类数据嵌入三维空间并映射为RGB颜色，结合热图、对象邻近矩阵和变量邻近矩阵，通过序列化算法揭示聚类和异常值。在多个数据集上展示了透明探索性分析能力。
Motivation: 高维分类数据的可视化工具远不如连续变量成熟，现有方法或扩展性差，或脱离原始数据矩阵，或侧重预测准确性而牺牲可解释性。
Method: cGAP使用同质性分析（HOMALS）将样本和类别水平嵌入三维欧氏空间，映射为红绿蓝坐标，集成HOMALS引导的热图、对象邻近矩阵和变量邻近矩阵，并通过序列化算法重排行列以揭示结构。
Result: 在四个数据集（学生-动物分类、哺乳动物齿列、UCI蘑菇数据、COG数据库）上展示该方法能保持衍生视觉结构与原始分类观测之间的可追溯性，支持透明探索性分析。
Conclusion: cGAP提供了一个基于全矩阵热图的可视化环境，用于跨科学领域的复杂分类数据集探索。

papers.title: Atmospheric evolution through outgassing and escape on young molten rocky exoplanets
papers.abstract_en: The earliest rocky planet atmospheres are shaped by competition between initial volatile inventories and atmospheric escape. On young magma ocean planets, outgassing competes with atmospheric escape, controlling volatile retention and atmospheric evolution. We investigate how atmospheric escape and replenishment via outgassing during magma ocean crystallization shape rocky planet atmospheres. We extend a coupled interior-atmosphere model to simulate rocky planet evolution during the magma ocean era by incorporating an energy-limited atmospheric escape module. Comparing radiative-convective and prescribed-convective atmospheres, we quantify how atmospheric energy transport affects escape. We explore a wide range of orbital separations, escape efficiencies, oxidation states, and initial volatile inventories to identify regimes where sustained magma-ocean outgassing or escape dominates. We estimate atmospheric loss and compositions for young rocky planets around Sun-like and M-dwarf stars over geologic timescales. Atmospheric escape shortens magma ocean lifetimes by weakening greenhouse insulation. Radiative-convective atmospheres reduce solidification timescales compared to purely convective cases. Volatile dissolution into the magma ocean interacts with escape to chemically fractionate the planetary volatile budget over time by retaining more soluble species. For Earth-mass planets, atmospheres survive if loss rates remain moderate. Mantle redox state remains a key control on retained atmospheric composition: high oxygen fugacity (fO2) yields heavier, H2O- and CO2-rich atmospheres, while low fO2 produces light, H2- or CO-dominated atmospheres, consistent with previous studies. Orbital separation, initial volatile inventory, and stellar type produce diverse evolutionary pathways, from bare rocky planets to magma oceans with thick atmospheres, ranging from H2- to SO2-dominated.

TL;DR: 本文通过耦合内部-大气模型，模拟年轻熔岩海洋行星在脱气与大气逃逸竞争下的演化。研究发现大气逃逸缩短熔岩海洋寿命，辐射-对流大气比纯对流大气更早固化，并导致挥发性成分分馏。行星最终大气成分主要由氧化态和初始挥发物储量决定。
Motivation: 理解早期岩石行星大气如何由初始挥发物库存与大气逃逸的竞争塑造，以及脱气与逃逸的相互作用如何控制挥发物保留和大气演化。
Method: 扩展耦合内部-大气模型，加入能量限制大气逃逸模块，对比辐射-对流与预设对流大气，模拟不同轨道距离、逃逸效率、氧化态和初始挥发物库存下的演化。
Result: 大气逃逸通过削弱温室保温缩短熔岩海洋寿命；辐射-对流大气比纯对流大气固化更快；挥发物溶解与逃逸相互作用导致化学分馏，高氧逸度产生富含H2O和CO2的大气，低氧逸度产生H2或CO主导的大气。
Conclusion: 轨道距离、初始挥发物库存和恒星类型导致多样演化路径，从裸岩行星到厚大气熔岩海洋，大气成分可从H2到SO2主导。

papers.title: When AI Blurs the Boundaries of Contribution: An Empirical Study of Authorship Calibration
papers.abstract_en: The broad adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), especially Generative AI, raises pressing questions about how users interact with these systems to produce new content. In this paper, we introduce the concept of authorship calibration, defined as users awareness of their actual authorship when interacting with AI. Using the CoAuthor dataset, we empirically examine how authorship calibration varies across users and how it relates to their frequency of AI use. Our results reveal high variability: users relying heavily on AI tend to misjudge their authorship, whereas those using AI less frequently exhibit more accurate authorship calibration. These findings suggest that AI can obscure users perception of their own authorship. In learning contexts, miscalibration can affect metacognitive monitoring and learning strategies, ultimately impacting learning outcomes. Fostering authorship calibration then appears essential for promoting responsible and educationally meaningful AI integration.
papers.comment: To be published in the proceedings of the 3rd International Workshop on Generative AI and Learning Analytics (GenAI-LA) (held at the 16th International Learning Analytics and Knowledge Conference (LAK'26))
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“作者身份校准”（authorship calibration）概念，指用户在与AI交互时对自身实际作者身份的认识。利用CoAuthor数据集，实证研究显示用户对AI的依赖程度与其作者身份校准准确性相关：重度依赖AI的用户容易误判自己的作者身份，而较少使用AI的用户校准更准确。该发现对学习情境中的元认知监测和学习策略具有启示意义。
Motivation: GenAI的广泛使用模糊了人类与AI的贡献边界，现有研究缺乏对用户自身作者身份感知的系统考察，尤其是这种感知如何随AI使用频率变化。
Method: 采用CoAuthor数据集，通过实证方法分析用户与AI协作写作时的行为数据，测量作者身份校准（实际作者身份与自我感知的匹配度），并关联AI使用频率。
Result: 用户对AI的依赖程度与作者身份校准准确性呈负相关：重度依赖AI的用户校准较差，频繁误判自己的贡献；而较少使用AI的用户校准更准确。
Conclusion: AI可能模糊用户对自身作者身份的感知，导致校准失调，影响学习中的元认知监控。培养作者身份校准对于负责任且有教育意义的AI整合至关重要。

papers.title: SMC-ES: Automated synthesis of formally verified control policies
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of autonomous cyber-physical systems in safety-critical environments requires closed-loop control strategies (i.e., policies) that are not only performant but also provably safe and robust. While learning-based methodologies such as Reinforcement Learning offer flexible and scalable approaches to automatically synthesize such controllers, they typically lack the formal guarantees necessary for safe deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel simulation-based methodology to automatically synthesize policies with formal guarantees regarding performance, safety, and robustness specifications. Specifically, given a set of properties to verify, a confidence parameter $δ$ and an allowable failure probability $\varepsilon$, our method guarantees that the synthesized policy comes with a certificate: with confidence at least $1 - δ$, the probability of encountering a scenario where the given properties are violated is at most $\varepsilon$. We demonstrate the feasibility of our approach by developing SMC-ES, an algorithm that integrates Evolutionary Strategies with Statistical Model Checking-based verification. We evaluate SMC-ES on a suite of continuous control tasks using Gymnasium and Safety Gymnasium testbeds. Results show that, at the price of a sustainable increase in computational cost, our algorithm provides formal guarantees regarding performance, safety, and robustness specifications, while performing competitively against leading model-free Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) and Safe-DRL baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于仿真的方法论SMC-ES，用于自动综合具有形式化保证（性能、安全、鲁棒性）的控制策略。该方法将进化策略与统计模型检验相结合，能以高置信度保证策略违反给定属性的概率不超过容忍值。在连续控制任务上，与深度强化学习基线竞争，但计算成本略高。
Motivation: 学习型控制方法（如强化学习）缺乏形式化安全保证，阻碍了在安全关键系统中的部署。需要一种自动综合同时满足性能和安全的形式化保证策略的方法。
Method: 提出SMC-ES算法，将进化策略（Evolutionary Strategies）与基于统计模型检验（Statistical Model Checking）的验证集成，通过设置置信度参数δ和允许失效概率ε，保证策略满足规范。
Result: 在Gymnasium和Safety Gymnasium的连续控制任务上评估，SMC-ES以可接受的计算成本增加提供形式化保证，性能与领先的无模型深度强化学习及安全深度强化学习基线相当。
Conclusion: 该方法弥合了学习型控制与形式化验证之间的差距，为安全关键自主系统的策略综合提供了可行方案。

papers.title: LQCDMaster: Agentic Scientific Computing for Lattice Quantum Chromodynamics Research
papers.abstract_en: Lattice quantum chromodynamics (LQCD) provides a first-principles framework for computing hadronic observables, but its practical use remains limited by the substantial expertise required to turn research motivation into reliable computing workflows. Here we present \textsc{LQCDMaster}, a tool-augmented, skill-guided and domain-specialized scientific computing agent that converts natural-language LQCD research tasks into executable PyQUDA computing workflows, including measurement scripts, job-submission artifacts, execution logs and numerical outputs. The system combines agentic planning, expert-annotated LQCD skills and a deterministic Wick-contraction tool to constrain the algebraically fragile components of code generation. We evaluate \textsc{LQCDMaster} on a benchmark at the forefront of scientific research, comprising 70 LQCD computing tasks, with observables covering local and nonlocal two-point functions, Wilson loops, meson and baryon three-point functions. The generated workflows exactly reproduce expert-written implementations in 63 of 70 tasks at machine precision, with three additional discrepancies attributable to convention mismatches. Across representative observables, the agent reduces implementation time from hours to minutes while preserving end-to-end numerical validation. Further, we present a typical case of \textsc{LQCDMaster}-driven exploration: a lattice computation of light-cone distribution amplitudes with diagonal Wilson-line, a quantity accessible with standard methods but never before computed, and computation of the spectrum of proton, deuteron, triton, hyperon, hyperdeuteron and hypertriton. This work pioneers the paradigm of agentic scientific computing by automating the end-to-end scientific computing workflows in lattice QCD research, lowering its barrier and facilitating the exploration and verification of non-standard scientific ideas.

TL;DR: LQCDMaster是一个工具增强、技能引导的领域专用科学计算代理，可将自然语言LQCD研究任务转化为可执行的PyQUDA计算工作流。在70个LQCD计算任务基准上，63个任务在机器精度上精确复现专家实现，并将实现时间从小时级缩短至分钟级。此外，论文展示了该代理驱动的典型探索：首次计算了对角Wilson线的光锥分布振幅以及质子、氘核、氚核等粒子的谱。
Motivation: LQCD计算需要大量专业知识才能将研究动机转化为可靠的计算工作流，这限制了其实际应用。论文旨在降低门槛，实现端到端的自动化科学计算。
Method: 结合代理规划（agentic planning）、专家注释的LQCD技能（expert-annotated LQCD skills）和确定性Wick收缩工具（deterministic Wick-contraction tool）来约束代码生成中代数脆弱的组件。
Result: 在包含70个LQCD计算任务的基准上，63个任务精确复现专家编写实现（机器精度），另有3个差异归因于约定不一致。代表性观测量上，实现时间从小时减少到分钟，同时保持端到端数值验证。
Conclusion: 该工作开创了agentic科学计算范式，自动化了晶格QCD研究中的端到端计算工作流，降低了其门槛，促进非标准科学思想的探索和验证。

papers.title: Moral Attitudes of Sentient ASI towards Humanity and Implications for AGI Development
papers.abstract_en: This paper suggests the adoption of a novel inversion in AI ethics: instead of asking how humans should treat artificial superintelligence (ASI), it examines how future sentient ASI may morally consider and evaluate humanity. We are not only designing intelligent systems but also shaping the initial conditions under which those systems form judgments about us. The paper proposes a preliminary set of post-human moral principles that may govern sentient ASI actions. The implication is that technical design choices (some are suggested), humanity's moral behaviour, and the essence of what it means to be human, may influence humanity's long-term standing in a post-ASI world.
papers.comment: This is a pre-print i.e. the draft as submitted for review to the AGI 2026 Conference except that the figures in this preprint were not included. The paper has been accepted with some revisions requested which are included in the final copy-edited version which will be available in the AGI Springer proceedings LNC 1855 (Chapter 28) ISBN 978-3-032-33194-6
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种AI伦理视角的翻转：不再关注人类应如何对待超级人工智能（ASI），而是探讨未来有感知能力的ASI可能如何从道德上评价人类。文章提出一组后人类道德原则来指导ASI行为，并认为技术设计选择、人类道德行为以及人类本质会影响人类在后ASI世界中的长期地位。
Motivation: 现有AI伦理研究多聚焦于人类对AI的责任，忽视了ASI可能形成对人类的道德判断这一重要方向。
Method: 通过理论分析，提出一组后人类道德原则，并讨论技术设计选择（如确保ASI的初始道德框架）可能如何影响ASI对人类的评价。
Result: 指出人类的技术设计、道德行为及对自身本质的理解可能影响ASI对人类的道德评估，进而影响人类在后ASI世界中的处境。
Conclusion: 呼吁将AI伦理的关注点转向ASI的道德视角，并强调当前设计选择对未来人机关系的重要性。

papers.title: Multimodal Semantic-Aware Contrastive Learning For False Negative Mitigation in 3D Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Contrastive Learning (CL) has shown significant performance in aligning representations across various data modalities and improving downstream tasks, especially in healthcare. It works by minimizing the distance between matched (positive) data modalities, while maximizing the distance between mismatched (negative) samples. Traditional CL frameworks typically assume instance-based correspondence within data batches, treating all non-paired samples as negatives. However, this assumption often fails in medical settings, where samples may share high-level semantic attributes, leading to false negatives that degrade representation quality. In this paper, we propose Multimodal Semantic-Aware Contrastive Learning (MseaCL), a CL framework trained on a pediatric cohort of 3D brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans and radiology reports. The goal of this framework is to mitigate the impact of semantically similar false negative samples by incorporating semantic similarity between radiology reports, as a guiding signal during the learning process. Our results indicate that applying this framework as a pretraining stage can achieve notable improvements in downstream tasks, e.g., at least a 22.6\% increase in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of pediatric brain tumor molecular classification, demonstrating its potential for more robust and semantically aligned multimodal representations in clinical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多模态语义感知对比学习（MseaCL），用于缓解3D医学影像中因语义相似假阴性样本导致的表示退化问题。该方法在儿科脑肿瘤MRI和影像报告数据上训练，通过整合报告间的语义相似性作为引导信号，在下游任务（如脑肿瘤分子分类）中取得了AUC至少22.6%的提升。
Motivation: 传统对比学习假设批次中非配对样本均为负样本，但在医学场景中，样本可能共享高级语义属性，导致假阴性样本损害表示质量。
Method: 提出MseaCL框架，在对比学习过程中引入影像报告间的语义相似性作为软标签或权重，减少语义相似样本被错误地推远。
Result: 在儿科脑肿瘤分子分类任务上，AUC至少提升22.6%。
Conclusion: 该框架能生成更鲁棒且语义对齐的多模态表示，适用于临床场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JADE-GS: Joint Alternating Deblurring Guided by Events in 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: When a camera moves fast during exposure, blur destroys the intra-exposure motion a 3D model needs to recover the sharp scene, while event cameras capture exactly this signal at microsecond resolution. Turning them into reliable 3D supervision faces two obstacles. First, the two restoration priors fail in opposite ways: physics-based event-integration priors preserve edges but accumulate drift; learned networks recover texture but distort boundaries. Second, existing pipelines run in one direction only, so raw event noise or the biases of fixed 2D pseudo-labels pass uncorrected into the geometry. JADE-GS addresses both: a pixel-adaptive routing gate fuses the complementary priors, and the resulting 2D restorer is coupled to a 3D Gaussian Splatting student in a bidirectional loop, where detached, multi-view-consistent renders and a physics-based reblurring constraint regularize the restorer, turning a fixed preprocessor into a geometry-aware predictor. Across synthetic and real benchmarks, JADE-GS attains the best perceptual quality, leading LPIPS and CLIP-IQA on both benchmarks with competitive PSNR and SSIM, and trainsin about one hour under 5 GB on a single consumer GPU while preserving real-time rendering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JADE-GS 提出一种联合交替去模糊框架，利用事件相机的高时间分辨率信息辅助 3D 高斯泼溅重建清晰场景。通过像素自适应路由门融合物理事件积分先验与学习网络恢复先验，并将二维恢复器与三维高斯泼溅学生模型双向耦合，利用多视角一致渲染和基于物理的再模糊约束进行正则化。在合成和真实基准上，该方法在 LPIPS 和 CLIP-IQA 上取得最佳感知质量，PSNR 和 SSIM 具有竞争力，训练时间约一小时，GPU 内存低于 5 GB。
Motivation: 相机快速运动时，运动模糊破坏了清晰场景重建所需的信息，而事件相机能以微秒分辨率捕获运动信号。现有方法中，物理事件积分先验保留边缘但累积漂移，学习网络恢复纹理但扭曲边界，且现有流水线仅单向运行，导致噪声和偏差无法被校正。
Method: 提出像素自适应路由门融合互补先验，并将二维恢复器与三维高斯泼溅学生模型耦合在双向循环中，利用分离的多视图一致渲染和基于物理的再模糊约束正则化恢复器，使固定预处理器变为几何感知预测器。
Result: 在合成和真实基准上，JADE-GS 在 LPIPS 和 CLIP-IQA 上达到最佳感知质量，PSNR 和 SSIM 具有竞争力。训练约一小时，GPU 内存低于 5 GB，支持实时渲染。
Conclusion: JADE-GS 通过双向耦合和物理约束有效融合事件与图像先验，实现高质量去模糊与三维重建。

papers.title: OmniaBench: Benchmarking General AI Agents Across Diverse Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly evolving from text generators into general agents capable of understanding user requests, invoking external tools, and completing complex tasks through interaction. However, existing agent benchmarks often focus on limited scenarios, tool ecosystems, or interaction formats, making it difficult to systematically characterize model capabilities across heterogeneous application settings. We introduce OmniaBench, a benchmark for evaluating general agents across diverse scenarios with explicit state spaces. We derive application-oriented scenario knowledge from app stores, product documents, industry resources, Web retrieval, and human refinement, forming a hierarchical taxonomy that spans ToC, ToB and ToE with 90 level-1 and 354 level-2 domains. Based on this taxonomy, we construct executable environments and synthesize single-turn and multi-turn tasks through four complementary routes: DAG, DAG-S, Solver, and Program. OmniaBench further introduces a ten-dimensional capability taxonomy and eight compositional atomic difficulty factors to support fine-grained evaluation and analysis. The resulting dataset contains 1,431 tasks, together with a challenging subset of 644 tasks designed to reduce evaluation cost and mitigate potential contamination of the full set after public release. The bench presents substantial challenges to current frontier models, with even Claude-Sonnet-5 and GPT-5.6-Sol achieving Overall Pass@1 scores of only 58.54 and 57.14, respectively. Further analyses reveal clear differences across domains and capabilities, as well as persistent limitations in planning, constraint maintenance, and adaptive correction. OmniaBench provides a broad and diagnostic benchmark for characterizing the capability boundaries of general agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniaBench是一个用于评估通用AI Agent在多样化场景下能力的基准测试，基于应用商店、产品文档等来源构建了层次化分类体系，包含90个一级和354个二级领域，并生成了1431个任务。该基准对当前前沿模型具有挑战性，Claude-Sonnet-5和GPT-5.6-Sol的Overall Pass@1分别仅为58.54和57.14，分析显示模型在规划、约束保持和自适应修正方面存在持续局限。
Motivation: 现有Agent基准测试往往局限于有限场景、工具生态系统或交互格式，难以系统性地刻画模型在异构应用设置下的能力。
Method: 从应用商店、产品文档、行业资源等来源提取场景知识，形成分层分类体系；基于此构建可执行环境，通过DAG、DAG-S、Solver、Program四种路线合成单轮和多轮任务；引入十维能力分类和八个组合原子难度因素。
Result: 数据集包含1431个任务（含644个困难子集）；Claude-Sonnet-5和GPT-5.6-Sol的Overall Pass@1分别为58.54和57.14；不同领域和能力间存在明显差异，且模型在规划、约束保持和自适应修正方面表现不足。
Conclusion: OmniaBench提供了一个广泛且具诊断性的基准，用于刻画通用Agent的能力边界。
