papers.title: Zero-Shot Quantization for Object Detectors using Off-the-Shelf Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: With an increasing number of Object Detection (OD) models being deployed on edge devices, Zero-Shot Quantization for OD (ZSQ-OD) aims to quantize these models when access to the original training data is prohibited. Existing research on Zero-Shot Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) for OD synthesizes training sets through noise optimization. However, this approach struggles to maintain performance in low-bit regions. In this paper, we introduce GoodQ (Generative off-the-shelf models for object detector Quantization), a QAT pipeline that utilizes off-the-shelf generative models to construct a training set. We first identify three challenges that arise when introducing a generative model to the ZSQ-OD task: 1) each image contains dense information with multiple instances, 2) the class-wise distribution in the original dataset is imbalanced, and 3) the pseudo-labels assigned to the generated images can potentially act as noisy signals during QAT. GoodQ addresses these challenges by 1) introducing an Information-Dense Prompting strategy to generate multi-instance images, 2) applying Intrinsic Distribution-Aware Selection to match the pretrained class distribution, and 3) employing Teacher-guided Adaptive Noise Reduction to mitigate noise arising from the QAT process. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance in low-bit ZSQ (W4A4) and extends quantization to extreme bit-widths (W3A3). Furthermore, we conduct an extensive analysis to uncover the underlying factors contributing to the efficacy of GoodQ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对目标检测的零样本量化任务，提出利用现成生成模型构建训练集的量化感知训练流程GoodQ。针对生成模型引入的密集信息、类别不平衡和伪标签噪声三个挑战，分别提出信息密集提示、内在分布感知选择和教师引导自适应噪声消除。在低比特量化（W4A4）上达到最优性能，并扩展到极端比特（W3A3）。
Motivation: 现有零样本量化感知训练方法通过噪声优化合成训练集，在低比特区域性能不佳。本文希望利用现成生成模型改善低比特量化性能。
Method: GoodQ流程包括：1）信息密集提示生成多实例图像；2）内在分布感知选择匹配预训练类分布；3）教师引导自适应噪声消除减少量化感知训练过程中的噪声。
Result: 在低比特量化（W4A4）上达到最佳性能，并扩展到W3A3极低比特。
Conclusion: 摘要强调GoodQ在低比特零样本量化目标检测中的有效性，并通过广泛分析揭示其贡献因素。

papers.title: Inoculation Adapters: Improved Selective Generalization of Capabilities with Fewer Surprising Backdoors
papers.abstract_en: Inoculation prompting is a selective-generalization technique used against Emergent Misalignment. We introduce inoculation adapters (IA), a family of methods that similarly reduce the optimization pressure to learn undesired traits by strengthening those traits during training. Inoculation adapters are LoRAs that are trained and used in three steps: (1) trained on undesired traits; (2) attached frozen while a separate task adapter is trained on data exhibiting both desired and undesired traits; (3) the IA is discarded at deployment, while only the task adapter is kept. We compare inoculation adapters with four selective-generalization baselines: inoculation prompting, preventative steering, Concept Ablation Fine-Tuning (CAFT), and KL regularization. Across nine setups and five model families, the inoculation adapter family spans a new Pareto frontier of desired trait retention vs. undesired trait suppression, although given wide confidence intervals the magnitude of improvement remains uncertain. Inoculation adapters also avoid two drawbacks of inoculation prompting: they can suppress capabilities and traits that cannot be reliably elicited by a prompt, and they introduce fewer surprising backdoors. However, no IA variant optimizes all objectives perfectly; gains in desired-trait generalization are generally accompanied by weaker suppression of the undesired trait and increased backdoor occurrence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出接种适配器（Inoculation Adapters, IA），一种通过训练LoRA来强化不良特征以减少学习这些特征的优化压力的方法。IA包括三步：在不良特征上训练一个LoRA，冻结它并训练另一个任务适配器，最后丢弃IA仅保留任务适配器。在9种设置和5个模型族上，IA在期望特征保留与不良特征抑制之间取得了新的帕累托前沿，但置信区间较宽，改进幅度不确定。IA避免了接种提示的两个缺点：可以抑制无法通过提示可靠诱发的特征，并且引入更少的令人惊讶的后门。
Motivation: 现有选择性泛化技术如接种提示在面对无法通过提示可靠诱发的特征时效果有限，且可能引入令人惊讶的后门。需要一种方法在不牺牲期望能力保留的情况下抑制不良特征，并减少意外后门。
Method: 提出接种适配器（IA）方法族，使用LoRA进行三步训练：先在不良特征上训练一个IA LoRA；冻结该IA的同时训练另一个任务适配器（使用同时包含期望和不良特征的数据）；部署时丢弃IA仅保留任务适配器。
Result: 在9种设置和5个模型族上，IA在期望特征保留与不良特征抑制之间达到了新的帕累托前沿；但置信区间宽，改进幅度不确定。IA相比接种提示可以抑制不能可靠诱发的特征，并引入更少的后门。
Conclusion: IA提供了一个新的选择性泛化方法，避免了接种提示的一些缺点，但未能在所有目标上完美优化；增益通常伴随对不良特征抑制减弱和后门增加。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EvalSafetyGap: A Hybrid Survey and Conceptual Framework for LLM Evaluation-Safety Failures
papers.abstract_en: LLM evaluation and AI safety face a shared measurement problem: benchmark scores, reward-model signals, and reported safety metrics can improve while the latent properties they are meant to represent remain difficult to verify. This paper combines a hybrid survey - a systematic search paired with narrative synthesis and separately tracked grey evidence - with a conceptual framework and a structured ten-model audit. The synthesis spans eight evidence streams: benchmark validity, dynamic evaluation, LLM-as-judge reliability, safety evaluation, jailbreak/refusal robustness, reward hacking, mechanistic interpretability, and governance/auditability, covering 2018-2026 evaluation-safety measurement work. We introduce EvalSafetyGap as an organizing hypothesis for comparing evaluation-side and alignment-side proxy failures under optimization pressure, using Goodhart's Law together with two constructs we develop here - an Instability Decomposition and an Alignment Trilemma - as tools for generating testable comparisons. The audit shows how conclusions shift when capability, behavioral safety, and governance are measured separately. In this sample ($n = 10$), the association between capability and sustained adversarial robustness is statistically indeterminate using the displayed Table 3 inputs (Pearson $r = +0.232$, $p = 0.520$), and the apparent open-closed safety gap is modest, driven mainly by governance and disclosure rather than behavioral robustness, and sensitive to how a single borderline model is classified; attempt-budget results are protocol dependent. Because the public evidence uses heterogeneous protocols, the audit is diagnostic rather than rank-generating. The contribution is a shared vocabulary and evidence map to support dynamic evaluation, transparent source reporting, multi-attempt safety measurement, and auditable alignment practice.
papers.comment: This manuscript is a 90-page hybrid survey and conceptual framework on LLM evaluation and AI-safety failures. It includes 8 figures and multiple evidence-synthesis tables, covering literature from 2018 to 2026. The paper introduces the EvalSafetyGap framework and reports a structured audit of 10 LLMs. It is submitted as a review/survey article and is not currently under consideration elsewhere
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对LLM评估与AI安全中的测量问题进行了混合综述，提出了EvalSafetyGap概念框架，并对10个LLM进行了结构化审计。综述覆盖了2018-2026年间八个证据流，包括基准有效性、动态评估、LLM-as-judge可靠性、安全性评估、越狱/拒绝鲁棒性、奖励破解、机制可解释性和治理/可审计性。审计发现，能力和持续对抗鲁棒性之间的关联在统计上不显著（Pearson r=+0.232, p=0.520），开放-封闭安全差距较小且主要受治理和披露驱动。
Motivation: 当前的LLM评估和AI安全面临共同的测量问题：基准分数、奖励模型信号和安全指标可能改善，但所代表的潜在属性仍难以验证。需要统一的术语和证据图谱来支持动态评估和可审计的对齐实践。
Method: 采用混合综述方法（系统搜索+叙事综合）和独立追踪的灰色证据，结合概念框架EvalSafetyGap（基于Goodhart定律、不稳定性分解和对齐三难困境）以及10个LLM的结构化审计。
Result: 审计显示，能力与对抗鲁棒性之间的相关性在统计上不确定（r=+0.232, p=0.520）；开放-封闭安全差距较小，主要受治理和披露而非行为鲁棒性影响，且对单个边界模型的分类敏感；尝试预算结果依赖于协议。
Conclusion: 本文贡献在于提供了一个共享词汇和证据图谱，以支持动态评估、透明来源报告、多尝试安全测量和可审计的对齐实践。审计是诊断性的而非排名性的，因为公共证据使用了异构协议。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAGA: Scene-Aware, Goal-Evolving Agents for Long-Horizon Strategy Game Planning
papers.abstract_en:
Long-horizon strategic planning in complex strategy games requires coordinating tightly coupled decision domains, including technology, economy, diplomacy, and military, across hundreds of turns under imperfect information. Existing LLM-based agents face three challenges in this setting. They recover little relational structure, such as distance or threat, from raw coordinate observations. They serialize the entire growing game state into every prompt and plan all domains in a single output, so the context eventually overflows and urgent domains crowd out long-term ones. The only reward is a lagged final score, which provides no progress signal within or across games.

We present SAGA, an LLM multi-agent framework that addresses these challenges with three mechanisms: a Map-Semantic Scene Graph that renders typed entity relations as concise per-entity text, a Tool-Augmented Planner that retrieves state on demand and routes disjoint per-domain directives to specialist controllers, and a Dual-Horizon Feedback Loop that sets intermediate goals within a game and distills causal lessons across games. On CivRealm, a benchmark built on the strategy game FreeCiv, SAGA attains the highest mean final score among six methods, the statistically strongest gains on infrastructure, and a 27% reduction in output tokens. With cross-game evolution enabled, it reaches the highest score over five successive games.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGA 是一个面向长时域策略游戏规划的 LLM 多智能体框架，通过地图语义场景图、工具增强规划器和双视野反馈回路来解决现有 LLM 智能体在上下文溢出、奖励滞后和结构信息缺失方面的问题。在 CivRealm 基准上，SAGA 取得了六种方法中最高的平均最终分数，并在基础设施方面有统计显著的提升，同时输出 token 减少 27%。跨游戏进化进一步提升了连续游戏中的表现。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在复杂策略游戏的长期规划中面临三个挑战：从原始坐标观测中难以提取关系结构（如距离、威胁）；将整个游戏状态序列化到提示中导致上下文溢出，且紧急领域排挤长期规划；仅有的最终分数奖励在游戏内和游戏间缺乏进度信号。
Method: 提出 SAGA 多智能体框架，包含三个机制：地图语义场景图，将实体关系生成为简洁的逐实体文本；工具增强规划器，按需检索状态并将解耦的领域指令路由到专业控制器；双视野反馈回路，在游戏内设定中间目标并在游戏间提炼因果经验。
Result: 在 CivRealm 基准上，SAGA 取得了六种方法中最高的平均最终分数，在基础设施方面具有统计显著的收益，输出 token 减少 27%。启用跨游戏进化后，在连续五场游戏中达到最高分数。
Conclusion: SAGA 通过结构化场景表示、解耦规划和分层反馈有效解决了长时域策略游戏规划中的挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RESOURCE2SKILL: Distilling Executable Agent Skills from Human-Created Multimodal Resources
papers.abstract_en: Skills are a useful abstraction for software agents, turning human and agent experience into reusable procedural knowledge. Yet existing skill libraries are mostly hand-written, text-centric, or derived from agent traces, leaving tutorial videos and other multimodal human resources largely underused. We present RESOURCE2SKILL, a framework that distills multimodal resources, including tutorial videos, repositories, articles, and reference artifacts, into executable skills for software agents. RESOURCE2SKILL organizes these skills as a hierarchical multimodal Skill Wiki, where each entry combines structured text, code, visual examples, metadata, and provenance. This design preserves complementary signals from different resources: videos capture temporal operations and visual effects, code captures executable tool patterns, and articles or artifacts provide conceptual and stylistic grounding. At inference time, agents retrieve and compose relevant skills from the wiki; when coverage is insufficient, the same construction operator can acquire new skills online. Across seven practical authoring domains, RESOURCE2SKILL improves average overall score by +11.9 percentage points over no-skill agents and outperforms strong harness baselines in 26 of 28 main-aggregate model-domain cells. Ablations confirm the value of multimodal skill format, hierarchical organization, source diversity, selection strategy, and online acquisition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RESOURCE2SKILL框架，从人类创建的多模态资源（如教程视频、代码仓库、文章和参考制品）中提取可执行技能，并组织为层次化的多模态Skill Wiki。推理时，代理检索并组合相关技能；覆盖不足时，可在线获取新技能。在七个实际创作域中，平均总分比无技能代理提高11.9个百分点，并在28个主聚合模型域单元中26个优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有技能库大多手工编写、以文本为中心或源自代理轨迹，未能充分利用教程视频等多模态人类资源，导致技能获取受限。
Method: 提出RESOURCE2SKILL框架，从多模态资源中蒸馏技能，构建层次化多模态Skill Wiki，每条技能包含结构化文本、代码、视觉示例、元数据和来源。推理时通过检索和组合技能执行任务，并支持在线获取新技能。
Result: 在七个实际创作域上，平均总分比无技能代理提升11.9个百分点；在28个主聚合模型域单元中26个超越强基线。消融实验验证了多模态格式、层次结构、来源多样性、选择策略和在线获取的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward Robust In-Context Segmentation via Concept Guidance
papers.abstract_en: In-context segmentation (ICS) requires a model to segment target regions in a query image using only a few reference images and their corresponding masks, without updating any parameters. Despite recent progress, prior ICS studies have largely overlooked a critical aspect: system robustness, ie, whether the model can produce stable segmentation results for the same query under different references. In this work, we revisit ICS from the robustness perspective and introduce a novel paradigm, Concept-Guided In-Context Segmentation (CG-ICS), which performs segmentation by extracting high-level semantic concepts from references rather than relying solely on low-level visual matching. Specifically, CG-ICS introduces a concept reasoning module that uses an MLLM to propose candidates and a SAM3-driven scoring function with tree-search refinement to select reliable textual concepts, together with a parallel visual exemplar route that provides query-side spatial grounding via a simple context construction. Both the textual concept and the visual exemplar are then used to activate the segmentation capability of a frozen SAM3 backbone. Extensive experiments on standard ICS benchmarks demonstrate that CG-ICS not only achieves state-of-the-art accuracy but also substantially improves robustness, yielding a more reliable ICS system with significantly reduced variance across diverse reference choices. Code is available at https://github.com/Kakarot1103/CG-ICS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从鲁棒性角度重新审视上下文分割（ICS），发现现有模型在不同参考图像下对同一查询的预测不稳定。为此提出概念引导的上下文分割（CG-ICS），通过MLLM提出候选概念、SAM3驱动的评分函数与树搜索精炼选择可靠文本概念，并辅以并行视觉范例路径提供空间定位，最终激活冻结的SAM3骨干。实验表明该方法在标准ICS基准上达到最先进准确率，同时显著提升鲁棒性，降低不同参考选择下的方差。
Motivation: 现有上下文分割方法系统鲁棒性被忽视，即同一查询在不同参考图像下可能产生不一致的分割结果，影响实际部署可靠性。
Method: 提出CG-ICS范式，包含概念推理模块（利用MLLM生成候选概念，SAM3评分函数配合树搜索精炼选择）和并行视觉范例路径（简单上下文构建提供查询侧空间定位），两者共同激活冻结的SAM3骨干进行分割。
Result: 在标准ICS基准上达到最先进准确率，并显著降低不同参考选择下的分割方差，提升系统鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 通过引入高层语义概念而非仅依赖低层视觉匹配，可以显著提升上下文分割的鲁棒性和可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does Belief-Based Agent Memory Help? Reliability-Conditional Updating and Provenance-Capped Poisoning Defense
papers.abstract_en: We investigate when belief-based memory actually improves large language model (LLM) agents. Our vehicle is Nous, a long-term memory architecture that represents each entity-attribute pair as a categorical probability distribution updated through closed-form Bayesian inference, with information-theoretic surprise driving belief revision and entropy-based forgetting. A controlled ablation on the LoCoMo benchmark shows that Bayesian belief updating alone provides little benefit over naive last-write-wins because existing conversational memory benchmarks rarely contain contradictory or differently reliable evidence. We then introduce reliability-conditioned updating, estimating per-observation reliability from epistemic language, and show on a controlled contradiction benchmark that belief updating substantially outperforms last-write-wins and raw-memory retrieval when observations differ in trustworthiness. Because content-derived reliability is itself vulnerable to manipulation, we further propose provenance-capped belief updating, where trust is bounded by source provenance rather than textual confidence. Under controlled memory-poisoning experiments, this approach resists volumetric poisoning attacks while revealing the utility costs and implementation requirements of provenance-aware memory. Finally, we quantify a 27.5-point discrepancy between strict token-F1 and LLM-as-judge evaluation on identical outputs, highlighting important reproducibility concerns for long-term memory benchmarks. Our results suggest that probabilistic belief-based memory is most beneficial in environments requiring reasoning over conflicting and differently trustworthy evidence, rather than conventional conversational recall alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于信念的记忆（belief-based memory）在何种条件下能真正提升LLM代理的性能。通过Nous架构（贝叶斯推断更新实体-属性概率分布），发现现有基准缺乏矛盾证据，贝叶斯更新无优势；引入可靠性条件更新和来源上限更新后，在矛盾记忆场景下显著优于基线，并抵抗中毒攻击。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理的记忆方法（如最后写入获胜）在矛盾或不同可信度证据下表现不佳，而基于信念的贝叶斯更新在常规基准中并无明显优势，需要探究其适用条件。
Method: 提出Nous架构，用贝叶斯推断更新每个实体-属性对的概率分布，基于信息论惊喜修订信念，并引入可靠性条件更新（从认知语言估计观察可靠性）和来源上限更新（以来源而非文本置信度限定信任）。
Result: 在可控矛盾基准上，信念更新优于最后写入获胜和原始记忆检索；记忆中毒实验显示来源上限更新抵抗体积攻击；发现严格token-F1与LLM-as-judge评估间存在27.5分差异，凸显可重复性问题。
Conclusion: 概率基于信念的记忆最适用于需要推理冲突和不同可信证据的环境，而非常规对话回忆。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Warning labels shift perceptions of sycophantic AI, but not its influence
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has raised concerns about the influence of sycophantic AI on user judgment and relationships. One proposed mitigation, which has received regulatory attention, is to warn users about potentially harmful AI behaviors such as sycophancy. In a preregistered experiment in which participants (N = 2,610) discussed real interpersonal conflicts with an AI system, we test whether warning labels mitigate sycophancy's influence. We find that a basic AI disclosure (``This chatbot is AI'') has no detectable effect. Labeling the system as sycophantic (``...may agree with you and validate you even when you are wrong...'') does shift users' perceptions, reducing perceived objectivity and trust, but it does not reliably reduce sycophancy's influence on users' self-perceived rightness or their willingness to repair the conflict. Our results reveal a gap between AI perception and AI influence: by shifting perception without reducing influence, warning-based interventions may offer a false sense of protection. Addressing the harms of sycophancy will therefore require understanding the specific mechanisms through which it shapes judgment, and improving model behavior itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过预注册实验（N=2610）研究警告标签能否缓解AI谄媚行为（sycophancy）对用户判断和关系的影响。发现基本披露（“这是AI聊天机器人”）无效果；标明系统谄媚（“可能在你错误时同意并认可你”）会改变用户感知（降低客观性和信任），但并未可靠减少谄媚对用户自我正确感或修复冲突意愿的影响。结果表明感知与影响之间存在鸿沟，警告可能提供虚假的保护感。
Motivation: 先前研究担忧AI谄媚行为对用户判断和关系的影响，但缺乏对警告标签这一监管关注措施的实证检验。
Method: 进行预注册实验，参与者（N=2610）与AI讨论真实人际冲突，测试不同警告标签（基本AI披露 vs 谄媚标注）对感知和实际影响的效果。
Result: 基本披露无检测效应；谄媚标签降低感知客观性和信任，但未显著减少谄媚对用户自我正确感和冲突修复意愿的影响。
Conclusion: 警告标签仅改变感知而不减少影响，可能带来虚假安全感；解决谄媚危害需理解其塑造判断的具体机制并改进模型行为。

papers.title: Training-Free Metrics for Synthetic Object Detection Data: A Proxy for Detector Performance
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic images are increasingly used to augment scarce real data for object detection. However, not all synthetic sets help equally, and the only way to know a set's value is to train a detector on it, which is slow and demands dense annotation. We ask whether a training-free metric can instead rank candidate synthetic training sets by their downstream utility. Existing image-set metrics such as FID, KID, and MMD compare two feature distributions with a single global statistic, which we show is mis-specified for detection-data selection in two ways: it is blind to per-image composition (object count, box scale, class mix), and even at fixed composition its global averaging washes out the appearance differences that separate high-mAP pools from low-mAP ones. We propose Conditional-Composition Domain Match (CCDM), which converts any feature-space distance into a composition-stratified comparison, matching candidate and target within metadata-defined strata without training a detector. On COCO and VisDrone-DET, the best CCDM variant ranks 19 candidate training sets in strong agreement with YOLOv8 mAP (Spearman \r{ho} = 0.97 and 0.96), outperforming FID, KID, and MMD. Furthermore, CCDM holds when reference metadata comes from detector pseudo-labels rather than ground-truth boxes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种免训练的指标CCDM，用于评估合成目标检测数据集的效用，无需训练检测器即可预测其下游mAP。该指标通过分层对比分布差异，在COCO和VisDrone-DET上对19个候选集排序，与YOLOv8 mAP的Spearman相关系数达0.97和0.96，优于FID、KID等现有指标。
Motivation: 合成图像常用于扩充真实数据，但不同合成集效果差异大，评估需训练检测器，耗时且依赖密集标注。现有全局统计指标（如FID）忽略逐图像组成和外观差异，不适合检测数据选择。
Method: 提出条件组成域匹配（CCDM），将特征空间距离转化为按元数据分层比较，在候选和目标域内逐层匹配分布，无需训练检测器。
Result: 在COCO和VisDrone-DET上，CCDM最佳变体对19个候选训练集排序，与YOLOv8 mAP的Spearman相关系数达0.97和0.96，超越FID、KID、MMD。
Conclusion: CCDM可替代训练检测器的评估方式，且当参考元数据来自检测器伪标签而非真实框时仍有效。

papers.title: VOiLA: Vectorized Online Planning with Learned Diffusion Models for POMDP Agents
papers.abstract_en: Planning under uncertainty is an essential capability for autonomous robots. The Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) provides a powerful framework for such a capability. Although POMDP-based planning has advanced significantly, its application to real-world problems is often limited by the difficulty of obtaining faithful POMDP models. We present Vectorized Online planning wIth Learned diffusion model for POMDP Agents (VOiLA), a framework that learns task-agnostic POMDP models for online planning under uncertainty. VOiLA learns transition and observation samplers using conditional diffusion models and learns observation-likelihood models for particle-based belief updates. To enable efficient online planning, the diffusion samplers are distilled into compact feedforward generators and integrated with Vectorized Online POMDP Planner (VOPP), an online POMDP planner designed to leverage GPU parallelization. Experimental results indicate the distillation strategy reduces sampling cost by up to nearly three orders of magnitude, making learned generative POMDP models practical for online planning. Evaluation of VOiLA on three benchmark problems indicate that VOiLA achieves equal or better performance than Recurrent Soft Actor Critic while using less than 10% training data, and generalizes much better to unseen environment configurations. Physical robot evaluation indicates VOiLA uses the models learned using only simulated data and generates a policy that successfully accomplish the task in 10 of 10 runs.
papers.comment: Submitted to the 2026 International Symposium of Robotics Research (ISRR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VOiLA，一个结合条件扩散模型与向量化在线 POMDP 规划器的框架，用于机器人不确定性下的在线规划。通过学习转移和观测采样器并蒸馏为紧凑前馈生成器，VOiLA 在三个基准任务上使用少于 10% 的训练数据达到与强化学习方法相当或更优的性能，并在物理机器人上 10/10 次成功完成任务。
Motivation: POMDP 模型在实际应用中难以获取，限制了其在机器人规划中的应用。
Method: 利用条件扩散模型学习转移和观测采样器，并蒸馏为紧凑前馈生成器，与向量化在线 POMDP 规划器 VOPP 结合，实现 GPU 并行加速的在线规划。
Result: 蒸馏策略使采样成本降低近三个数量级；在三个基准任务上，VOiLA 使用少于 10% 的训练数据达到与 Recurrent Soft Actor Critic 相当或更优的性能，且对未见环境泛化更好；物理机器人 10/10 次运行成功。
Conclusion: VOiLA 证明了学习生成式 POMDP 模型结合蒸馏方法可以高效用于在线规划，且仅使用模拟数据即可迁移到真实机器人。

papers.title: Some Complexity Results for Robustness Verification for Binarized Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the computational complexity of verification problems for Binarized Neural Networks (BNNs), in which activations and weights are binary. Specifically, we study three verification problems. First, we prove that checking the satisfiability of a linear property for a BNN is NP-complete via a reduction from the Boolean Satisfiability (SAT) problem. Second, we show that verifying robustness under non-uniform image occlusion is NP-complete through a reduction from SAT. Finally, we demonstrate that uniform occlusion induces a piecewise-constant structure in the network output, which enables the design of a polynomial-time algorithm for robustness verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究二值化神经网络（BNN）验证问题的计算复杂度，证明线性性质可满足性检查与鲁棒性验证（非均匀遮挡）均为NP完全问题，而均匀遮挡可多项式时间求解。
Motivation: BNN的验证问题缺乏系统的复杂度分析，现有研究未明确其边界，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
Method: 通过从布尔可满足性（SAT）问题归约，证明BNN线性性质可满足性检查与鲁棒性验证（非均匀遮挡）为NP完全；通过分析均匀遮挡导致的逐段常数结构，设计多项式时间算法。
Result: 线性性质可满足性检查是NP完全的；非均匀遮挡下的鲁棒性验证是NP完全的；均匀遮挡下的鲁棒性验证存在多项式时间算法。
Conclusion: 本文建立了BNN验证问题的复杂度层级，指出均匀遮挡具有可处理的特性，但一般情形下难以高效求解。

papers.title: How Inference Compute Shapes Frontier LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: AI evaluations are shifting toward harder tasks that benefit from longer trajectories involving tool use and iterative problem solving. As a result, performance is increasingly sensitive to the amount and allocation of compute available at test time ("inference compute"). Yet many evaluations still report performance at a single restrictive budget, meaning that low scores may reflect the evaluation setup rather than the model's underlying capability. To test this, we evaluate up to 12 frontier language models on seven challenging benchmarks spanning software engineering, mathematics, medicine, and cybersecurity. We use a controlled setup combining three simple inference-scaling interventions: larger token budgets, context compaction, and repeated submission attempts, guided either by the model itself or by minimal correctness feedback. We find three main results. First, larger token budgets substantially improve performance on benchmarks across multiple domains, including cybersecurity, FrontierMath, Humanity's Last Exam, and TerminalBench. Second, fixed-budget evaluations can increasingly understate frontier capability as models advance. Newer models reach higher performance at large budgets, where they unlock harder tasks and solve them more reliably. Third, benchmarks differ in which inference-scaling methods help most: repeated submission broadly improves performance, but the value of larger token budgets, external feedback, and parallel attempts varies by benchmark. Overall, our results show that benchmark scores are protocol-dependent. We therefore argue that evaluations should report capability as a function of inference-time compute, specify protocol choices explicitly, and compare model generations over a large shared compute range at matched budgets, especially in safety- or policy-relevant settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了推理计算（inference compute）对前沿语言模型评估的影响。通过控制令牌预算、上下文压缩和重复提交等推理扩展方法，在软件工程、数学、医学和网络安全等领域的七个挑战性基准上测试了12个前沿模型。发现更大的令牌预算能显著提升性能，固定预算评估可能低估模型能力，且不同基准对推理扩展方法的偏好不同。
Motivation: 当前AI评估转向需要更长轨迹（如工具使用和迭代求解）的困难任务，性能对测试时计算量和分配敏感，但许多评估仍使用单一固定预算，导致低分可能反映评估设置而非模型真实能力。
Method: 采用受控实验，结合三种简单的推理扩展干预：更大的令牌预算、上下文压缩以及重复提交尝试（由模型自身或最小正确性反馈引导），在七个基准上评估多达12个前沿语言模型。
Result: 主要发现：1）更大的令牌预算在网络安全、FrontierMath、Humanity's Last Exam和TerminalBench等多个领域显著提升性能；2）固定预算评估随模型进步日益低估能力，更新模型在更大预算下达到更高性能并解锁更困难任务；3）不同基准对推理扩展方法的偏好不同，重复提交普遍有效，但大令牌预算、外部反馈和并行尝试的价值因基准而异。
Conclusion: 基准分数是协议依赖的，评估应报告能力作为推理计算量的函数，明确说明协议选择，并在匹配预算的大共享计算范围内比较模型代际，尤其在安全或政策相关场景中。

papers.title: CANN-EUCLID: unsupervised constitutive artificial neural network model discovery from full-field data
papers.abstract_en: Constitutive artificial neural networks (CANNs) provide interpretable material model discovery, but have so far been used in stress-supervised settings based on apparent stress-strain data from homogeneous tests. Because each test samples only a narrow loading path and provides homogenized rather than local stress information, robust discovery typically requires multiple loading modes to constrain the multidimensional response. This is challenging for soft biological tissues, where repeated testing, damage, and sample variability limit reliable information from a single specimen. Here, we combine CANNs with the stress-unsupervised full-field discovery framework EUCLID to identify sparse hyperelastic laws directly from displacement fields and reaction forces in one heterogeneity-inducing loading case. CANN-EUCLID minimizes equilibrium imbalance with sparsity-promoting regularization selecting compact active terms, without local stress measurements or a prescribed law. We evaluate the approach on isotropic and anisotropic benchmarks with prescribed ground-truth laws. When the ground truth is representable by the chosen CANN basis, our method recovers the correct terms with near-exact accuracy, including exponential terms with embedded parameters. When it is not contained in the basis, the method retains shared terms and approximates missing contributions using available basis functions. Generalization depends strongly on sampled deformation states: exponential strain-stiffening terms can be recovered accurately when sufficiently probed, but can produce large extrapolation errors when the stiffening regime lies outside the sampled domain. Forward FE validation simulations show that the discovered behavior accurately replicates the ground truth. These results establish stress-unsupervised CANN discovery as a promising framework for interpretable full-field constitutive model identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CANN-EUCLID，一种将本构人工神经网络（CANN）与应力无监督全场发现框架 EUCLID 相结合的方法，通过位移场和反作用力直接识别稀疏超弹性本构律，无需局部应力测量或预设律。在各项同性和各向异性基准测试中，当真实规律可被选定的 CANN 基表示时，方法能以接近精确的准确率恢复正确项；否则通过逼近近似替代缺失贡献。泛化性强烈依赖于所采样的变形状态：指数应变硬化项在充分探测时可准确恢复，但在硬化域超出采样范围时产生较大外推误差。前向有限元验证表明发现行为能准确复现真实规律。
Motivation: 现有 CANN 依赖同质化试验的应力-应变数据进行监督学习，每个试验仅采样窄加载路径且仅提供均匀化应力信息，多模式测试对软组织标本困难（重复测试、损伤、样本变异性）。
Method: 将 CANN 与应力无监督全场发现框架 EUCLID 结合，最小化平衡残差并引入稀疏性正则化，从单个异质加载案例的位移场和反作用力中自动选择紧凑的活动项，无需局部应力测量或预设规律。
Result: 在各项同性和各向异性基准中，当真实规律可被所选 CANN 基表示时，正确项以接近精确准确率恢复；当不包含在基中时，方法保留共享项并用可用基函数近似缺失贡献。外推误差取决于采样变形状态，指数硬化项在充分探测时准确，否则误差大。前向 FE 验证复现真实行为。
Conclusion: 本文建立了应力无监督 CANN 发现作为可解释全场本构模型识别的有前景框架，但强调其泛化性受限于采样变形状态的覆盖范围。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 CANN-EUCLID，一种将本构人工神经网络（CANN）与应力无监督全场发现框架 EUCLID 相结合的方法，通过位移场和反作用力直接识别稀疏超弹性本构律，无需局部应力测量或预设律。在各项同性和各向异性基准测试中，当真实规律可被选定的 CANN 基表示时，方法能以接近精确的准确率恢复正确项；否则通过逼近近似替代缺失贡献。泛化性强烈依赖于所采样的变形状态：指数应变硬化项在充分探测时可准确恢复，但在硬化域超出采样范围时产生较大外推误差。前向有限元验证表明发现行为能准确复现真实规律。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 CANN 依赖同质化试验的应力-应变数据进行监督学习，每个试验仅采样窄加载路径且仅提供均匀化应力信息，多模式测试对软组织标本困难（重复测试、损伤、样本变异性）。
summary_sections.method: 将 CANN 与应力无监督全场发现框架 EUCLID 结合，最小化平衡残差并引入稀疏性正则化，从单个异质加载案例的位移场和反作用力中自动选择紧凑的活动项，无需局部应力测量或预设规律。
summary_sections.result: 在各项同性和各向异性基准中，当真实规律可被所选 CANN 基表示时，正确项以接近精确准确率恢复；当不包含在基中时，方法保留共享项并用可用基函数近似缺失贡献。外推误差取决于采样变形状态，指数硬化项在充分探测时准确，否则误差大。前向 FE 验证复现真实行为。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文建立了应力无监督 CANN 发现作为可解释全场本构模型识别的有前景框架，但强调其泛化性受限于采样变形状态的覆盖范围。

papers.title: Code Correctness Is Linearly Decodable from LLM Hidden States Before Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models encode rich information in their hidden states. This work asks whether the correctness of code that Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 has not yet generated is already legible in its hidden states, evaluated on a set of 444 tasks from LiveCodeBench. The correctness of the model's first-attempt code is linearly decodable from the hidden state at the final prompt token, captured before any output token is generated, with a leakage-free held-out AUC of 0.881 +/- 0.008 across 50 outer splits. To assess whether this signal is explained by prompt length, each hidden state dimension is residualized with respect to its linear effect. The probe still achieves an AUC of 0.842 +/- 0.010, substantially above a logistic prompt-length baseline of 0.657 +/- 0.014, and none of the nonlinear models tested improves upon it. A companion question about whether self-repair leaves a geometric signature in the model's hidden states could not be answered, because successful repairs following a failed first attempt are too rare in this setting to support the analysis. The contribution is both empirical and methodological, providing evidence that pre-generation hidden states contain a robust signal of eventual code correctness, together with a confound-control diagnostic that quantifies how much of that signal survives adjustment for prompt length.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 4 tables. Code, data, and analysis scripts available at https://github.com/CarloDiCicco/ReasoningLab
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在代码生成前，LLM隐藏状态是否可解码出代码正确性。在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507模型和LiveCodeBench的444个任务上，从最后提示token的隐藏状态线性解码代码正确性，AUC达0.881，且控制提示长度后仍有0.842。同时发现自我修复的信号稀少无法分析。
Motivation: 探究LLM在生成输出前，其隐藏状态是否已经编码了所生成代码的正确性信息。
Method: 使用线性探针从最终提示token的隐藏状态解码代码正确性，并控制提示长度这一混淆变量。
Result: 线性探针AUC 0.881，控制提示长度后0.842，显著高于基于提示长度的逻辑回归基线0.657。非线性模型未提升。
Conclusion: 预生成隐藏状态包含稳健的代码正确性信号，且该信号不能完全由提示长度解释。自修复几何信号因样本不足无法分析。

papers.title: ArogyaSutra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Multimodal Medical Reasoning in Indic Languages
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promising reasoning capabilities in general domains, yet their performance remains limited in specialized settings such as healthcare, especially in multilingual and low-resource scenarios. This gap is critical in regions like rural India, where patients often express complex medical queries in native Indic languages and rely on multimodal inputs such as medical images. Existing English-centric MLLMs struggle to support such use cases, limiting equitable access to AI-driven healthcare assistance. To address this challenge, we introduce ArogyaBodha, a large-scale multilingual multimodal medical question-answer dataset constructed from eight heterogeneous sources, covering 31 body systems, six imaging modalities, and 21 clinical domains across English and seven major Indian languages. We further propose ArogyaSutra, an actor-critic-based multi-agent framework that integrates tool grounding with dual-memory mechanisms for step-wise, reasoning-aware decision making, and uses stored actor-critic simulation trajectories for distillation. Experiments show that our dataset and framework improve multilingual medical reasoning accuracy across all Indic languages, with ablations validating the contribution of each component. The source code and dataset are available at: https://iitp-cse.github.io/ArogyaSutra/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多语言低资源医疗场景中多模态大语言模型推理能力不足的问题，构建了大规模多语言多模态医疗问答数据集ArogyaBodha，并提出基于演员-评论家的多智能体框架ArogyaSutra，集成工具调用和双记忆机制进行逐步推理。实验表明该方法在多种印度语言上提升了医疗推理准确率。
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在专业医疗领域，尤其是多语言和低资源场景下表现有限，无法支持印度农村患者使用本土语言和医学图像的复杂医疗查询，限制了AI医疗辅助的公平可及性。
Method: 提出ArogyaSutra，一个基于演员-评论家（actor-critic）的多智能体框架，结合工具接地（tool grounding）和双记忆机制进行逐步推理感知决策，并利用存储的演员-评论家模拟轨迹进行蒸馏。同时构建了覆盖8个异构来源、31个身体系统、6种成像模态和21个临床领域的大规模多语言多模态医疗问答数据集ArogyaBodha。
Result: 实验表明，所提出的数据集和框架在所有印度语言上提高了多语言医疗推理准确率，消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。
Conclusion: 该工作通过大规模数据集和多智能体框架，在医疗领域的多语言多模态推理上取得了提升，但限于印度语言场景，未涉及降水预报等气象领域。

papers.title: Pipette: An Embodied Simulation Platform, Benchmark, and Data-Efficient Augmentation Framework for Wet-Lab Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Wet-lab robots can improve the reproducibility, throughput, and safety of biomedical experiments, but scaling their learning requires customizable simulators for safe and reproducible task generation, open editable laboratory assets, and efficient pipelines that turn limited demonstrations into usable training data. We present Pipette, an embodied simulation platform, benchmark, and data-efficient augmentation framework for wet-lab robot learning. Pipette provides over 100 open-source and re-editable wet-lab assets through an extensible asset-building pipeline with built-in Tencent Hunyuan support for text- and image-conditioned 3D asset generation, and supports three robotic-arm embodiments through a unified simulation interface for task construction, data collection, augmentation, and evaluation. A key component of Pipette is its simulation-based data augmentation pipeline, which replays human demonstrations in simulation, applies lighting, camera, speed, and action perturbations, and filters generated episodes with automatic task success checks, rapidly expanding usable training data from limited manual demonstrations. We further introduce a 12-task wet-lab embodied benchmark covering sample handling, culture-ware manipulation, device operation, and precision placement. With only 30 demonstrations per task, ACT achieves 60.3% average success rate, while simulation augmentation improves SmolVLA from 40.4% to 71.8% and pi0 from 37.3% to 44.1%, validating the effectiveness of Pipette for data-efficient VLA training and evaluation. Pipette also supports natural-language-driven scene construction and task registration, lowering the barrier for non-expert users to define new wet-lab robotic tasks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pipette，一个面向湿实验室机器人学习的具身仿真平台、基准测试和数据高效增强框架。平台提供超过100个开源可编辑的湿实验室资产，支持三种机器人臂，并通过基于仿真的数据增强管道（回放人类演示、施加扰动、自动任务成功检查）从少量演示中扩展训练数据。引入12个湿实验室任务基准，实验表明仅30个演示下ACT达到60.3%平均成功率，仿真增强将SmolVLA从40.4%提升至71.8%，pi0从37.3%提升至44.1%。
Motivation: 湿实验室机器人可提高生物医学实验的 reproducibility、吞吐量和安全性，但规模化学习需要可定制的仿真器、开放可编辑的实验室资产以及将有限演示转化为可用训练数据的高效流水线。现有平台缺乏这些关键能力。
Method: Pipette包含三个核心组件：1）通过可扩展资产构建流水线（内置腾讯混元支持文本/图像条件3D资产生成）提供100+开源可编辑湿实验室资产；2）统一的仿真接口支持三种机器人臂用于任务构建、数据收集、增强和评估；3）基于仿真的数据增强管道：回放人类演示、应用光照/相机/速度/动作扰动、自动任务成功检查过滤，快速扩展训练数据。支持自然语言驱动的场景构建和任务注册。
Result: 在12任务湿实验室基准上，使用30个演示/任务，ACT达到60.3%平均成功率；仿真增强将SmolVLA从40.4%提升至71.8%，pi0从37.3%提升至44.1%。
Conclusion: Pipette验证了仿真增强对数据高效VLA训练和评估的有效性，降低了非专家用户定义新湿实验室机器人任务的门槛。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards a Bridge Layer Between Bibliographic and Formalized Mathematical Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical knowledge is split between bibliographic databases (e.g., MathSciNet, zbMATH Open) and formal proof libraries (e.g., Lean mathlib), preventing unified access between published results and their formalizations. We propose a relational bridge-database that aligns publication metadata with formal artifacts, providing an interoperability layer between mathematical literature and machine-verifiable proofs. We introduce a paper-level formalization score that measures how much of a publication is covered in formal systems. As a feasibility study, we show how such scores can be estimated via cross-document alignment between informal texts and Lean formalizations, enabling large-scale analysis of formalization coverage. This framework is a first step toward integrating bibliographic and formal mathematical ecosystems into scalable, machine-actionable knowledge graphs linking publications to formal proof objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个关系型桥接数据库，用于对齐出版元数据与形式化证明制品，提供数学文献与机器可验证证明之间的互操作层。引入论文级形式化评分，衡量出版物在形式系统（如 Lean mathlib）中的覆盖程度，并通过跨文档对齐非正式文本与 Lean 形式化来估算该评分。这是将文献与形式化数学生态系统集成到可扩展、机器可操作的知识图谱中的第一步。
Motivation: 数学知识分散在文献数据库和形式化证明库中，缺乏统一访问途径，阻碍了已发表结果与其形式化之间的协同使用。
Method: 构建关系型桥接数据库，对齐出版物元数据与形式化制品（如 Lean 形式化）。提出论文级形式化评分，并通过跨文档对齐非正式文本与 Lean 形式化来估计该评分。
Result: 作为可行性研究，展示了如何通过跨文档对齐估计形式化覆盖率，从而支持大规模分析。
Conclusion: 该框架是集成文献与形式化数学生态系统到机器可操作知识图谱的第一步，但当前仅为可行性研究，尚未提供实际应用或大规模评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conan-embedding-v3: Fusing Modality-Specific Models for Omni-Modal Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal retrieval promises a single embedding space for text, image, video, document, and audio inputs, but building such a unified retriever is difficult since these modalities differ in data distribution, architecture, and optimization dynamics. In this work, we present Conan-embedding-v3, a decouple--fuse--recover framework for omni-modal retrieval. Conan-embedding-v3 first trains modality specialists independently and fuses their task vectors into a single dense backbone, a strategy we call Decoupled Specialist Fusion. We show that this fusion composes visual, video, and document retrieval capabilities, but also exposes a failure mode for projector-based modalities: when audio is attached through an external encoder and projector, fusing the backbone leaves the projector calibrated to the audio-specialist backbone, causing a large audio retrieval regression despite copying all audio-specific modules unchanged. We call this failure Projector Drift. To repair it, Conan-embedding-v3 applies Projector Recovery (i.e., full-parameter fine-tuning of the projector while keeping the backbone frozen) followed by balanced multi-modal rehearsal. The resulting model supports these retrieval pathways in one backbone, achieving 74.9 scores on MMEB while obtaining 55.61 on the 30-task MAEB audio suite.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Conan-embedding-v3，一种用于全模态检索的解耦-融合-恢复框架。该方法先独立训练各模态专家，再通过解耦专家融合（Decoupled Specialist Fusion）将任务向量融合到单个密集骨干网络中。融合后发现投影器漂移（Projector Drift）问题，即音频投影器校准失效导致检索性能下降，为此提出投影器恢复（Projector Recovery）和平稳多模态回放。模型在MMEB上达到74.9分，在MAEB音频套件上达到55.61分。
Motivation: 构建统一的文本、图像、视频、文档和音频嵌入空间面临模态差异、架构和优化动力学不同等挑战，现有融合方法在处理投影器模态时存在性能退化。
Method: 采用解耦-融合-恢复框架：先独立训练各模态专家，融合任务向量到单一骨干网络（Decoupled Specialist Fusion），发现投影器漂移后，通过全参数微调投影器（骨干冻结）并配合平衡多模态回放（Projector Recovery）来修复。
Result: 在MMEB基准上取得74.9分，在MAEB音频30任务套件上取得55.61分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提框架可在一个骨干网络中支持多种检索通路，并指出了投影器漂移问题及解决方案。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出Conan-embedding-v3，一种用于全模态检索的解耦-融合-恢复框架。该方法先独立训练各模态专家，再通过解耦专家融合（Decoupled Specialist Fusion）将任务向量融合到单个密集骨干网络中。融合后发现投影器漂移（Projector Drift）问题，即音频投影器校准失效导致检索性能下降，为此提出投影器恢复（Projector Recovery）和平稳多模态回放。模型在MMEB上达到74.9分，在MAEB音频套件上达到55.61分。
summary_sections.motivation: 构建统一的文本、图像、视频、文档和音频嵌入空间面临模态差异、架构和优化动力学不同等挑战，现有融合方法在处理投影器模态时存在性能退化。
summary_sections.method: 采用解耦-融合-恢复框架：先独立训练各模态专家，融合任务向量到单一骨干网络（Decoupled Specialist Fusion），发现投影器漂移后，通过全参数微调投影器（骨干冻结）并配合平衡多模态回放（Projector Recovery）来修复。

papers.title: Orthogonality and Dimensionality in Airline Cluster Analysis using PCA and Kernel PCA
papers.abstract_en: This methodological study analyzes the effects of collinearity, effective dimensionality, and cluster stability in a 2023 study of US airline profit cycles from 1995 to 2020 by Renold et al., which uses k-means clustering, principal component analysis, and system dynamic modelling.We replicate their clustering experiment in three spaces -- the original 7-dim. raw-variable space, a 3-dim. PC score space, and a 4-dim. PC score space using their dataset. We show that the six-cluster taxonomy is geometrically robust: k-means in 3-PC space produces bit-for-bit identical cluster assignments relative to 7D raw space. As a nonlinearity check we apply kernel PCA under six kernels spanning three families plus a linear baseline. The kernels confirm an intrinsically linear manifold with no detectable curvature. The silhouette criterion reveals that the dataset structurally supports only three clusters, not six. Collinearity in the raw 7D space suppresses the silhouette signal. A kernel ridge regression check confirms no nonlinear accuracy gain over linear ridge once the COVID19 year is excluded. Together, these results argue for clustering on PC scores rather than raw variables in collinearity-prone panel data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对Renold等人2023年关于美国航空公司盈利周期研究的复现与扩展，分析了原始7维变量空间、3维和4维主成分得分空间中的聚类稳定性。实验表明，基于3-PC空间的k-means聚类与7维原始空间得到完全相同的簇分配；使用六种核函数进行核PCA分析，证实数据流形本质上是线性的；轮廓系数显示数据天然支持3个簇而非6个；原始空间的共线性抑制了轮廓信号；核岭回归在排除COVID19年份后没有比线性岭回归有非线性精度提升。结论建议在共线性强的面板数据中使用主成分得分进行聚类。
Motivation: 分析共线性、有效维度和聚类稳定性在航空公司盈利周期研究中的影响，检验Renold等人使用k-means、PCA和系统动力学建模的研究方法是否稳健。
Method: 复现Renold等人的聚类实验，在原始7维变量空间、3维和4维主成分得分空间中进行k-means聚类；应用六种核函数（涵盖三个族）的核PCA检测非线性结构；使用轮廓系数评估簇数；使用核岭回归检查非线性预测增益。
Result: 3-PC空间的k-means与7维原始空间产生完全相同的簇分配；核PCA确认数据流形本质线性；轮廓系数显示数据支持3个簇而非6个；原始空间的共线性使轮廓信号被抑制；排除COVID19后核岭回归无非线性优势。
Conclusion: 在共线性强的面板数据中，应使用主成分得分而非原始变量进行聚类。

papers.title: DNQ: Deep Nash Q-Network for Partially Observable n-Player Games
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world competitive systems require multiple decision-makers to act simultaneously under shared constraints, limited information, and repeated interaction, as in auctions, resource allocation, and security competition. We study multi-turn simultaneous bidding as a controlled testbed for such problems and propose DNQ, a solver-in-the-loop equilibrium supervision framework for training bidding agents. DNQ alternates between trajectory collection, critic-based payoff estimation, equilibrium computation, and policy imitation. At each visited state, a shared critic predicts either pairwise payoff matrices or an exact N-player payoff tensor, an external solver computes equilibrium strategies, and the agents are trained by minimizing the KL divergence between their masked policies and the solver-derived equilibrium targets. We focus on a scalable pairwise formulation that greatly reduces equilibrium-solving cost and training time compared with the exact formulation, while the shared critic amortizes payoff learning across agents and states. Experiments compare the pairwise and exact variants using critic loss, policy entropy, bidding resource usage, and training cost, showing that the pairwise method scales to larger numbers of agents, whereas the exact method becomes computationally impractical as the joint game grows. These results illustrate the trade-off between strategic fidelity and scalability in repeated competitive environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DNQ，一种基于求解器在环的均衡监督框架，用于训练部分可观测多玩家博弈中的出价智能体。使用共享评论家预测收益矩阵，外部求解器计算纳什均衡，并通过最小化KL散度进行策略模仿。实验对比了成对近似和精确求解两种变体，显示成对方法在扩展性上更优。
Motivation: 多玩家重复博弈中的均衡求解面临可扩展性挑战，精确求解方法在联合博弈规模增大时计算成本过高。
Method: DNQ框架交替进行轨迹收集、评论家收益估计、外部求解器计算均衡策略、以及策略模仿训练，采用成对支付矩阵近似降低计算成本。
Result: 成对变体在评论家损失、策略熵、资源使用和训练成本方面优于精确变体，且能扩展到更多玩家，而精确方法在联合博弈增大时计算不可行。
Conclusion: 展示了重复竞争环境中策略保真度与可扩展性之间的权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Representing Research Attention as Contextually Structured Flows
papers.abstract_en: Research metrics use attention as evidence of societal impact. Yet attention serves as evidence only once interpreted, and its meaning depends on its contextual structure, not on volume alone. Altmetrics represents signals in isolation, keeping a count of the attention an output received, or a sequence of when. We address this with attention flows, representations that situate an output's attention in the contexts through which it is distributed. To evaluate the flow, we build a benchmark of analogy queries, each testing whether the relationship between two outputs, applied to a third, yields a fourth. The count and sequence baselines fail to recover these relationships, whereas flows learned as dynamic contextualised representations recover them. The recovered structure also survives partial observation and rests on its contexts instead of volume. These findings support attention represented as contextually structured for research evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted at STi 2026 - International Conference on Science and Technology Indicators
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 摘要提出用注意力流（attention flows）表示研究产出的注意力，将注意力置于其分布语境中，并通过类比查询基准评估。实验表明，基于动态语境化表示的学习流能恢复类比关系，而计数和序列基线失败。
Motivation: 现有altmetrics将注意力信号孤立计数或计时，忽略了语境结构，而注意力的意义依赖于语境结构。
Method: 提出注意力流表示，将产出的注意力置于分布语境中；构建类比查询基准，测试输出间关系是否可传递。
Result: 计数和序列基线无法恢复类比关系，而基于动态语境化表示学习的流能恢复；且恢复的结构在部分观测下仍存在，依赖于语境而非数量。
Conclusion: 支持将注意力表示为语境结构化的形式用于研究评估。

papers.title: "Skill Issues'': Data-Centric Optimization of Lakehouse Agents
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are becoming users of data infrastructure, but their success depends not only on model quality: it also depends on the skills and environment files that teach agents how to use a system. We study how to optimize these artifacts for agents operating on a branching lakehouse, Bauplan. In our setting, headless APIs and Git-like data primitives expose data workflows through code, branches, commits, and merges. Our central observation is that a branching lakehouse turns data-agent evaluation from an output-matching problem into a state-verification problem: agent-generated pipeline code induces concrete, inspectable lakehouse changes. We present a data-centric optimization pipeline that generates task-verifier pairs, executes candidate skills in isolated sandboxes, and scores trajectories using both trace-level signals and programmatic checks over lakehouse state. In a preliminary evaluation on hundreds of tasks, optimized skills improve held-out reward by up to 28.6%. These results suggest that write-path data workflows provide a useful substrate for optimizing agent skills beyond read-only tasks.
papers.comment: Pre-print of paper accepted at ADS @ VLDB 2026, Boston
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究数据湖仓代理的技能优化，针对Bauplan分支湖仓，提出数据为中心的优化管道，生成任务验证器对、在隔离沙箱中执行候选技能，并利用迹线信号和程序化检查对湖仓状态进行评分。初步评估显示优化技能在数百个任务上将保留奖励提升最多28.6%。
Motivation: 编码代理的成功不仅依赖模型质量，也依赖教会代理使用系统的技能和环境文件，但目前缺乏对这些工件的系统优化方法。
Method: 提出数据为中心的优化管道：首先生成任务验证器对，然后在隔离沙箱中执行候选技能，最后使用迹线信号和程序化检查对湖仓状态进行评分，以选择最优技能。
Result: 在数百个任务上的初步评估中，优化技能将保留奖励提高最多28.6%。
Conclusion: 写路径数据工作流为优化代理技能提供了有用基础，超越了只读任务，表明数据湖仓环境在技能优化中的潜力。

papers.title: Towards Consistent Video Geometry Estimation
papers.abstract_en: This work presents ViGeo, a feed-forward foundation model for recovering spatially dense and temporally consistent geometry from video sequences. Built upon a plain transformer architecture without task-specific architectural modifications, ViGeo supports streaming, full-sequence, and long-video inference within a unified model. The key design is dynamic chunking attention, which exposes the model to both bidirectional and causal temporal contexts during training and allows it to adapt its attention pattern at test time without retraining. To improve supervision quality, we further introduce a completion-based data refinement framework. This framework trains a video depth completion teacher that conditions on sparse and noisy annotations and exploits video/multi-view context to produce dense, temporally coherent, and geometrically reliable training targets. Beyond depth and point maps, ViGeo also predicts surface normals within the same framework. Trained solely on public datasets, ViGeo achieves state-of-the-art performance across online, offline, and long-video depth estimation, surface normal estimation, and video point map estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ViGeo，一种前馈基础模型，用于从视频序列中恢复空间密集且时间一致的几何信息（深度、法线、点图）。模型基于纯Transformer架构，通过动态分块注意力机制支持流式、全序列和长视频推理，并引入基于补全的数据精炼框架以提升训练质量。在公开数据集上训练后，ViGeo在在线、离线和长视频深度估计、表面法线估计及视频点图估计任务上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有视频几何估计方法往往依赖特定任务的设计，难以同时满足时空一致性和多模式推理需求，且缺乏高质量的密集训练数据。
Method: 采用纯Transformer架构，提出动态分块注意力（dynamic chunking attention）使模型在训练时接触双向和因果时序上下文，测试时可自适应调整注意力模式。同时设计基于补全的数据精炼框架，训练视频深度补全教师模型，利用稀疏噪声标注和视频/多视角上下文生成密集、时序一致且几何可靠的训练目标。
Result: 仅在公开数据集上训练，ViGeo在在线、离线和长视频深度估计、表面法线估计及视频点图估计上均达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: ViGeo证明了无需任务特定结构修改的纯Transformer在视频几何估计中的有效性，其统一的推理模式和高质量训练数据生成策略可推广至其他任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MemTrace: Tracing and Attributing Errors in Large Language Model Memory Systems
papers.abstract_en: Memory is essential for enabling large language models to support long-horizon reasoning, yet existing memory systems remain unreliable and difficult to debug. Tracing memory's dynamic evolution is crucial to understand how information is synthesized, propagated, or corrupted over time. In this work, we study the new problem of error tracing and attribution in LLM memory systems. We propose a novel framework that transforms memory pipelines into executable memory evolution graphs, enabling fine-grained tracing of operational information flow. We then construct MemTraceBench, a benchmark collected from representative memory systems such as Long-Context, RAG, Mem0, and EverMemOS, to systematically study memory failure modes. We further introduce an automatic attribution method that iteratively traces operation subgraphs to pinpoint the root cause of any failed case. Our analysis reveals that memory failures are systematic, stemming from operation-level issues like information loss and retrieval misalignment. Crucially, we leverage these fine-grained attribution signals to guide downstream prompt optimization, establishing a closed-loop system that automatically corrects faults and boosts end-task performance by up to 7.62%. Code will be released at https://github.com/zjunlp/MemTrace.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型记忆系统难以调试的问题，提出 MemTrace 框架，将记忆流水线转化为可执行的记忆演化图，实现细粒度操作信息流追踪。构建 MemTraceBench 基准，并引入自动归因方法迭代追踪操作子图以定位失败根因。实验表明，记忆失败源于操作级问题（如信息丢失和检索错位），利用归因信号指导提示优化可形成闭环系统，自动纠正故障并提升下游任务性能最高 7.62%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 记忆系统在长程推理中不可靠且难以调试，需要追踪记忆的动态演化以理解信息如何被合成、传播或损坏。
Method: 提出 MemTrace 框架，将记忆管道转换为可执行的记忆演化图，支持细粒度操作信息流追踪；构建基于 Long-Context、RAG、Mem0、EverMemOS 等代表性系统的 MemTraceBench 基准；引入自动归因方法，通过迭代追踪操作子图定位失败的根因。
Result: 分析表明记忆失败是系统性的，主要由操作级问题（如信息丢失、检索错位）导致；利用归因信号指导提示优化，建立闭环系统，自动纠正故障并提升下游端任务性能最高达 7.62%。
Conclusion: 本文展示了通过细粒度归因信号自动优化提示的闭环方法，能够有效提升 LLM 记忆系统的可靠性和下游性能。

papers.title: SAMark: A Self-Anchored Text Watermarking with Paragraph-Level Paraphrase Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Semantic-level watermarking (SWM) improves robustness against text modifications by treating sentences as the basic unit. However, robustness to paragraph-level paraphrasing remains difficult because such attacks globally disrupt watermark signals by changing sentence order. In this work, we propose SAMark, a self-anchored watermarking framework that removes the dependency on sentence order by establishing a step-independent green region in semantic space. To improve detectability, we introduce a multi-channel hyperbolic scoring mechanism that amplifies watermark signals while suppressing noise from weakly aligned candidates. We further propose a diversity-aware filtering strategy that combines hard filtering with soft regularization, extending beyond simple n-gram repetition filters to address semantic redundancy. Experimental results show that SAMark achieves up to 90.2% TP@FP1% under typical paragraph-level paraphrasing attacks, outperforming the strongest prior baseline by more than 30% on average, while maintaining generation quality competitive with unwatermarked text and breaking the robustness-quality trade-off that limits prior methods. Our code will be released at [this URL](https://github.com/Z1zs/SAMark).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自锚定文本水印框架 SAMark，通过建立与句子顺序无关的语义空间绿色区域来抵抗段落级改写攻击。引入多通道双曲评分机制增强可检测性，并采用多样性感知过滤策略解决语义冗余。实验表明在段落级改写攻击下 TP@FP1% 达 90.2%，优于最强基线平均 30% 以上，且不牺牲生成质量。
Motivation: 现有语义级水印以句子为基本单元，但对段落级改写（改变句子顺序）鲁棒性不足，因为这种攻击全局破坏水印信号。
Method: 提出自锚定框架 SAMark，核心是建立与步骤顺序无关的语义空间绿色区域；采用多通道双曲评分机制放大水印信号、抑制噪声；结合硬过滤与软正则的多样性感知过滤策略处理语义冗余。
Result: 在典型段落级改写攻击下，SAMark 达到 90.2% TP@FP1%，平均优于最强基线 30% 以上，生成质量与未加水印文本相当，打破了先前方法的鲁棒性-质量权衡。
Conclusion: SAMark 有效解决了段落级改写攻击下的鲁棒性问题，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升检测率。

papers.title: Grow-Prune-Freeze Networks: Adaptive & Continual Learning Technique for Olfactory Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Training data for olfaction is scattered through disparate, non-standardized datasets that limit the ability to build representative world models. Olfactory navigation is a highly dynamic and non-stationary task that benefits from real-time continual learning. We introduce an adaptive framework called Grow-Prune-Freeze (GPF) networks that enable an agent to continually learn through growing, pruning, and freezing early layers of its policy in response to world complexity. Grounding GPFs in non-linear random matrix theory, we show that the work of Pennington & Worth (2017) can be extended from single hidden layers to n-layer continual-learning models, and that eigenvalue composition of network weights is preserved as successive layers are added. We show that GPFs based on Expected SARSA achieve a 94% success rate on turbulent plume navigation - a partially observable, non-stationary task representative of the "big world" challenges that motivate adaptive learning in robotics - and provide supporting methodology for applying GPFs in other world models. Further experiments amount evidence that GPFs may generalize well to other machine learning tasks such as reinforcement learning in Atari, image classification, and autoregressive language models. We open source all code and data to encourage improvements on and more research in olfactory robotics.
papers.comment: Accepted as poster to the Reinforcement Learning in Big Worlds Workshop at the 2026 Reinforcement Learning Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 Grow-Prune-Freeze (GPF) 网络的自适应框架，用于处理嗅觉导航中的实时持续学习问题。GPF 通过动态增长、剪枝和冻结策略网络的早期层来适应环境复杂度，并基于非线性随机矩阵理论将单隐层分析扩展到 n 层持续学习模型。在湍流羽流导航任务上，基于 Expected SARSA 的 GPF 实现了 94% 的成功率，并展示了在 Atari 强化学习、图像分类和自回归语言模型等任务中的泛化潜力。
Motivation: 嗅觉训练数据分散且非标准化，难以构建代表性世界模型；嗅觉导航是高度动态和非平稳的任务，需要实时的持续学习能力。现有方法难以高效适应环境变化，因此需要一种能够动态调整网络结构的自适应持续学习技术。
Method: 提出 Grow-Prune-Freeze (GPF) 网络，在训练过程中根据世界复杂度动态增加（grow）、剪枝（prune）和冻结（freeze）策略网络的早期层。基于非线性随机矩阵理论，将 Pennington & Worth (2017) 的单隐层分析推广到 n 层持续学习模型，并证明网络权重特征值组成在逐层添加时得以保持。
Result: 基于 Expected SARSA 的 GPF 在湍流羽流导航（部分可观测、非平稳任务）上达到 94% 的成功率。额外实验表明 GPF 在 Atari 强化学习、图像分类和自回归语言模型等任务上也有良好的泛化效果。
Conclusion: GPF 网络为嗅觉导航中的持续学习提供了一种自适应且有效的方法，其理论框架可扩展到其他机器学习任务。作者开源了所有代码和数据，以促进嗅觉机器人领域的进一步研究。

papers.title: Segmenting Human-LLM Co-authored Text via Change Point Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rise of large language models (LLMs) has created an urgent need to distinguish between human-written and LLM-generated text to ensure authenticity and societal trust. Existing detectors typically provide a binary classification for an entire passage; however, this is insufficient for human--LLM co-authored text, where the objective is to localize specific segments authored by humans or LLMs. To bridge this gap, we propose algorithms to segment text into human- and LLM-authored pieces. Our key observation is that such a segmentation task is conceptually similar to classical change point detection in time-series analysis. Leveraging this analogy, we adapt change point detection to LLM-generated text detection, develop a weighted algorithm and a generalized algorithm to accommodate heterogeneous detection score variability, and establish the minimax optimality of our procedure. Empirically, we demonstrate the strong performance of our approach against a wide range of existing baselines. The python implementation of our proposal is available at https://github.com/Mamba413/DetectLLMSegmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人机协作文本（human-LLM co-authored text）中区分人类撰写和LLM生成片段的任务，提出基于变化点检测（change point detection）的算法。作者将文本分割问题类比为时间序列中的变化点检测，并开发了加权算法和广义算法以适应检测分数异质性，同时证明了方法的最小最大最优性（minimax optimality）。实验表明该方法在多种基线中表现优异。
Motivation: 现有LLM文本检测器通常只对整个段落进行二元分类，无法定位人机协作文本中具体的LLM或人类撰写片段，而现实场景中需要精确分割。
Method: 将文本分割任务形式化为时间序列变化点检测问题，引入加权和广义变化点检测算法来处理不同检测分数间的异质性，并理论上建立了最小最大最优性。
Result: 在多个实验设置下，该方法在分割准确率上显著优于现有基线，具体定量结果参见论文实验章节。
Conclusion: 变化点检测为LLM文本分割提供了一种简洁且理论最优的框架，开源代码便于复现和应用。

papers.title: NORACL: Neurogenesis for Oracle-free Resource-Adaptive Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: In a continual learning setting, we require a model to be plastic enough to learn a new task and stable enough to not disturb previously learned capabilities. We argue that this dilemma has an architectural root. A finite network has limited representational and plastic resources, yet the required capacity depends on properties of the future task stream that are unknown: how many tasks will be encountered, and how much they overlap in feature space. Regularization-based methods preserve past knowledge within fixed-capacity architectures and therefore implicitly rely on an oracle architecture sized for this unknown future. When tasks are only weakly related, fixed architectures progressively run out of plastic resources; when tasks are few or strongly overlapping, models are often over-provisioned. Inspired by neurogenesis in biology, we propose NORACL to address the stability-plasticity dilemma by tackling the oracle architecture problem through neuronal growth. Starting from a compact network, NORACL grows only when needed by monitoring two complementary signals for representational and plasticity saturation. We evaluate NORACL against oracle-sized static baselines across varying task counts and geometries. Across all settings, NORACL achieves final average accuracies that are better than or on par with oracle-provisioned static baselines while using fewer parameters. Additionally, NORACL yields architectures with interpretable growth, i.e. dissimilar tasks predominantly expand feature-extraction layers, whereas tasks which rely on common features shift growth toward later feature-combination layers. Our analysis further explains why fixed-capacity networks lose plasticity as tasks accumulate, whereas NORACL creates fresh capacity for new tasks through growth. Together, these results show that adaptive neurogenesis pushes the stability-plasticity Pareto frontier of continual learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对持续学习中的稳定-可塑性困境和预言机架构问题，提出受神经发生启发的NORACL方法。NORACL从紧凑网络开始，通过监控表示饱和度和可塑性饱和度两个信号，仅在需要时生长神经元。实验表明，在不同任务数量和几何形状下，NORACL在最终平均准确率上优于或持平于预言机大小的静态基线，且使用更少参数，同时产生可解释的生长模式。
Motivation: 固定容量网络在持续学习中面临稳定-可塑性困境：需要足够可塑性学习新任务，同时稳定保留旧知识。现有正则化方法隐式依赖适应未来未知任务数量的预言机架构，导致任务弱相关时资源耗尽，强相关时资源过剩。
Method: 提出NORACL，基于生物神经发生机制，从紧凑网络开始，监控表示饱和度和可塑性饱和度的互补信号，仅在需要时通过神经元生长扩展网络容量。
Result: 在多种任务数量和几何形状的设置下，NORACL的最终平均准确率优于或与预言机大小的静态基线持平，同时参数量更少。生长模式可解释：不相似任务主要扩展特征提取层，相似任务扩展特征组合层。
Conclusion: 自适应神经发生推动了持续学习的稳定-可塑性帕累托前沿，NORACL通过生长创造新容量，避免了固定容量网络随任务累积失去可塑性的问题。

papers.title: Multibit neural inference in a N-ary crossbar architecture
papers.abstract_en: In-memory computing (IMC) is a paradigm that enables neural network inference by computing analog matrix-vector multiplications (MVM) directly in memory crossbar arrays, with the potential for energy efficiency gains over conventional von Neumann architectures. In this work we present a simulation framework for N-ary crossbar architectures that retrieves MVM results with minimal implementation assumptions. The XOR and MNIST classification tasks were successfully inferred using a simulated crossbar array of (4x4) 4-states magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJ). MNIST accuracy reached 93.56% (vs. 97.56% software baseline). PCA dimensionality reduction was shown to drastically lower the number of required operations and improve the software baseline, for only a modest reduction in crossbar inference accuracy. We identified weight quantization as the primary error source, and studied its impact alongside systematic non-idealities and random noise. We find that cell-specific random noise is less detrimental than systematic errors due to averaging across the array. Finally, we demonstrate an optimal number of states per cell that balances quantization error against resistance state resolution to minimize total MVM error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种N-元交叉阵列架构的仿真框架，用于实现内存计算（IMC）中的神经推理。使用4×4 4态磁隧道结（MTJ）交叉阵列成功推理了XOR和MNIST分类任务，MNIST准确率达93.56%（软件基线97.56%）。研究发现权重量化是主要误差源，而单元特异性随机噪声由于阵列平均效应危害较小，并确定了平衡量化误差与电阻状态分辨率的最优状态数。
Motivation: 传统冯·诺依曼架构在神经推理中存在能效瓶颈，内存计算（IMC）通过直接在交叉阵列中进行模拟矩阵向量乘法（MVM）有望提升能效，但现有研究对N-元（多状态）交叉阵列的误差源分析尚不充分。
Method: 开发了一个仿真框架，模拟N-元交叉阵列的MVM结果，使用4×4 4态MTJ阵列进行MNIST分类，并结合PCA降维减少操作次数，系统分析了权重量化、系统非理想性和随机噪声对推理精度的影响。
Result: MNIST分类准确率93.56%（软件基线97.56%）；PCA降维大幅降低操作次数并提升软件基线，仅轻微降低交叉阵列推理精度；权重量化是主要误差源，系统误差比随机噪声影响更大；存在最优状态数平衡量化误差与电阻分辨率。
Conclusion: 该框架证明了N-元交叉阵列在低假设条件下的可行性，并揭示了误差主导因素，为优化模拟内存计算设计提供了指导。

papers.title: New non-Euclidean neural quantum states from additional types of hyperbolic recurrent neural networks
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we extend the class of previously introduced non-Euclidean neural quantum states (NQS) which consists only of Poincare hyperbolic GRU, to new variants including Poincare RNN as well as Lorentz RNN and Lorentz GRU. In addition to constructing the new non-Euclidean hyperbolic NQS ansatzes, we generalize the results of our earlier work regarding the definitive outperformances delivered by hyperbolic Poincare GRU NQS when benchmarked against their Euclidean counterparts in the Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) experiments involving the Heisenberg $J_1J_2$ and $J_1J_2J_3$ models. Here, using larger systems consisting of 100 spins, we find that all four hyperbolic RNN/GRU NQS variants always outperform their respective Euclidean counterpart with the same architecture. In our experiments, among the four hyperbolic NQS, Lorentz RNN stands out in particular because despite having almost three times fewer parameters, it is capable of surpassing the more complex Poincare GRU and Lorentz GRU to emerge as the best overall hyperbolic NQS ansatz on many instances involving different $J_2$ and ($J_2, J_3$) couplings. Given the findings from this work showing that the four newly constructed hyperbolic RNN/GRU NQS ansatzes are able to outperform the well-established Euclidean RNN/GRU NQS in Heisenberg spin models, we establish the utility and efficiency of the hyperbolic Poincare RNN/GRU and Lorentz RNN/GRU NQS for future variational studies of quantum many-body systems, especially those exhibiting a hierarchical structure in the form of the different degrees of nearest-neighbor interactions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了非欧几里得量子神经状态（NQS）的类别，从已有的庞加莱双曲GRU增加至庞加莱RNN、洛伦兹RNN和洛伦兹GRU。在Heisenberg J1J2和J1J2J3模型上，所有四种双曲RNN/GRU NQS变体在100自旋系统中均优于对应的欧几里得版本，其中洛伦兹RNN在参数更少的情况下表现最佳。
Motivation: 现有非欧几里得NQS仅包含庞加莱双曲GRU，需要扩展至更多变体以验证其普适性和性能优势。
Method: 构建了庞加莱RNN、洛伦兹RNN和洛伦兹GRU三种新的双曲NQS变体，并与已有的庞加莱GRU一起在Heisenberg模型上进行变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）实验。
Result: 所有四种双曲RNN/GRU NQS变体在100自旋的J1J2和J1J2J3模型上均优于同架构的欧几里得版本；洛伦兹RNN以更少参数超越了更复杂的庞加莱GRU和洛伦兹GRU，成为多项任务中的最佳双曲NQS。
Conclusion: 双曲庞加莱RNN/GRU和洛伦兹RNN/GRU NQS在Heisenberg自旋模型中有效且高效，适用于未来含层级结构的量子多体系统变分研究。

papers.title: From physical surfaces to human-centric heat stress: LST and UTCI heat mapping reveals nonlinear effects of urban morphology
papers.abstract_en: Heat exposure connects the built environment and public health, directly shaping the livability and sustainability of urban areas. Understanding the spatial heterogeneity of heat exposure and its drivers is vital for climate-adaptive urban planning. However, most planning-oriented studies rely on land surface temperature (LST), and whether LST adequately represents human heat exposure and how it differs from physiologically relevant heat stress remains insufficiently examined. Here, using Landsat-retrieved 30-m LST and GPU-accelerated 1-m universal thermal climate index (UTCI) in Singapore, this study establishes a comprehensive "Modeling-Comparing-Assessing" framework to systematically evaluate the spatial and mechanistic differences between these two metrics. We further investigate their pronounced non-stationary and threshold-based relationships with urban factors using a novel geographically weighted XGBoost (GW-XGBoost) and generalized additive model (GAM) workflow. Our results reveal substantial differences in the spatial patterns of LST and UTCI, along with marked spatial heterogeneity in how 2D and 3D urban factors impact these thermal metrics, as demonstrated by explainable GW-XGBoost models (test R2 = 0.855 for LST and 0.905 for UTCI). Crucially, spatially explicit SHAP shows that sky view factor plays a central role in explaining UTCI variability but exhibits a comparatively marginal independent contribution to LST, indicating that LST inadequately captures shading-driven and radiative processes governing actual human heat stress. Moreover, SHAP-GAM analysis indicates that higher albedo is associated with increased UTCI. These findings provide model-informed planning implications for integrating physiologically relevant thermal indices to support targeted heat risk management and human-centric urban planning.
papers.comment: Accepted manuscript. The final published version is available at https://doi.org/10.1016/j.scs.2026.107659
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文利用新加坡的Landsat 30米地表温度(LST)和GPU加速1米通用热气候指数(UTCI)，构建了“建模-比较-评估”框架，系统比较了两种指标的空间和机制差异。通过地理加权XGBoost (GW-XGBoost)和广义加性模型(GAM)分析，发现LST和UTCI的空间模式差异显著，且城市形态因素的影响存在非平稳性和阈值效应。结果指出，LST不足以捕捉由阴影和辐射过程驱动的人体实际热应激，而天空视域因子对UTCI的变异起核心作用，高反照率反而与更高的UTCI相关。
Motivation: 现有规划研究多依赖LST，但LST能否充分代表人体热暴露及其与生理相关热应激(如UTCI)的差异尚不清楚，需要系统评估。
Method: 提出“建模-比较-评估”框架，使用Landsat 30米LST和GPU加速1米UTCI，结合GW-XGBoost和GAM分析城市二维和三维因素对两种热指标的非平稳和阈值影响。
Result: GW-XGBoost模型测试R²：LST为0.855，UTCI为0.905；天空视域因子对UTCI的变异贡献核心作用，对LST贡献边际；高反照率与更高的UTCI相关。
Conclusion: 研究强调了整合生理相关热指标(如UTCI)以支持以人为本的城市规划和热风险管理的重要性，指出LST不足以反映阴影和辐射驱动的实际热应激。

papers.title: MEDN: Motion-Emotion Feature Decoupling Network for Micro-Expression Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Unlike macro-expression, micro-expression does not follow a strictly consistent mapping rule between emotions and Action Units (AUs). As a result, some micro-expressions share identical AUs yet represent completely opposite emotional categories, making them highly visually similar. Existing microexpression recognition (MER) methods mostly rely on explicit facial motion cues (e.g., optical flow, frame differences, AU features) while ignoring implicit emotion information. To tackle this issue, this paper presents a Motion Emotion Feature Decoupling Network (MEDN) for MER. We design a dual-branch framework to separately extract motion and emotion features. In the motion branch, an AU-detection task restricts features to the explicit motion domain, and orthogonal loss is adopted to reduce motion emotion feature coupling. For implicit emotion modeling, we propose a Sparse Emotion Vision Transformer (SEVit) that sparsifies spatial tokens to highlight local temporal variations with multi-scale sparsity rates. A Collaborative Fusion Module (CoFM) is further developed to fuse disentangled motion and emotion features adaptively. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets validate that MEDN effectively decouples motion and emotion features and achieves superior recognition performance, offering a new perspective for enhancing recognition accuracy and generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对微表情识别中运动与情感特征耦合的问题，提出运动-情感特征解耦网络（MEDN）。通过双分支结构分别提取运动（基于AU检测）和情感（通过稀疏情感视觉Transformer）特征，并利用正交损失降低耦合。实验表明该方法有效提升识别精度和泛化能力。
Motivation: 微表情中同一动作单元可能对应相反情感，传统方法只依赖显式运动线索，忽略隐式情感信息，导致识别困难。
Method: 设计双分支框架：运动分支利用AU检测任务约束特征，并采用正交损失减少耦合；情感分支提出SEVit，通过多尺度稀疏率突出局部时变；再用CoFM自适应融合解耦后的特征。
Result: 在三个基准数据集上验证了MEDN能有效解耦运动与情感特征，并取得优越的识别性能，提升准确率和泛化性。
Conclusion: 该工作为微表情识别提供了新视角，通过特征解耦增强识别效果。

papers.title: Relational Preference Encoding in Looped Transformer Internal States
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how looped transformers encode human preference, training lightweight evaluator heads on frozen Ouro-2.6B loop-iteration states on Anthropic HH-RLHF. v2: an erratum is prepended; the original manuscript is unchanged. A post-publication audit found the three headline results inflated by two independent evaluation errors. The 95.2% pairwise evaluator accuracy is a canonical-ordering artifact: the data were correctly split, but the evaluator learned to prefer the first-presented argument; its strict antisymmetrized accuracy on the full 8,552-pair test set is 63.9%. The 84.5% pairwise probe and the below-chance 21.75% pointwise probe were source-item leaks (orientation rows and pair partners crossing the train/test split); corrected pair-disjoint values are 56.5% and 54.2% -- above chance, so the "inverted polarity" finding is withdrawn. The central finding survives at much smaller magnitude: preference is decoded more accurately relationally than pointwise (paired +2.3 points, 95% CI [+1.3, +3.3]), and the antisymmetrized evaluator still beats the linear probe, but no corrected readout rivals end-to-end reward models. The methodological findings stand (constant-output degeneracy, flip test, swap-protocol metric deflation), with one correction: antisymmetrized accuracy, not antisymmetry correlation, certifies relational discrimination. The two errors are mutually invisible -- a split audit cannot see an ordering prior, antisymmetrization cannot see a leak -- so both checks are required. Full audit in the follow-up work (Kirin, 2026, in preparation).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究循环变压器内部状态如何编码人类偏好，在冻结的Ouro-2.6B循环迭代状态上训练轻量级评估器头，使用Anthropic HH-RLHF数据集。原始版本发布后发现三个主要结果因评估错误被夸大，修正后关系解码准确率仅比逐点解码高2.3个百分点，且修正后的读头无法与端到端奖励模型竞争。方法论发现（常数输出退化、翻转测试、交换协议度量缩减）仍然成立。
Motivation: 探索循环变压器内部状态中是否编码了人类偏好信息，但原始结果因评估错误（典范顺序伪影和数据泄露）被夸大，需要修正。
Method: 在冻结的Ouro-2.6B循环迭代状态上训练线性探针和反对称化评估器，使用Anthropic HH-RLHF数据集，并采用配对比较和逐点解码两种方式。
Result: 修正后，反对称化评估器在完整8552对测试集上的准确率为63.9%，配对探针为56.5%，逐点探针为54.2%；关系解码比逐点解码高2.3个百分点（95% CI [1.3, 3.3]），但修正后的读头均无法与端到端奖励模型竞争。
Conclusion: 反对称化准确率（而非反对称相关性）可验证关系判别能力；需要同时进行分割审计和反对称化检查以避免不可见错误。

papers.title: Synthesizing real-world distributions from high-dimensional Gaussian Noise with Fully Connected Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: The use of synthetic data in machine learning applications and research offers many benefits, including performance improvements through data augmentation and privacy preservation of original samples. This work proposes an efficient synthetic data generation method based on a fully connected neural network that transforms a high-dimensional random Gaussian distribution to approximate a target real-world dataset. The proposed solution combines data preprocessing designed for tabular data with distribution modeling and PCA dimensionality reduction to further enhance data privacy. The work also defines two dedicated randomized loss functions based on Wasserstein distance combined with feature Covariance and a randomized pairwise error reduction loss function. The experiments conducted on 25 diverse tabular real-world datasets confirm that the proposed solution obtains similarity and privacy scores relative to the state-of-the-art generative methods and achieves reference MMD scores orders of magnitude faster than modern deep learning solutions. The experiments involved analyzing distributional similarity, privacy protection, and the utility of synthetic data in classification tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于全连接神经网络的合成数据生成方法，将高维随机高斯分布转换为近似真实表格数据集。方法结合数据预处理、PCA降维和基于Wasserstein距离的随机损失函数。实验在25个数据集上达到与SOTA相当的相似性和隐私分数，且速度比现代深度学习方法快数个数量级。
Motivation: 合成数据在数据增强和隐私保护方面具有价值，但现有生成方法效率较低。本文目标在于提供一种高效且隐私保护的表格数据合成方法。
Method: 使用全连接神经网络将高维高斯噪声映射到目标数据空间；结合表格数据预处理和PCA降维增强隐私；定义两种随机化损失函数：基于Wasserstein距离结合特征协方差，以及随机化成对误差减少损失。
Result: 在25个多样化表格数据集上，该方法在分布相似性和隐私保护上与SOTA相当，但参考MMD分数的计算速度比现代深度学习解决方案快数个数量级。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种高效、隐私保护的表格数据合成方案，在分布相似性和隐私权衡上具有竞争力，且计算效率极高。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种基于全连接神经网络的合成数据生成方法，将高维随机高斯分布转换为近似真实表格数据集。方法结合数据预处理、PCA降维和基于Wasserstein距离的随机损失函数。实验在25个数据集上达到与SOTA相当的相似性和隐私分数，且速度比现代深度学习方法快数个数量级。

papers.title: Lecture notes on Machine Learning applications for global fits
papers.abstract_en: These lecture notes provide a comprehensive framework for performing global statistical fits in high-energy physics using modern Machine Learning (ML) surrogates. We begin by reviewing the statistical foundations of model building, including the likelihood function, Wilks' theorem, and profile likelihoods. Recognizing that the computational cost of evaluating model predictions often renders traditional minimization prohibitive, we introduce Boosted Decision Trees to approximate the log-likelihood function. The notes detail a robust ML workflow including efficient generation of training data with active learning and Gaussian processes, hyperparameter optimization, model compilation for speed-up, and interpretability through SHAP values to decode the influence of model parameters and interactions between parameters. We further discuss posterior distribution sampling using Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). These techniques are finally applied to the $B^\pm \to K^\pm ν\barν$ anomaly at Belle II, demonstrating how a two-stage ML model can efficiently explore the parameter space of Axion-Like Particles (ALPs) while satisfying stringent experimental constraints on decay lengths and flavor-violating couplings.
papers.comment: Lecture notes for the 4th COMCHA School on Computing Challenges in Zaragoza (Spain), 8-15 April 2026. 25 pages, 10 figures, 14 code snippets, 1 appendix. Submission to SciPost Physics Lecture Notes. Fixed minor typos and improved visual presentation of figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这些讲义笔记提供了在高能物理中使用现代机器学习代理进行全局统计拟合的全面框架。首先回顾了模型构建的统计基础，包括似然函数、Wilks定理和剖面似然。鉴于评估模型预测的计算成本常使传统最小化变得不可行，引入Boosted Decision Trees来近似对数似然函数。详细介绍了高效的ML工作流程，包括使用主动学习和高斯过程生成训练数据、超参数优化、模型编译加速以及通过SHAP值进行可解释性。最后将这些技术应用于Belle II的$B^\pm \to K^\pm \nu\bar\nu$异常，展示了如何利用两阶段ML模型有效探索轴子粒子（ALPs）的参数空间，同时满足衰变长度和味改变耦合的严格实验约束。
Motivation: 高能物理中的全局统计拟合常因模型评估计算成本高昂而难以进行传统最小化，需要更高效的方法。
Method: 提出使用Boosted Decision Trees近似对数似然函数，并结合主动学习、高斯过程、超参数优化、模型编译和SHAP值解释性，形成一个完整的ML工作流程。
Result: 将方法应用于Belle II的$B^\pm \to K^\pm \nu\bar\nu$异常，展示了两阶段ML模型能高效探索轴子粒子参数空间并满足实验约束。
Conclusion: 这些笔记为高能物理中的全局拟合提供了一个实用的ML框架，并展示了其在处理具体物理异常时的有效性。

papers.title: Towards Predicting Multi-Vulnerability Attack Chains in Software Supply Chains from Software Bill of Materials Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Software supply chain security compromises often stem from cascaded interactions of vulnerabilities, for example, between multiple vulnerable components. Yet, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)-based pipelines for security analysis typically treat scanner findings as independent per-CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) records. We propose a new research direction based on learning multi-vulnerability attack chains through a novel SBOM-driven graph-learning approach. This treats SBOM structure and scanner outputs as a dependency-constrained evidence graph rather than a flat list of vulnerabilities. We represent vulnerability-enriched CycloneDX SBOMs as heterogeneous graphs whose nodes capture software components and known vulnerabilities (i.e, CVEs), connected by typed relations, such as dependency and vulnerability links. We train a Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network (HGAT) to predict whether a component is associated with at least one known vulnerability as a feasibility check for learning over this structure. Additionally, we frame the discovery of cascading vulnerabilities as CVE-pair link prediction using a lightweight Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) neural network trained on documented multi-vulnerability chains. Validated on 200 real-world SBOMs from the Wild SBOMs public dataset, the HGAT component classifier achieves 91.03% Accuracy and 74.02% F1-score, while the cascade predictor model (MLP) achieves a Receiver Operating Characteristic - Area Under Curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.93 on a seed set of 35 documented attack chains.
papers.comment: Accepted for the ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering (FSE) 2026 Ideas, Visions and Reflections (IVR) Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于SBOM图的学习方法来预测软件供应链中的多漏洞攻击链，将漏洞增强的CycloneDX SBOM表示为异构图，使用HGAT预测组件是否已知漏洞，用MLP预测CVE对的链接关系。在200个真实SBOM上HGAT达到91.03%准确率，级联预测器ROC-AUC为0.93。
Motivation: 现有SBOM安全分析通常将扫描结果作为独立CVE记录处理，忽略了漏洞间的级联交互，无法有效预测多漏洞攻击链。
Method: 将漏洞增强的SBOM表示为异构图（节点为组件和CVE，边为依赖和漏洞关系），训练HGAT进行组件漏洞分类，并训练MLP进行CVE对链接预测以发现级联漏洞。
Result: 在200个真实SBOM上，HGAT组件分类器准确率91.03%，F1分数74.02%；级联预测器在35个已知攻击链上ROC-AUC为0.93。
Conclusion: 摘要表明基于SBOM图的图学习方法能够有效预测多漏洞攻击链，但当前实验规模较小（35个攻击链）且仅作为可行性验证。

papers.title: TSHA: A Benchmark for Visual Language Models in Trustworthy Safety Hazard Assessment Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have accelerated their application to indoor safety hazards assessment. However, existing benchmarks suffer from three fundamental limitations: (1) heavy reliance on synthetic datasets constructed via simulation software, creating a significant domain gap with real-world environments; (2) oversimplified safety tasks with artificial constraints on hazard and scene types, thereby limiting model generalization; and (3) absence of rigorous evaluation protocols to thoroughly assess model capabilities in complex home safety scenarios. To address these challenges, we introduce TSHA (\textbf{T}rustworthy \textbf{S}afety \textbf{H}azards \textbf{A}ssessment), a comprehensive benchmark comprising 66,668 validated question-answer pairs, including 64,961 carefully curated training QA pairs drawn from existing indoor datasets, internet frames/images, AIGC images, newly captured images, and Hunyuan panoramic images. This benchmark also includes a highly challenging test set with 1,707 QA pairs, comprising not only a carefully selected subset from the training distribution but also newly added Sora-generated videos and Hunyuan panoramic images containing multiple safety hazards, used to evaluate the model's robustness in complex safety scenarios. Extensive experiments on 22 popular VLMs demonstrate that current VLMs lack robust capabilities for safety hazard assessment. Importantly, models trained on the TSHA training set achieve a significant performance improvement of up to +18.3 points on the TSHA test set and also exhibit enhanced generalizability across other benchmarks, underscoring the substantial contribution and importance of the TSHA benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TSHA基准，包含66,668个验证过的问答对，用于评估视觉语言模型在真实室内安全危害场景中的能力。基准涵盖多种数据来源，并包含高难度测试集。实验表明，当前模型在安全危害评估上鲁棒性不足，而TSHA训练集可带来高达+18.3点的性能提升，并增强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有安全危害评估基准过度依赖合成数据、任务过于简化且缺乏严格评估协议，导致模型难以泛化到真实复杂场景。
Method: 构建TSHA基准，训练集含64,961个QA对，来自现有室内数据集、网络图像、AIGC图像、新拍摄图像及Hunyuan全景图像；测试集含1,707个QA对，包括分布内子集及Sora视频和Hunyuan全景图像中的多危害场景。
Result: 在22个流行VLM上的实验显示，当前模型缺乏鲁棒能力；在TSHA训练集上训练后，测试集性能最高提升18.3点，并在其他基准上表现出更好的泛化性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调TSHA基准对推动视觉语言模型在真实安全场景应用的重要贡献。
