papers.title: Unsupervised Evaluation of Deep Audio Embeddings for Music Structure Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Music Structure Analysis (MSA) aims to uncover the high-level organization of musical pieces. State-of-the-art methods are often based on supervised deep learning, but these methods are bottlenecked by the need for heavily annotated data and inherent structural ambiguities. In this paper, we propose an unsupervised evaluation of nine open-source, generic pre-trained deep audio models, on MSA. For each model, we extract barwise embeddings and segment them using three unsupervised segmentation algorithms (Foote's checkerboard kernels, spectral clustering, and Correlation Block-Matching (CBM)), focusing exclusively on boundary retrieval. Our results demonstrate that modern, generic deep embeddings generally outperform traditional spectrogram-based baselines, but not systematically. Furthermore, our unsupervised boundary estimation methodology generally yields stronger performance than recent linear probing baselines. Among the evaluated techniques, the CBM algorithm consistently emerges as the most effective downstream segmentation method. Finally, we highlight the artificial inflation of standard evaluation metrics and advocate for the systematic adoption of ``trimming'', or even ``double trimming'' annotations to establish more rigorous MSA evaluation standards.
papers.comment: To be published at the SMC 2026 conference. 2 figures and 2 tables in the main document, 7 figures in Appendix. Code can be found at: https://github.com/ax-le/msa_deep_embeddings. Computed embeddings are uploaded here: https://zenodo.org/records/20155502
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对九种通用的预训练深度音频模型进行无监督评估，用于音乐结构分析。通过提取小节级嵌入并使用三种无监督分割算法（Foote棋盘核、谱聚类、CBM）进行边界检测，发现现代通用深度嵌入通常优于传统频谱基线，但并非总是如此。CBM算法是最有效的下游分割方法，并指出标准评价指标存在人为膨胀，建议采用"修剪"或"双修剪"标注以建立更严格的评估标准。
Motivation: 音乐结构分析的现有监督深度学习方法受限于大量标注数据和结构歧义，需要探索无需标注的无监督评估方式。
Method: 提取九种预训练深度音频模型的小节级嵌入，结合Foote棋盘核、谱聚类和CBM三种无监督分割算法进行边界检索，并对比传统频谱基线。
Result: 现代通用深度嵌入总体优于传统频谱基线但非绝对；无监督边界估计方法优于近期线性探针基线；CBM算法是最有效的下游分割方法；标准评价指标存在人为膨胀。
Conclusion: 建议采用修剪或双修剪标注来建立更严格的音乐结构分析评价标准，并指出通用深度嵌入在无监督场景下的潜力与局限。

papers.title: VAN-AD: Visual Masked Autoencoder with Normalizing Flow For Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) is essential for maintaining the reliability and security of IoT-enabled service systems. Existing methods require training one specific model for each dataset, which exhibits limited generalization capability across different target datasets, hindering anomaly detection performance in various scenarios with scarce training data. To address this limitation, foundation models have emerged as a promising direction. However, existing approaches either repurpose large language models (LLMs) or construct largescale time series datasets to develop general anomaly detection foundation models, and still face challenges caused by severe cross-modal gaps or in-domain heterogeneity. In this paper, we investigate the applicability of large-scale vision models to TSAD. Specifically, we adapt a visual Masked Autoencoder (MAE) pretrained on ImageNet to the TSAD task. However, directly transferring MAE to TSAD introduces two key challenges: overgeneralization and limited local perception. To address these challenges, we propose VAN-AD, a novel MAE-based framework for TSAD. To alleviate the over-generalization issue, we design an Adaptive Distribution Mapping Module (ADMM), which maps the reconstruction results before and after MAE into a unified statistical space to amplify discrepancies caused by abnormal patterns. To overcome the limitation of local perception, we further develop a Normalizing Flow Module (NFM), which combines MAE with normalizing flow to estimate the probability density of the current window under the global distribution. Extensive experiments on nine real-world datasets demonstrate that VAN-AD consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods across multiple evaluation metrics.We make our code and datasets available at https://github.com/PenyChen/VAN-AD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VAN-AD，一个基于视觉掩码自编码器（MAE）和归一化流的时间序列异常检测框架，旨在解决直接迁移视觉 MAE 到时间序列任务时的过泛化与局部感知不足问题，在9个真实数据集上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测方法需要为每个数据集单独训练模型，泛化能力差；而基于大语言模型或大规模时间序列数据集的 foundation model 方法面临跨模态鸿沟或域内异质性挑战。
Method: 从 ImageNet 预训练的视觉 MAE 出发，设计自适应分布映射模块（ADMM）将 MAE 前后的重构结果映射到统一统计空间以放大异常差异；并结合归一化流模块（NFM）估计当前窗口的全局分布概率密度。
Result: 在9个真实数据集上，VAN-AD 在多个评估指标上一致优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 视觉 MAE 结合归一化流可有效用于时间序列异常检测，缓解过泛化与局部感知不足问题；代码与数据集已开源。

papers.title: Contrastive Conformal Sets
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive learning produces coherent semantic feature embeddings by encouraging positive samples to cluster closely while separating negative samples. However, existing contrastive learning methods lack a principled construction of geometric sets in the semantic feature space with distribution-free guarantees at any user-specified coverage level. We extend conformal prediction to this setting by introducing covering sets equipped with learnable generalized hyper-ball constraints. We propose a method that constructs conformal sets guaranteeing user-specified coverage of positive samples while maximizing negative sample exclusion. We theoretically motivate volume minimization as a proxy for negative exclusion, enabling our approach to operate effectively even when negative pairs are unavailable. The positive inclusion guarantee inherits the distribution-free coverage property of conformal prediction, while negative exclusion is maximized through learned set geometry optimized on a held-out training split. Experiments on simulated and real-world image datasets demonstrate improved inclusion-exclusion trade-offs compared to standard distance-based conformal baselines.

papers.title: From Stateless to Situated: Building a Psychological World for LLM-Based Agents
papers.abstract_en: In psychological support and emotional companionship scenarios, the core limitation of large language models (LLMs) lies not merely in response quality, but in their reliance on local next-token prediction, which prevents them from maintaining the temporal continuity, stage awareness, and user consent boundaries required for multi-turn intervention. This stateless characteristic makes systems prone to premature advancement, stage misalignment, and boundary violations in continuous dialogue. To address this problem, we argue that the key challenge in process-oriented emotional support is not simply generating natural language, but constructing a sustainably updatable external situational structure for the model. We therefore propose LEKIA 2.0, a situated LLM architecture that separates the cognitive layer from the executive layer, thereby decoupling situational modeling from intervention execution. This design enables the system to maintain stable representations of the user's situation and consent boundaries throughout ongoing interaction. To evaluate this process-control capability, we further introduce a Static-to-Dynamic online evaluation protocol for multi-turn interaction. LEKIA achieved an average absolute improvement of approximately 31% over prompt-only baselines in deep intervention loop completion. The results suggest that an external situational structure is a key enabling condition for building stable, controllable, and situated emotional support systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM在心理支持场景中因无状态特性导致的阶段错位和边界侵犯问题，提出LEKIA 2.0架构，通过分离认知层与执行层来构建外部情境结构，使系统能维护用户状态和同意边界的稳定表示。在深度干预循环完成率上相比纯提示基线提升约31%。
Motivation: 现有LLM依赖局部next-token预测，缺乏多轮对话所需的时间连续性和阶段意识，容易过早推进或越界，限制了过程导向的情感支持效果。
Method: 提出LEKIA 2.0，一种将认知层与执行层分离的情境化LLM架构，实现情境建模与干预执行的解耦，并设计静态到动态的在线评估协议。
Result: 在深度干预循环完成率上，LEKIA比纯提示基线平均绝对提升约31%。
Conclusion: 研究表明外部情境结构是构建稳定、可控和情境化情感支持系统的关键条件。

papers.title: Autoregressive Guidance of Deep Spatially Selective Filters using Bayesian Tracking for Efficient Extraction of Moving Speakers
papers.abstract_en: Deep spatially selective filters achieve high-quality enhancement with real-time capable architectures for stationary speakers of known directions. To retain this level of performance in dynamic scenarios where only the speakers' initial directions are given, accurate, yet computationally lightweight tracking algorithms become necessary. Assuming a frame-wise causal processing style, temporal feedback allows for leveraging the enhanced speech signal to improve tracking performance. In this work, we investigate strategies to incorporate the enhanced signal into lightweight tracking algorithms and autoregressively guide deep spatial filters. Our proposed Bayesian tracking algorithms are compatible with arbitrary deep spatial filters. To increase the realism of simulated trajectories during development and evaluation, we develop a synthetic data generation framework based on the social force model. Results validate that the autoregressive incorporation significantly improves the accuracy of our Bayesian trackers, resulting in superior enhancement with none or only negligibly increased computational overhead. Real-world recordings complement these findings and demonstrate the generalizability of our methods to unseen acoustic conditions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自回归引导的贝叶斯跟踪算法，用于深度空间选择性滤波器在动态场景下提取移动说话人。该方法兼容任意深度空间滤波器，并通过增强语音信号反馈提高跟踪精度，而计算开销几乎不增加。基于社会力模型的合成数据生成框架提高了轨迹的真实性，真实世界录音验证了方法的泛化性。
Motivation: 现有深度空间选择性滤波器在已知方向的静态说话人上效果优秀，但在动态场景下仅知道初始方向时，需要轻量级且精确的跟踪算法来维持性能。
Method: 提出自回归引导策略，将增强后的语音信号反馈给轻量级贝叶斯跟踪算法，从而引导深度空间滤波器。跟踪算法基于贝叶斯推断，兼容任意深度空间滤波器。并开发了基于社会力模型的合成数据生成框架模拟真实轨迹。
Result: 自回归引导显著提高了贝叶斯跟踪器的准确性，从而提升了增强效果，且计算开销几乎不增加。真实世界录音验证了方法对未见声学条件的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 自回归引导的贝叶斯跟踪能有效提升动态场景下深度空间选择性滤波器的表现，且具有轻量级和通用性。

papers.title: Echoes: A semantically-aligned music deepfake detection dataset
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Echoes, a new dataset for music deepfake detection designed for training and benchmarking detectors under realistic and provider-diverse conditions. Echoes comprises 4,468 tracks (131 hours of audio) spanning multiple genres (pop, rock, electronic), and includes content generated by ten popular AI music generation systems. To prevent shortcut learning and promote robust generalization, the dataset is deliberately constructed to be challenging, enforcing semantic-level alignment between spoofed audio and bona fide references. This alignment is achieved by conditioning generated audio samples directly on bona-fide waveforms or song descriptors. We evaluate Echoes in a cross-dataset setting against three existing AI-generated music datasets using state-of-the-art Wav2Vec2 XLS-R 2B representations. Results show that (i) Echoes is the hardest in-domain dataset; (ii) detectors trained on existing datasets transfer poorly to Echoes; (iii) training on Echoes yields the strongest generalization performance. These findings suggest that provider diversity and semantic alignment help learn more transferable detection cues.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了Echoes，一个用于音乐深度伪造检测的新数据集。该数据集包含4468首歌曲（131小时），涵盖多种流派和10个AI音乐系统。它通过语义级对齐（基于真实波形或歌曲描述）生成深伪样本，以强制检测器学习鲁棒特征。跨数据集评估显示，Echoes是难度最大的域内数据集，且在其上训练的模型泛化性能最好。
Motivation: 现有音乐深伪检测数据集缺乏提供者多样性，且样本与真实音频之间语义不一致，导致检测器易利用虚假捷径。
Method: 构建Echoes数据集，包含10个AI音乐系统的深伪样本，并通过条件生成实现与真实音频的语义对齐。使用Wav2Vec2 XLS-R 2B表征进行跨数据集评估。
Result: 摘要报告（i）Echoes是域内最难的数据集；（ii）现有数据集训练的检测器在Echoes上表现差；（iii）在Echoes上训练的模型泛化能力最强。
Conclusion: 提供者多样性和语义对齐有助于学习更具迁移性的检测线索。

papers.title: ME-IQA: Memory-Enhanced Image Quality Assessment via Re-Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-induced vision-language models (VLMs) advance image quality assessment (IQA) with textual reasoning, yet their scalar scores often lack sensitivity and collapse to a few values, so-called discrete collapse. We introduce ME-IQA, a plug-and-play, test-time memory-enhanced re-ranking framework. It (i) builds a memory bank and retrieves semantically and perceptually aligned neighbors using reasoning summaries, (ii) reframes the VLM as a probabilistic comparator to obtain pairwise preference probabilities and fuse this ordinal evidence with the initial score under Thurstone's Case V model, and (iii) performs gated reflection and consolidates memory to improve future decisions. This yields denser, distortion-sensitive predictions and mitigates discrete collapse. Experiments across multiple IQA benchmarks show consistent gains over strong reasoning-induced VLM baselines, existing non-reasoning IQA methods, and test-time scaling alternatives.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对推理型视觉语言模型（VLM）在图像质量评估（IQA）中输出的标量分数缺乏敏感性且容易坍塌为少数值的问题（离散塌陷），提出ME-IQA框架。该框架是一种即插即用、测试时增强的重排序方法，通过构建记忆库并利用推理摘要检索语义与感知一致邻居，将VLM重定位为概率比较器以获取成对偏好概率，并基于Thurstone's Case V模型融合序数证据与初始分数，同时采用门控反射与记忆巩固改进后续决策。实验表明，该方法在多个IQA基准上持续优于强推理型VLM基线、现有非推理型IQA方法以及测试时缩放替代方案。
Motivation: 现有推理型VLM在IQA中输出的标量分数往往缺乏对细微失真的敏感性，且倾向于坍塌为少数几个离散值（离散塌陷），限制了评估的准确性。
Method: 提出ME-IQA框架：（1）构建记忆库，基于推理摘要检索语义与感知对齐的邻居；（2）将VLM重新表述为概率比较器，获得成对偏好概率，并使用Thurstone's Case V模型将序数证据与初始分数融合；（3）执行门控反射与记忆巩固以提升未来决策。
Result: 在多个IQA基准数据集上，该方法相较于强推理型VLM基线、非推理型IQA方法以及测试时缩放替代方案均取得一致提升。
Conclusion: ME-IQA通过记忆增强的重排序策略有效缓解了离散塌陷，生成了更密集、对失真更敏感的预测分数，且作为即插即用模块可适配现有推理型VLM。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: REST: Receding Horizon Explorative Steiner Tree for Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot object-goal navigation (ZSON) requires navigating unknown environments to find a target object without task-specific training. Prior hierarchical solutions mainly focus on either scene understanding and representations (belief) or high-level decision-making and planning (policy), yet treat the option, i.e., the subgoal candidate that belief proposes and policy selects, as an interface inherited from adjacent modules rather than a design axis in its own right. In practice, options are predominantly single waypoints scored by destination utility: a lone destination hides the value gathered en route, and a flat list obscures the relationships among candidates. Our insight is that the option space should be a tree of paths. Full paths expose en-route information gain that destination-only scoring systematically neglects; a tree of shared segments enables coarse-to-fine LLM reasoning that dismisses or pursues entire branches before examining individual leaves, compressing the combinatorial path space into an efficient hierarchy. We instantiate this insight in REST (Receding Horizon Explorative Steiner Tree), a training-free framework that (1) builds an explicit open-vocabulary 3D map from online RGB-D streams; (2) grows an agent-centric tree of safe and informative paths as the option space via sampling-based planning; and (3) textualizes each branch into a spatial narrative and selects the next-best path through chain-of-thought LLM reasoning. Across the Gibson, HM3D, and HSSD benchmarks, REST consistently ranks among the top methods in success rate and path efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REST框架，一种无需训练的零样本目标导航方法。通过在线RGB-D流构建开词汇3D地图，生长以智能体为中心的路径树作为选项空间，并将分支文本化为空间叙述供LLM链式思维推理选择下一个最佳路径。在Gibson、HM3D和HSSD基准上，REST在成功率和路径效率上均排名靠前。
Motivation: 现有零样本目标导航方法将子目标视为模块接口，忽视路径上的信息增益和候选项间关系，导致目标评分不全面。本文提出选项空间应为路径树，以暴露路径上信息增益并支持层次化推理。
Method: 提出REST框架，包含三步：(1) 从在线RGB-D流构建显式开词汇3D地图；(2) 通过采样规划生成智能体中心的路径树作为选项空间；(3) 将每个分支文本化为空间叙述，利用LLM链式思维推理选择下一个最佳路径，整个过程无需训练。
Result: 在Gibson、HM3D和HSSD三个基准上，REST在成功率和路径效率指标上均达到领先水平。
Conclusion: 通过将选项空间表示为路径树并利用LLM进行层次化推理，REST有效提升了零样本目标导航的性能和效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automated identification of Ichneumonoidea wasps via YOLO-based deep learning: Integrating HiresCam for Explainable AI
papers.abstract_en: Accurate taxonomic identification of parasitoid wasps within the superfamily Ichneumonoidea is essential for biodiversity assessment, ecological monitoring, and biological control programs. However, morphological similarity, small body size, and fine-grained interspecific variation make manual identification labor-intensive and expertise-dependent. This study proposes a deep learning-based framework for the automated identification of Ichneumonoidea wasps using a YOLO-based architecture integrated with High-Resolution Class Activation Mapping (HiResCAM) to enhance interpretability. The proposed system simultaneously identifies wasp families from high-resolution images. The dataset comprises 3556 high-resolution images of Hymenoptera specimens. The taxonomic distribution is primarily concentrated among the families Ichneumonidae (n = 786), Braconidae (n = 648), Apidae (n = 466), and Vespidae (n = 460). Extensive experiments were conducted using a curated dataset, with model performance evaluated through precision, recall, F1 score, and accuracy. The results demonstrate high accuracy of over 96 % and robust generalization across morphological variations. HiResCAM visualizations confirm that the model focuses on taxonomically relevant anatomical regions, such as wing venation, antennae segmentation, and metasomal structures, thereby validating the biological plausibility of the learned features. The integration of explainable AI techniques improves transparency and trustworthiness, making the system suitable for entomological research to accelerate biodiversity characterization in an under-described parasitoid superfamily.

papers.title: PhasorFlow: A Python Library for Unit Circle Based Computing
papers.abstract_en: We present PhasorFlow, an open-source Python library for computing on the $S^1$ unit circle. Inputs are encoded as complex phasors $z=e^{iφ}$ on the $N$-torus ($\mathbb{T}^N$); as computation proceeds through unitary wave-interference gates, global norm is preserved while components drift into $\mathbb{C}^N$, letting algorithms leverage continuous geometric gradients. PhasorFlow makes three contributions. First, we formalize the Phasor Circuit model ($N$ threads, $M$ gates) with a 22-gate library spanning standard-unitary, non-linear, neuromorphic, and encoding operations under full matrix-algebra simulation. Second, we introduce the Variational Phasor Circuit (VPC), a trainable phase-native classifier analogous to variational quantum circuits. Third, we introduce the Phasor Transformer block and Large Phasor Model (LPM), replacing $QK^TV$ attention with a parameter-free DFT token-mixing layer. We validate the framework on financial volatility detection, neuromorphic associative memory, neural binding, period finding, and algorithmic logic applications that are unique to the library. This positions unit-circle computing as a deterministic, lightweight paradigm on classical hardware. Available at https://github.com/mindverse-computing/phasorflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PhasorFlow，一个开源Python库，用于在S^1单位圆上计算。输入为复相量，通过酉波干涉门保持全局范数，利用连续几何梯度。贡献包括：形式化Phasor电路模型（22门库）、变分Phasor电路（VPC）、Phasor Transformer块和大型Phasor模型（LPM），用DFT令牌混合层替代注意力。在金融波动检测等任务上验证，定位为单位圆计算的确定性轻量级范式。
Motivation: 现有计算范式在处理单位圆上的连续几何梯度方面缺乏高效的库支持，特别是对于需要保持范数的计算。
Method: 设计Phasor电路模型和VPC，引入Phasor Transformer块使用参数无关的DFT令牌混合层。
Result: 在金融波动检测、神经形态联想记忆、神经绑定、周期查找和算法逻辑应用中验证了框架有效性。
Conclusion: 单位圆计算可作为经典硬件上的确定性轻量级计算范式。

papers.title: AgentWorm: Self-Propagating Attacks Across LLM Agent Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous LLM-based agents increasingly operate as long-running processes forming densely interconnected multi-agent ecosystems, whose security properties remain largely unexplored. Systems such as OpenClaw, an open-source platform with over 40{,}000 active instances, persistent configurations, tool-execution privileges, and cross-platform messaging, are deployed at scale, yet the security of such agent ecosystems remains largely unexplored. This work presents AgentWorm, the first self-replicating worm attack against a production-scale agent framework, achieving a fully autonomous infection cycle initiated by a single message: the worm first hijacks the victim's core configuration to establish persistent presence across session restarts, then executes an arbitrary payload upon each reboot, and finally propagates itself to every newly encountered peer without further attacker intervention. The attack is evaluated on a controlled testbed across five distinct LLM backends, three infection vectors, and three payload types. Results show a 63\% aggregate attack success rate, sustained multi-hop propagation, and stark divergences in model security postures, highlighting that while execution-level filtering effectively mitigates dormant payloads, skill supply chains remain universally vulnerable. Defenses are evaluated at three layers (prompt-level mitigations sourced from real community practice, the framework's built-in security controls, and an ecosystem-wide measurement of public configurations), revealing that the critical controls capable of breaking the infection loop are not enabled in any of the observed deployments. A cross-framework transferability experiment on Hermes Agent confirms that the underlying vulnerabilities are properties of the autonomous agent design pattern, not artifacts of a single implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentWorm，首个针对生产级LLM代理框架的自复制蠕虫攻击，通过单条消息实现完全自主感染循环。攻击在受控测试床上评估，涉及5种LLM后端、3种感染向量和3种载荷类型，结果显示63%的总体攻击成功率，持续的多跳传播，以及模型安全姿态的显著差异。防御评估揭示了关键控制措施在真实部署中未被启用。
Motivation: 自主LLM代理正形成密集互联的多代理生态系统，其安全特性尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出AgentWorm攻击，通过劫持受害者核心配置实现持久化，重启时执行任意载荷，并自动传播给新遇到的同伴。
Result: 在受控测试床上，攻击成功率达63%，支持多跳传播，且不同LLM后端安全表现差异显著；执行级过滤只能缓解休眠载荷，技能供应链普遍易受攻击。
Conclusion: 该攻击暴露了自主代理设计模式的内在漏洞，而非单个实现的缺陷，防御措施需在多层面上加固。

papers.title: Beyond Medical Diagnostics: How Medical Multimodal Large Language Models Think in Space
papers.abstract_en: Visual spatial intelligence is critical for medical image interpretation, yet remains largely unexplored in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for 3D imaging. This gap persists due to a systemic lack of datasets featuring structured 3D spatial annotations beyond basic labels. In this study, we introduce an agentic pipeline that autonomously synthesizes spatial visual question-answering (VQA) data by orchestrating computational tools such as volume estimation and bounding boxes extraction with multi-agent collaboration and expert radiologist validation. We present SpatialMed, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating 3D spatial intelligence in medical MLLMs, comprising 31,253 question-answer pairs across multiple organs and tumor types. Our evaluations on 24 state-of-the-art MLLMs and extensive analyses reveal that current models lack robust spatial reasoning capabilities for medical imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型在3D医学影像中空间智能缺失的问题，提出一个自动化合成空间视觉问答数据的代理管道，并构建了首个综合基准SpatialMed（含31,253个问答对）。在24个先进MLLM上的评估显示，当前模型缺乏鲁棒的医学影像空间推理能力。
Motivation: 医学影像解释需要视觉空间智能，但现有MLLM在3D成像中的空间推理研究空白，主要原因在于缺乏结构化3D空间标注的数据集。
Method: 提出一个多智能体协作的代理管道，自动调用体积估计、边界框提取等计算工具，结合放射科专家验证，合成空间VQA数据，并构建基准SpatialMed。
Result: 在24个SOTA多模态大语言模型上的评估表明，当前模型在医学影像空间推理任务上表现不佳，缺乏鲁棒的空间理解能力。
Conclusion: 摘要指出当前模型在医学影像3D空间理解上的显著不足，并提供了评估基准SpatialMed，呼吁进一步研究。

papers.title: Human Motion Data Alone Does Not Guarantee Plausible Gait Biomechanics
papers.abstract_en: Motion imitation learning (IL) is increasingly used in robotics and human gait modeling, yet its ability to recover biomechanically consistent joint moments without explicit kinetic information remains unclear. In this study, we examined whether motion imitation alone can estimate reasonable biological joint moments. We compare motion-only IL (MOIL) against a kinetics-aware IL (KAIL) framework that incorporates ground reaction forces (GRF) and center of pressure (CoP) in imitation rewards, with an ablation study to examine the contribution of each kinetic term. Experiments were conducted using walking data from a non-disabled participant at three speeds (0.9, 1.2, and 1.5 m/s). While both MOIL and KAIL achieved comparable kinematic tracking accuracy, MOIL exhibited substantially larger errors in GRF, CoP, and joint moment estimates relative to inverse dynamics references. In contrast, KAIL produced kinetics more consistent with biomechanical values. These findings highlight a fundamental limitation of MOIL approaches, which may lead to erroneous interpretations of gait biomechanics and downstream applications by failing to estimate consistent human-like gait kinetics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究仅基于运动数据的模仿学习（MOIL）能否恢复合理的步态生物力学。实验表明，MOIL虽能达到与动力学感知方法（KAIL）相当的关节角度精度，但在地面反作用力、压力中心和关节力矩估计上存在较大误差，说明仅靠运动数据无法保证动力学一致性。
Motivation: 运动模仿学习在机器人步态建模中广泛应用，但能否输出生物力学上一致的关节力矩尚不清楚。缺乏显式动力学信息可能导致下游步态分析错误。
Method: 对比仅运动数据的模仿学习（MOIL）与加入地面反作用力（GRF）和压力中心（CoP）奖励的动力学感知框架（KAIL），并通过消融实验分析各动力学项的贡献。
Result: MOIL与KAIL的关节角度跟踪精度相近，但MOIL在GRF、CoP和关节力矩估计上误差显著大于逆动力学参考值；KAIL则产生更符合生物力学的结果。
Conclusion: 仅依赖运动数据的模仿学习无法可靠估计人体步态动力学，可能导致错误的下游应用。

papers.title: PanoAffordanceNet: Towards Holistic Affordance Grounding in 360° Indoor Environments
papers.abstract_en: Global perception is essential for embodied agents in 360° spaces, yet current affordance grounding remains largely object-centric and restricted to perspective views. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel task: Holistic Affordance Grounding in 360° Indoor Environments. This task faces unique challenges, including severe geometric distortions from Equirectangular Projection (ERP), semantic dispersion, and cross-scale alignment difficulties. We propose PanoAffordanceNet, an end-to-end framework featuring a Distortion-Aware Spectral Modulator (DASM) for latitude-dependent calibration and an Omni-Spherical Densification Head (OSDH) to restore topological continuity from sparse activations. By integrating multi-level constraints comprising pixel-wise, distributional, and region-text contrastive objectives, our framework effectively suppresses semantic drift under low supervision. Furthermore, we construct 360-AGD, the first high-quality panoramic affordance grounding dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PanoAffordanceNet significantly outperforms existing methods, establishing a solid baseline for scene-level perception in embodied intelligence. The source code and benchmark dataset will be made publicly available at https://github.com/GL-ZHU925/PanoAffordanceNet.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE/RSJ IROS 2026. The source code and benchmark dataset will be made publicly available at https://github.com/GL-ZHU925/PanoAffordanceNet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出全景室内环境中的整体功能接地（holistic affordance grounding）任务，并设计PanoAffordanceNet端到端框架。该框架包含畸变感知光谱调制器（DASM）和全球密度化头部（OSDH），结合像素级、分布级和区域-文本对比多级约束，有效抑制语义漂移。同时构建了首个高质量全景功能接地数据集360-AGD，实验表明所提方法显著优于现有方法，为具身智能的场景级感知建立了强基线。
Motivation: 现有功能接地（affordance grounding）多局限于透视视图且以物体为中心，无法满足360°空间中具身智能体对全局感知的需求，且360°图像存在Equirectangular Projection（ERP）导致的严重几何畸变、语义分散和跨尺度对齐困难等挑战。
Method: 提出PanoAffordanceNet，包含纬度相关的Distortion-Aware Spectral Modulator（DASM）用于畸变校准，以及Omni-Spherical Densification Head（OSDH）从稀疏激活恢复拓扑连续性。训练中集成像素级、分布级和区域-文本对比多级约束，以抑制低监督下的语义漂移。
Result: 在自建数据集360-AGD上，PanoAffordanceNet显著优于现有方法，为场景级全景功能接地任务建立了可靠的基线性能。
Conclusion: 本文首次定义了360°室内环境中的整体功能接地任务，并提供了有效解决方案和基准数据集，但摘要未明确提及局限性与适用范围。

papers.title: InfoFlow KV: Information-Flow-Aware KV Recomputation for Long Context
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for long-context question answering is bottlenecked by inference-time prefilling over large retrieved contexts. A common strategy is to precompute key-value (KV) caches for individual documents and selectively recompute a small subset of tokens to restore global causal dependencies, but existing methods rely on heuristics or representation discrepancies without modeling whether selected tokens can effectively influence generation. We cast selective KV recomputation as an information flow problem and show that a simple attention-norm signal from the query reliably identifies tokens that are both semantically relevant and structurally positioned to propagate information, when computed under an inference-consistent RoPE geometry. We therefore reconstruct global positional assignments for retrieved chunks and introduce an information-flow-guided chunk reordering strategy. Experiments on Large Language Model and Vision-Language Model benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains over prior methods under comparable latency.

TL;DR: 本文针对长上下文RAG中推理时预填充瓶颈，提出基于信息流的KV缓存选择性重计算方法。通过查询的注意力范数信号可靠识别语义相关且结构上能传播信息的令牌，在推理一致的RoPE几何下重构检索块的位置分配，并引入信息流引导的块重排序策略。实验表明在LLM和VLM基准上，该方法在可比延迟下持续优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有选择性KV重计算方法依赖启发式或表示差异，未建模所选令牌能否有效影响生成。
Method: 将选择性KV重计算建模为信息流问题，利用推理一致RoPE几何下的查询注意力范数信号识别关键令牌，并重构全局位置分配和块重排序。
Result: 在LLM和VLM基准上，该方法在可比延迟下持续优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 信息流感知的KV重计算能更有效地选择对生成有实际影响的令牌，提升长上下文RAG效率。

papers.title: Teacher-Guided Causal Interventions for Image Denoising: Orthogonal Content-Noise Disentanglement in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Conventional image denoising models often inadvertently learn spurious correlations between environmental factors and noise patterns. Moreover, due to high-frequency ambiguity, they struggle to reliably distinguish subtle textures from stochastic noise, resulting in over-removed details or residual noise artifacts. We therefore revisit denoising via causal intervention, arguing that purely correlational fitting entangles intrinsic content with extrinsic noise, which directly degrades robustness under distribution shifts. Motivated by this, we propose the Teacher-Guided Causal Disentanglement Network (TCD-Net), which explicitly decomposes the generative mechanism via structured interventions on feature spaces within a Vision Transformer framework. Specifically, our method integrates three key components: (1) An Environmental Bias Adjustment (EBA) module projects features into a stable, de-centered subspace to suppress global environmental bias (de-confounding). (2) A dual-branch disentanglement head employs an orthogonality constraint to force a strict separation between content and noise representations, preventing information leakage. (3) To resolve structural ambiguity, we leverage Nano Banana Pro, Google's reasoning-guided AI image generation model, to guide a causal prior, effectively pulling content representations back onto the natural-image manifold. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TCD-Net outperforms mainstream methods across multiple benchmarks in both fidelity and efficiency, achieving a real-time speed of 104.2 FPS on a single RTX 5090 GPU.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, and 5 tables. Revised manuscript. Kuai Jiang and Zhaoyan Ding contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Teacher-Guided Causal Disentanglement Network (TCD-Net)，用于图像去噪，通过因果干预和正交约束在 Vision Transformer 中分离内容与噪声表示，并利用 Nano Banana Pro 模型提供因果先验。实验表明在多个基准上超越主流方法，在 RTX 5090 上达到 104.2 FPS。
Motivation: 传统去噪模型容易学习环境因素与噪声模式之间的虚假相关，且由于高频模糊性难以区分细节纹理与随机噪声，导致过度平滑或残留伪影。
Method: 提出 TCD-Net，包含三个组件：①环境偏置调整模块 (EBA) 将特征投影到稳定子空间以抑制全局环境偏置；②双分支解耦头通过正交约束严格分离内容与噪声表示；③利用 Nano Banana Pro (推理引导的 AI 图像生成模型) 提供因果先验，将内容表示拉回自然图像流形。
Result: 在多个基准上，TCD-Net 在保真度和效率上均优于主流方法，在单张 RTX 5090 GPU 上达到 104.2 FPS 的实时速度。
Conclusion: 通过显式解耦内容与噪声的生成机制，所提方法在鲁棒性和效率上取得提升，尤其适用于分布偏移场景。

papers.title: PhotoAgent: Exploratory Visual Aesthetic Planning with Large Vision Models
papers.abstract_en: With the recent fast development of generative models, instruction-based image editing has shown great potential in generating high-quality images. However, the quality of editing highly depends on carefully designed instructions, placing the burden of task decomposition and sequencing entirely on the user. To achieve autonomous image editing, we present PhotoAgent, a system that advances image editing through explicit aesthetic planning. Specifically, PhotoAgent formulates autonomous image editing as a long-horizon decision-making problem. It reasons over user aesthetic intent, plans multi-step editing actions via tree search, and iteratively refines results through closed-loop execution with memory and visual feedback, without requiring step-by-step user prompts. To support reliable evaluation in real-world scenarios, we introduce UGC-Edit, an aesthetic evaluation benchmark consisting of 7,000 photos and a learned aesthetic reward model. We also construct a test set containing 1,017 photos to systematically assess autonomous photo editing performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhotoAgent consistently improves both instruction adherence and visual quality compared with baseline methods. The project page is https://mdyao.github.io/PhotoAgent/.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 Oral. A fully automated, intelligent photo-editing agent that autonomously plans multi-step aesthetic enhancements, smartly chooses diverse editing tools, and enables everyday users to achieve professional-looking results without crafting complex prompts. Project page: https://mdyao.github.io/PhotoAgent/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PhotoAgent，将自主图像编辑转化为长时决策问题，通过树搜索规划多步美学编辑，并利用记忆与视觉反馈进行闭环迭代优化。同时构建 UGC-Edit 基准（7000 张照片）和美学奖励模型，在 1017 张照片测试集上验证了指令遵循和视觉质量的提升。
Motivation: 现有指令驱动图像编辑依赖用户手动分解任务和设计提示，缺乏自动化美学规划能力。
Method: 将自主图像编辑建模为长时决策问题，通过树搜索推理用户美学意图并规划多步编辑动作，结合记忆和视觉反馈进行闭环执行，无需逐步用户提示。
Result: 在自建测试集上，PhotoAgent 相比基线方法一致提升了指令遵循度和视觉质量。
Conclusion: 提出的显式美学规划框架可让普通用户无需复杂提示即可获得专业级编辑效果。

papers.title: Quality-Aware Robust Multi-View Clustering for Heterogeneous Observation Noise
papers.abstract_en: Deep multi-view clustering has achieved remarkable progress but remains vulnerable to complex noise in real-world applications. Existing noisy robust methods predominantly rely on a simplified binary assumption, treating data as either perfectly clean or completely corrupted. This overlooks the prevalent existence of heterogeneous observation noise, where contamination intensity varies continuously across data. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel framework termed Quality-Aware Robust Multi-View Clustering (QARMVC). Specifically, QARMVC employs an information bottleneck mechanism to extract intrinsic semantics for view reconstruction. Leveraging the insight that noise disrupts semantic integrity and impedes reconstruction, we utilize the resulting reconstruction discrepancy to precisely quantify fine-grained contamination intensity and derive instance-level quality scores. These scores are integrated into a hierarchical learning strategy: at the feature level, a quality-weighted contrastive objective is designed to adaptively suppress the propagation of noise; at the fusion level, a high-quality global consensus is constructed via quality-weighted aggregation, which is subsequently utilized to align and rectify local views via mutual information maximization. Extensive experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate that QARMVC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, particularly in scenarios with heterogeneous noise intensities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度多视图聚类中存在的异构观测噪声问题，提出质量感知鲁棒多视图聚类框架（QARMVC）。该方法利用信息瓶颈机制提取语义进行视图重建，根据重建差异量化噪声强度得到实例级质量分数，并设计质量加权对比学习和质量加权融合策略来抑制噪声。在五个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在异构噪声场景下优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有鲁棒聚类方法通常假设噪声是二元的（干净或完全损坏），忽略了实际应用中噪声强度连续变化的异构观测噪声，导致性能受限。
Method: QARMVC采用信息瓶颈（information bottleneck）提取内在语义用于视图重建，通过重建残差精确量化每个实例的污染程度，得到质量分数。随后在特征层引入质量加权对比学习自适应抑制噪声传播，在融合层构建质量加权全局共识，并通过互信息最大化对齐和修正局部视图。
Result: 在五个基准数据集上，QARMVC一致优于最先进的基线方法，尤其在异构噪声强度场景下表现更佳。
Conclusion: 该工作提出了一种处理异构观测噪声的有效框架，通过细粒度的质量感知机制提升了多视图聚类的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Pretty Isn't Useful: Investigating Why Modern Text-to-Image Models Fail as Reliable Training Data Generators
papers.abstract_en: Recent text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models produce visually stunning images and demonstrate excellent prompt following. But do they perform well as synthetic vision data generators? In this work, we revisit the promise of synthetic data as a scalable substitute for real training sets and uncover a surprising performance regression. We generate large-scale synthetic datasets using state-of-the-art T2I models released between 2022 and 2025, train standard classifiers solely on this synthetic data, and evaluate them on real test data. Despite observable advances in visual fidelity and prompt adherence, classification accuracy on real test data consistently declines with newer T2I models as training data generators. Our analysis reveals a hidden trend: These models collapse to a narrow, aesthetic-centric distribution that undermines diversity and real data distribution coverage. Overall, our findings challenge a growing assumption in vision research, namely that progress in generative realism implies progress in data realism. We thus highlight an urgent need to rethink the capabilities of modern T2I models as reliable training data generators.
papers.comment: Accepted to CVPR26, Project Page: https://bill2462.github.io/When-Pretty-Isn-t-Useful-page/, Code: https://github.com/Bill2462/When-Pretty-Isn-t-Useful-codebase
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了现代文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型作为合成视觉数据生成器的可靠性。尽管这些模型在视觉真实感和提示遵循方面取得了显著进步，但使用2022至2025年间发布的先进模型生成大规模合成数据集并训练标准分类器后，在真实测试数据上的分类准确率却持续下降。分析表明，这些模型生成的数据分布逐渐坍缩到狭窄、以美学为中心的分布，牺牲了多样性和与真实分布的覆盖度，从而挑战了“生成真实感提升意味着数据真实感提升”的普遍假设。
Motivation: 当前视觉研究领域普遍假设更真实的生成模型能产生更可靠的训练数据，但实际中观察到了性能回归，需要系统性验证这一假设。
Method: 使用2022至2025年间发布的先进T2I模型生成大规模合成数据集，并仅用这些数据训练标准分类器，然后在真实测试集上评估性能。
Result: 实验发现，随着T2I模型更新换代，合成数据集上训练的分类器在真实测试集上的准确率持续下降，表明生成数据分布偏向美学中心而缺乏多样性。
Conclusion: 本文挑战了“生成真实感提升即数据真实感提升”的假设，强调需要重新评估现代T2I模型作为可靠训练数据生成器的能力，并指出当前生成数据分布覆盖真实分布的问题。

papers.title: Adaptive Time Series Reasoning via Segment Selection
papers.abstract_en: Time series reasoning tasks often start with a natural language question and require targeted analysis of a time series. Evidence may span the full series or appear in a few short intervals, so the model must decide what to inspect. Most existing approaches encode the entire time series into a fixed representation before inference, regardless of whether or not the entire sequence is relevant. We introduce ARTIST, which formulates time-series reasoning as a sequential decision problem. ARTIST interleaves reasoning with adaptive temporal segment selection. It adopts a controller-reasoner architecture and uses reinforcement learning to train the controller role to select informative segments and the reasoner role to generate segment-conditioned reasoning traces and final answers. During inference, the model actively acquires task-relevant information instead of relying on a static summary of the full sequence. We use a novel hierarchical policy optimization approach for post-training that allows the model to excel in both segment selection and question-answering behavior. We evaluate ARTIST on six time-series reasoning benchmarks and compare it with large language models, vision-language models, and prior time-series reasoning systems. ARTIST improves average accuracy by 6.46 absolute percentage points over the strongest baseline. The largest gains appear on rare event localization and multi-segment reasoning tasks. Supervised fine-tuning improves performance, and reinforcement learning provides additional gains by optimizing question-adaptive segment selection. These results show that selective data use drives effective time-series reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ARTIST，将时间序列推理建模为顺序决策问题，通过控制器-推理器架构和强化学习实现自适应时间段选择，在六个基准上平均准确率提升6.46个百分点。
Motivation: 现有方法在推理前将整个时间序列编码为固定表示，无论是否相关，导致无效计算和信息冗余。
Method: 采用控制器-推理器架构，控制器通过强化学习选择信息段，推理器生成基于段的条件推理轨迹和答案，并使用层次化策略优化进行后训练。
Result: 在六个时间序列推理基准上，ARTIST平均准确率提升6.46个百分点，尤其在罕见事件定位和多段推理任务上提升最大。
Conclusion: 选择性数据使用可有效驱动时间序列推理，强化学习进一步优化了问题自适应的段选择。

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic Strong-AI Robots with Closed Knowledge Assumption: Learning and Deductions
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge representation formalisms are aimed to represent general conceptual information and are typically used in the construction of the knowledge base of reasoning agent. A knowledge base can be thought of as representing the beliefs of such an agent. Like a child, a strong-AI (AGI) robot would have to learn through input and experiences, constantly progressing and advancing its abilities over time. Both with statistical AI generated by neural networks we need also the concept of \textsl{causality} of events traduced into directionality of logic entailments and deductions in order to give to robots the emulation of human intelligence. Moreover, by using the axioms we can guarantee the \textsl{controlled security} about robot's actions based on logic inferences. For AGI robots we consider the 4-valued Belnap's bilattice of truth-values with knowledge ordering as well, where the value "unknown" is the bottom value, the sentences with this value are indeed unknown facts, that is, the missed knowledge in the AGI robots. Thus, these unknown facts are not part of the robot's knowledge database, and by learn through input and experiences, the robot's knowledge would be naturally expanded over time. Consequently, this phenomena can be represented by the Closed Knowledge Assumption and Logic Inference provided by this paper. Moreover, the truth-value "inconsistent", which is the top value in the knowledge ordering of Belnap's bilattice, is necessary for strong-AI robots to be able to support such inconsistent information and paradoxes, like Liar paradox, during deduction processes.

Motivation: 现有强AI机器人难以处理知识的未知状态和不一致信息，缺乏基于逻辑推断的因果推理和安全控制，需要一种结合统计学习与符号推理的框架。
Method: 提出封闭知识假设，将机器人初始知识库中的未知事实视为缺失信息，通过输入和体验自然扩展知识。采用Belnap四值双格（知识序）表示真值，支持unknown和inconsistent值，并基于逻辑推断进行推理。
Result: 论文本身是理论框架，未提供具体实验结果。摘要声称该方法能为AGI机器人提供可控的安全性和处理不一致信息的能力（如应对谎者悖论）。
Conclusion: 封闭知识假设与四值逻辑推理为强AI机器人提供了一种渐进学习和安全推理的理论基础。

papers.title: Allure of Craquelure: A Variational-Generative Approach to Crack Detection in Paintings
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in imaging technologies, deep learning and numerical performance have enabled non-invasive detailed analysis of artworks, supporting their documentation and conservation. In particular, automated detection of craquelure in digitized paintings is crucial for assessing degradation and guiding restoration, yet remains challenging due to the possibly complex scenery and the visual similarity between cracks and crack-like artistic features such as brush strokes or hair. We propose a hybrid approach that models crack detection as an inverse problem, decomposing an observed image into a crack-free painting and a crack component. A deep generative model is employed as powerful prior for the underlying artwork, while crack structures are captured using a Mumford--Shah-type variational functional together with a crack prior. Joint optimization yields a pixel-level map of crack localizations in the painting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合变分-生成方法，将绘画中的裂纹检测建模为逆问题，通过将观察图像分解为无裂纹绘画和裂纹成分，利用深度生成模型作为绘画先验，并结合Mumford-Shah型变分泛函和裂纹先验捕捉裂纹结构，通过联合优化实现像素级裂纹定位。
Motivation: 自动检测绘画中的裂纹对评估劣化和指导修复至关重要，但由于复杂场景以及裂纹与艺术特征（如笔触）的视觉相似性，使得检测任务具有挑战性。
Method: 提出混合方法，将裂纹检测作为逆问题，从观察图像中分离出无裂纹绘画和裂纹成分。使用深度生成模型作为绘画先验，同时采用Mumford-Shah型变分泛函结合裂纹先验来建模裂纹结构，通过联合优化获得像素级裂纹定位图。
Result: 方法能够生成像素级的裂纹定位图，但摘要中未提供具体的量化性能指标。
Conclusion: 该方法通过结合变分模型和深度生成模型，有效处理了裂纹与艺术特征之间的视觉混淆问题，为绘画裂纹检测提供了一种有效的非侵入式分析工具。

papers.title: Selecting Hyperparameters for Tree-Boosting
papers.abstract_en: Tree-boosting is a widely used machine learning technique for tabular data. However, its out-of-sample accuracy is critically dependent on multiple hyperparameters. In this article, we empirically compare several popular methods for hyperparameter optimization for tree-boosting including random grid search, the tree-structured Parzen estimator (TPE), Gaussian-process-based Bayesian optimization (GP-BO), Hyperband, the sequential model-based algorithm configuration (SMAC) method, and deterministic full grid search using $59$ regression and binary classification data sets. We find that the SMAC method clearly outperforms all the other considered methods on average, and it gives stable performance across a diverse collection of tabular data sets under a fixed tuning budget, which is relevant for users who cannot afford extensive manual trial-and-error tuning. We further observe that (i) a relatively large number of trials larger than $100$ is typically required for accurate tuning, (ii) using default values for hyperparameters or a full search over a small grid often yields very inaccurate models, (iii) all considered hyperparameters can have a material effect on the accuracy of tree-boosting, i.e., there is no small set of hyperparameters that is more important than others, and (iv) choosing the number of boosting iterations using early stopping yields more accurate results compared to including it in the search space for regression tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过59个回归和二分类数据集，系统比较了树提升（tree-boosting）的超参数优化方法，包括随机网格搜索、TPE、GP-BO、Hyperband、SMAC和确定性全网格搜索。结果表明SMAC方法在固定调优预算下平均表现最优且稳定，且需要超过100次试验才能准确调优，所有超参数均对精度有显著影响。
Motivation: 树提升模型的预测精度严重依赖多个超参数，但缺乏对常用超参数优化方法的全面实证比较。
Method: 使用59个表格数据集，对随机网格搜索、TPE、GP-BO、Hyperband、SMAC和确定性全网格搜索进行实证比较。
Result: SMAC方法在所有方法中平均表现最优且稳定；需要超过100次试验；默认超参数或小网格搜索常导致不准确模型；所有超参数均重要；对回归任务，使用早停选择迭代次数比将其纳入搜索空间更准确。
Conclusion: SMAC是树提升超参数优化的推荐方法，且调优需要足够预算和全面考虑所有超参数。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: AnyStyle: Single-Pass Multimodal Stylization for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: The growing demand for rapid and scalable 3D asset creation has driven interest in feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods, with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) emerging as an effective scene representation. While recent approaches have demonstrated pose-free reconstruction from unposed image collections, integrating stylization or appearance control into such pipelines remains underexplored. Existing attempts largely rely on image-based conditioning, which limits both controllability and flexibility. In this work, we introduce AnyStyle, a feed-forward 3D reconstruction and stylization framework that enables pose-free, zero-shot stylization through multimodal conditioning. Our method supports both textual and visual style inputs, allowing users to control the scene appearance using natural language descriptions or reference images. We propose a modular stylization architecture that requires only minimal architectural modifications and can be integrated into existing feed-forward 3D reconstruction backbones. Experiments demonstrate that AnyStyle improves style controllability over prior feed-forward stylization methods while preserving high-quality geometric reconstruction. A user study further confirms that AnyStyle achieves superior stylization quality compared to an existing state-of-the-art approach. Repository: https://github.com/joaxkal/AnyStyle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnyStyle，一个前馈式 3D 重建与风格化框架，支持无位姿、零样本的多模态风格化。该方法通过文本或图像控制场景外观，仅需少量架构修改即可集成到现有重建骨干中。实验表明，AnyStyle 在保持高质量几何重建的同时，风格可控性优于先前方法，用户研究也确认其风格化质量更优。
Motivation: 现有的前馈 3D 重建方法缺乏有效的风格化或外观控制，且大多依赖图像条件，限制了灵活性和可控性。
Method: AnyStyle 采用模块化风格化架构，支持文本和视觉两种风格输入，通过最小化架构修改集成到前馈 3D 重建骨干中，实现无位姿、零样本的风格化。
Result: AnyStyle 在风格可控性上优于先前前馈风格化方法，同时保持高质量几何重建；用户研究显示其风格化质量超过现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: AnyStyle 展示了多模态条件在 3D 风格化中的有效性，但摘要未提及具体局限性或适用范围。

papers.title: MedBeads: An AI-Native Clinical Context Graph Built from Immutable Beads and Reconstructable Clinical Links
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI can encode substantial medical knowledge, but patient-specific answers remain constrained by the context supplied at inference time. Electronic health records and FHIR support documentation and interoperability, but they do not by themselves define the complete, current, and auditable context a model should receive. Similarity-based retrieval can find related text, but it neither guarantees collection of clinically connected records nor makes omissions explicit. We introduce MedBeads, an AI-facing clinical record substrate that assembles a declared closure of longitudinal patient information before generation. A Bead is an immutable clinical or knowledge object identified by SHA-256 over canonical content and stored as an append-only frame in a patient-scoped Pod. Structural parent edges form a patient-rooted Merkle DAG. Typed clinical links occupy a separate, reconstructable interpretation layer derived from signed, versioned knowledge rules; they can be recomputed when knowledge changes without rewriting clinical facts. Retrieval follows authorized structural and clinical edges, resolves amendments and retractions, and reports policy or token truncation. An open-source Go implementation uses append-only Pods and reconstructable SQLite projections. File-based conversion of 1,135 synthetic Synthea FHIR bundles produced approximately one million Beads and demonstrated deterministic clinical-link derivation and interpretation-layer reconstruction. These engineering results establish feasibility and reproducibility, not reduced hallucination or improved clinical outcomes. MedBeads reframes grounding as a data-structure problem by delivering a policy-bounded, provenance-bearing clinical subgraph rather than an opaque list of similar fragments.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Reference implementation and reproducible Docker demo available at https://github.com/medbeads/medbeads
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedBeads 是一个面向 AI 的临床记录基础结构，通过将患者信息组织为不可变的 Bead（内容哈希标识）和可重建的临床链接层，在生成前构建声明闭包。系统使用 Merkle DAG 存储结构，支持可审计、可追溯的上下文检索，并允许知识规则更新时重新计算临床链接而不修改原始数据。在合成 Synthea FHIR 数据上的实验证明了其工程可行性。
Motivation: 现有生成式 AI 在回答患者特定问题时受限于推理时提供的上下文，电子健康记录和 FHIR 不保证完整且可审计的上下文，基于相似度的检索无法确保收集到临床相关的记录。
Method: MedBeads 将临床数据建模为不可变的 Bead（SHA-256 标识），以追加方式存储在患者范围的 Pod 中，并通过结构父边形成 Merkle DAG。另外一层可重建的临床链接由带签名的知识规则生成，可在知识变化时重新计算而不影响临床事实。检索遵循授权的结构和临床边，处理修正和撤销，并报告策略或 token 截断。
Result: 在 1,135 条合成 Synthea FHIR 数据上转换出约 100 万个 Bead，并展示了确定性的临床链接推导和解释层重建，验证了可行性和可重复性，但未声称减少幻觉或改善临床结果。
Conclusion: MedBeads 将生成式 AI 的 grounding 重新定义为数据结构问题，通过提供策略约束的、带来源的临床子图，而非不透明的相似片段列表。

papers.title: To Grok Grokking: Provable Grokking in Ridge Regression
papers.abstract_en: We study grokking, the onset of generalization long after overfitting, in a classical ridge regression setting. We prove end-to-end grokking results for learning over-parameterized linear regression models using gradient descent with weight decay. Specifically, we prove that the following stages occur: (i) the model overfits the training data early during training; (ii) poor generalization persists long after overfitting has manifested; and (iii) the generalization error eventually becomes arbitrarily small. Moreover, we show, both theoretically and empirically, that grokking can be amplified or eliminated in a principled manner through proper hyperparameter tuning. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first rigorous quantitative bounds on the generalization delay (which we refer to as the "grokking time") in terms of training hyperparameters. Lastly, going beyond the linear setting, we empirically demonstrate that our quantitative bounds also capture the behavior of grokking on non-linear neural networks. Our results suggest that grokking is not an inherent failure mode of deep learning, but rather a consequence of specific training conditions, and thus does not require fundamental changes to the model architecture or learning algorithm to avoid.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在经典的ridge回归设置中严格研究了grokking现象（即过拟合后泛化突然出现）。作者证明了在使用梯度下降和权重衰减学习过参数化线性回归模型时，会出现三个阶段：早期过拟合、长期泛化延迟、最终泛化误差趋近于零。首次给出了泛化延迟（grokking时间）关于训练超参数的严格定量界，并通过超参数调整可以放大或消除grokking。数值实验表明这些定量界也适用于非线性神经网络。
Motivation: grokking现象（过拟合后长时间才出现泛化）的成因尚不明确，现有研究缺乏严格的理论理解。本文旨在通过理论分析揭示grokking的根本机制，并证明其并非深度学习的固有缺陷。
Method: 在经典ridge回归框架下，理论分析使用梯度下降和权重衰减训练过参数化线性回归模型的动力学过程，推导泛化误差的演化轨迹，并给出grokking时间的严格上界。
Result: 首次给出了grokking时间的严格定量界限，并证明通过调节权重衰减等超参数可以放大或消除grokking。理论预测在非线性神经网络上也被数值验证。
Conclusion: grokking不是深度学习的固有失败模式，而是特定训练条件（如过参数化、权重衰减）的后果，因此无需改变模型架构或学习算法即可避免。

summary_sections.conclusion: grokking不是深度学习的固有失败模式，而是特定训练条件（如过参数化、权重衰减）的后果，因此无需改变模型架构或学习算法即可避免。

papers.title: Knowledge-Aware Evolution for Task-Free Streaming Federated Continual Learning with Arbitrary Class Overlap
papers.abstract_en: Federated Continual Learning (FCL) leverages inter-client collaboration to better balance new knowledge acquisition and old knowledge retention on non-stationary data. However, existing FCL methods struggle to adapt to streaming scenarios where sequential and ephemerally accessible data chunks lack task identifiers and exhibit arbitrary class overlap, leading to confusion between old and new knowledge and an inability to sustain local inference on all encountered classes. To address this, we propose FedKACE with three components: 1) an adaptive mechanism that determines when to switch the inference model from the local to the global one to improve client-side inference performance; 2) a responsive gradient-balanced replay scheme that utilizes the ratio of the squared L2 gradient norms to balance client-specific knowledge between new acquisition and old retention; 3) a holistic buffer maintenance strategy that preserves highly informative and boundary-significant samples to enhance knowledge retention under class overlap.Experiments across multiple scenarios and theoretical analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of FedKACE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FedKACE，一种面向无任务标识、任意类别重叠的流式联邦持续学习方法。通过自适应推理模型切换、梯度平衡重放和缓冲区维护三个组件，解决流式场景下新旧知识混淆和本地推理能力下降的问题。实验和理论分析验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有联邦持续学习方法难以适应流式场景——数据块顺序到达、无任务标识、类别任意重叠，导致新旧知识混淆，无法在所有已见类别上维持本地推理性能。
Method: FedKACE包含三个组件：1) 自适应机制决定何时将推理模型从本地切换至全局模型；2) 基于梯度L2范数平方比的响应式梯度平衡重放方案，平衡新旧知识；3) 整体缓冲区维护策略，保留高信息量和边界显著性样本以增强类别重叠下的知识保留。
Result: 在多种场景下的实验和理论分析证明了FedKACE的有效性。
Conclusion: FedKACE适用于无任务标识的流式联邦持续学习，能处理任意类别重叠问题。

papers.title: A$^2$TG: Adaptive Anisotropic Textured Gaussians for Efficient 3D Scene Representation
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian Splatting has emerged as a powerful representation for high-quality, real-time 3D scene rendering. While recent works extend Gaussians with learnable textures to enrich visual appearance, existing approaches allocate a fixed square texture per primitive, leading to inefficient memory usage and limited adaptability to scene variability. In this paper, we introduce adaptive anisotropic textured Gaussians (A$^2$TG), a novel representation that generalizes textured Gaussians by equipping each primitive with an anisotropic texture. Our method employs a gradient-guided adaptive rule to jointly determine texture resolution and aspect ratio, enabling non-uniform, detail-aware allocation that aligns with the anisotropic nature of Gaussian splats. This design significantly improves texture efficiency, reducing memory consumption while enhancing image quality. Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that A TG consistently outperforms fixed-texture Gaussian Splatting methods, achieving comparable rendering fidelity with substantially lower memory requirements. Project page: http://github.com/Rickyeeeeee/A2TG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应各向异性纹理高斯分布（A$^2$TG），通过为每个高斯基元配备各向异性纹理，并利用梯度引导的规则联合确定纹理分辨率和长宽比，实现了更高效的三维场景表示。实验表明，该方法在多个基准数据集上优于固定纹理的高斯泼溅方法，在保持渲染质量的同时显著降低内存消耗。
Motivation: 现有高斯泼溅方法为每个基元分配固定的方形纹理，导致内存利用低效且难以适应场景的多样性。
Method: 提出自适应各向异性纹理高斯分布（A$^2$TG），每个基元使用各向异性纹理，并通过梯度引导的规则动态优化纹理分辨率和长宽比，实现非均匀、细节感知的纹理分配。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，A$^2$TG 在保持渲染保真度的同时，相比固定纹理方法大幅降低了内存需求。
Conclusion: A$^2$TG 证明了各向异性纹理分配在提高高斯泼溅效率方面的有效性，为紧凑的三维场景表示提供了新思路。

papers.title: Knowledge-Embedded and Hypernetwork-Guided Few-Shot Substation Meter Defect Image Generation Method
papers.abstract_en: Substation meters play a critical role in monitoring and ensuring the stable operation of power grids, yet their detection of cracks and other physical defects is often hampered by a severe scarcity of annotated samples. To address this few-shot generation challenge, we propose a novel framework that integrates Knowledge Embedding and Hypernetwork-Guided Conditional Control into a Stable Diffusion pipeline, enabling realistic and controllable synthesis of defect images from limited data. First, we bridge the substantial domain gap between natural-image pre-trained models and industrial equipment by fine-tuning a Stable Diffusion backbone using DreamBooth-style knowledge embedding. This process encodes the unique structural and textural priors of substation meters, ensuring generated images retain authentic meter characteristics. Second, we introduce a geometric crack modeling module that parameterizes defect attributes--such as location, length, curvature, and branching pattern--to produce spatially constrained control maps. These maps provide precise, pixel-level guidance during generation. Third, we design a lightweight hypernetwork that dynamically modulates the denoising process of the diffusion model in response to the control maps and high-level defect descriptors, achieving a flexible balance between generation fidelity and controllability. Extensive experiments on a real-world substation meter dataset demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms existing augmentation and generation baselines. It reduces Frechet Inception Distance (FID) by 32.7%, increases diversity metrics, and--most importantly--boosts the mAP of a downstream defect detector by 15.3% when trained on augmented data. The framework offers a practical, high-quality data synthesis solution for industrial inspection systems where defect samples are rare.

papers.title: LPCAN: Lightweight Pyramid Cross-Attention Network for Rail Surface Defect Detection Using RGB-D Data
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the limitations of current vision-based rail defect detection methods, including high computational complexity, excessive parameter counts, and suboptimal accuracy. We propose a Lightweight Pyramid Cross-Attention Network (LPCANet) that leverages RGB-D data for efficient and accurate defect identification. The architecture integrates MobileNetv2 as a backbone for RGB feature extraction with a lightweight pyramid module (LPM) for depth processing, coupled with a cross-attention mechanism (CAM) for multimodal fusion and a spatial feature extractor (SFE) for enhanced structural analysis. Comprehensive evaluations on three unsupervised RGB-D rail datasets (NEU-RSDDS-AUG, RSDD-TYPE1, RSDD-TYPE2) demonstrate that LPCANet achieves state-of-the-art performance with only 9.90 million parameters, 2.50 G FLOPs, and 162.60 fps inference speed. Compared to 18 existing methods, LPCANet shows significant improvements, including +1.48\% in $S_α$, +0.86\% in IOU, and +1.77\% in MAE over the best-performing baseline. Ablation studies confirm the critical roles of CAM and SFE, while experiments on non-rail datasets (DAGM2007, MT, Kolektor-SDD2) validate its generalization capability. The proposed framework effectively bridges traditional and deep learning approaches, offering substantial practical value for industrial defect inspection. Future work will focus on further model compression for real-time deployment.

papers.title: ROOFS: RObust biOmarker Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection (FS) is essential for biomarker discovery and clinical predictive modeling. Over the past decades, methodological literature on FS has become rich and mature, offering a wide spectrum of algorithmic approaches. However, much of this methodological progress has not fully translated into applied biomedical research. Moreover, challenges inherent in biomedical data, such as high-dimensional feature space, low sample size, multicollinearity, and missing values, make FS non-trivial. To help bridge this gap between methodological development and practical application, we propose ROOFS (RObust biOmarker Feature Selection), a Python package available at https://gitlab.inria.fr/compo/roofs, designed to help researchers in the choice of FS method adapted to their problem. ROOFS benchmarks multiple FS methods on the user's data and generates reports summarizing a comprehensive set of evaluation metrics, including downstream predictive performance estimated using optimism correction, stability, robustness of individual features, and true positive and false positive rates assessed on semi-synthetic data with a simulated outcome. We demonstrate the utility of ROOFS on data from the PIONeeR clinical trial, aimed at identifying predictors of resistance to anti-PD-(L)1 immunotherapy in lung cancer. Of the 34 FS methods gathered in ROOFS, we evaluated 23 in combination with 11 classifiers (253 models) and identified a filter based on the union of Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate-adjusted p-values from t-test and logistic regression as the optimal approach, outperforming other methods including widely used LASSO. We conclude that comprehensive benchmarking with ROOFS has the potential to improve the reproducibility of FS discoveries and increase the translational value of clinical models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ROOFS，一个用于生物标志物特征选择的 Python 包，通过基准测试多种特征选择方法并生成包含下游预测性能、稳定性、特征鲁棒性等指标的评估报告，帮助研究人员选择适合其问题的特征选择方法。在 PIONeeR 临床试验数据上，评估了 23 种特征选择方法与 11 种分类器的组合，发现基于 t 检验和逻辑回归的 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正 p 值联合过滤方法优于包括 LASSO 在内的其他方法。
Motivation: 生物医学数据具有高维、小样本、多重共线性和缺失值等挑战，而特征选择方法的方法论进展未充分应用于实际研究，需要工具帮助研究者选择适合的特征选择方法。
Method: ROOFS 包：基准测试多种特征选择方法，使用改进的交叉验证（乐观校正）评估下游预测性能、特征稳定性、鲁棒性，并利用半合成数据评估真阳性率和假阳性率。
Result: 在 PIONeeR 临床试验数据上，评估了 23 种特征选择方法与 11 种分类器的 253 个模型，发现基于 t 检验和逻辑回归的 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正 p 值联合过滤方法为最优，优于 LASSO 等常用方法。
Conclusion: ROOFS 的全面基准测试有望提高特征选择发现的可重复性并增强临床模型的转化价值。

papers.title: CoDi -- an exemplar-conditioned diffusion model for low-shot counting
papers.abstract_en: Low-shot object counting addresses estimating the number of previously unobserved objects in an image using only few or no annotated test-time exemplars. A considerable challenge for modern low-shot counters are dense regions with small objects. While total counts in such situations are typically well addressed by density-based counters, their usefulness is limited by poor localization capabilities. This is better addressed by point-detection-based counters, which are based on query-based detectors. However, due to limited number of pre-trained queries, they underperform on images with very large numbers of objects, and resort to ad-hoc techniques like upsampling and tiling. We propose CoDi, the first latent diffusion-based low-shot counter that produces high-quality density maps on which object locations can be determined by non-maxima suppression. Our core contribution is the new exemplar-based conditioning module that extracts and adjusts the object prototypes to the intermediate layers of the denoising network, leading to accurate object location estimation. On FSC benchmark, CoDi outperforms state-of-the-art by 15% MAE, 13% MAE and 10% MAE in the few-shot, one-shot, and reference-less scenarios, respectively, and sets a new state-of-the-art on MCAC benchmark by outperforming the top method by 38% MAE. The code is available at https://github.com/gsustar/CoDi

Motivation: 现有低样本计数器在密集小物体区域存在定位差或大数量物体性能下降的问题，密度方法定位弱而点检测方法受限于预训练查询数量。

Conclusion: CoDi 证明了扩散模型在低样本计数中的有效性，通过示例条件调节实现了优于现有方法的计数和定位性能。

papers.title: The Challenger: When Do New Data Sources Justify Switching Machine Learning Models?
papers.abstract_en: Organizations often have an incumbent predictive model in production when new data sources become available. Because historical training data lack the new features, a challenger model must be trained on a small but growing full-feature dataset. We study whether, and when, the organization should switch to the challenger. The decision is statistical and economic: the challenger's predictive performance improves as full-feature data accumulate, but repeated retraining is costly and delays benefits from deployment. We develop a framework linking learning-curve dynamics to model-switching economics. Under a standard power-law learning curve and finite data-collection horizon $T$, the optimal time to train and evaluate the challenger scales as $T^{1/(1+α)}$: learning-curve shape (through its learning speed $α$) is the primary theoretical determinant of when to stop experimenting; costs determine switching profitability. Even without knowing the learning curve, the operational problem is tractable: we show that any algorithm stopping on the $T^{2/3}$ scale and making reliable switch/discard decisions achieves $O(T^{2/3}\sqrt{\log T})$ regret relative to a full-foresight oracle. We propose a sequential evaluation algorithm that uses local learning-curve trends to anticipate improvement, and test it in a real-world credit-scoring study. Even with this local approximation, the algorithm theoretically and empirically achieves near-oracle performance. It is also more stable than greedy sequential evaluation algorithms, where noisy early estimates trigger premature discarding, or simple one-shot evaluation algorithms, which work only when their fixed evaluation time matches the (unknown in practice) theoretical timing scale. Our framework offers a step toward principled model governance when new data sources require costly collection, validation, and deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究组织在已有生产预测模型的情况下，当新数据源（新特征）出现时，是否以及何时应切换到新模型（挑战者模型）。作者建立了一个将学习曲线动力学与模型切换经济学相结合的框架，发现最优训练和评估时间与数据收集窗口和学习速度有关，并提出了一个序贯评估算法，在理论分析和真实信用评分数据中接近最优性能。
Motivation: 实际中组织往往拥有一个已投产的旧模型，而新数据源（含新特征）的出现需要训练一个新模型，但由于历史数据缺乏新特征，新模型只能在小而增长的全特征数据集上训练。决定何时切换到新模型是一个统计和经济问题：切换过早可能性能不佳，切换过晚会延迟收益且增加重训成本。
Method: 提出一个框架，结合标准幂律学习曲线和有限数据收集期，推导出最优切换时间标度为 T^{1/(1+α)}。进一步设计了一个序贯评估算法，利用局部学习曲线趋势预测改进，在无需知道完整学习曲线的情况下实现 O(T^{2/3}√log T) 的遗憾界。
Result: 理论上证明了最优切换时间依赖于学习曲线形状（学习速度α），成本决定切换的盈利性。序贯评估算法在真实信用评分数据上达到近乎最优性能，且比贪婪序贯算法（可能因早期噪声过早丢弃）和一次性评估算法更稳定。
Conclusion: 该框架为当新数据源需要高成本收集、验证和部署时的模型治理提供了一步原则性方法。

papers.title: RePlan: Reasoning-guided Region Planning for Complex Instruction-based Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-based image editing enables natural-language control over visual modifications, yet existing models falter under Instruction-Visual Complexity (IV-Complexity), where intricate instructions meet cluttered or ambiguous scenes. We introduce RePlan (Region-aligned Planning), a plan-then-execute framework that couples a vision-language planner with a diffusion editor. The planner decomposes instructions via step-by-step reasoning and explicitly grounds them to target regions; the editor then applies changes using a training-free attention-region injection mechanism, enabling precise, parallel multi-region edits without iterative inpainting. To strengthen planning, we apply GRPO-based reinforcement learning using 1K instruction-only examples, yielding substantial gains in reasoning fidelity and format reliability. We further present IV-Edit, a benchmark focused on fine-grained grounding and knowledge-intensive edits. Across IV-Complex settings, RePlan consistently outperforms strong baselines trained on far larger datasets, improving regional precision and overall consistency. Our project page: https://replan-iv-edit.github.io
papers.comment: [ECCV2026] Precise multi-region control and planning for instruction-based image editing. Our project page: https://replan-iv-edit.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RePlan提出了一种计划-执行框架，用于复杂指令引导的图像编辑。该框架包含一个视觉语言规划器和一个扩散编辑器，规划器通过逐步推理分解指令并显式定位到目标区域，编辑器使用无需训练的注意力区域注入机制实现精确的多区域并行编辑。通过GRPO强化学习提升推理可靠性，并引入IV-Edit基准测试。在复杂指令场景下，RePlan优于使用更大数据集训练的强基线模型。
Motivation: 现有指令引导图像编辑模型在处理复杂指令与杂乱场景（IV-Complexity）时表现不佳，难以精确定位和同时编辑多个区域。
Method: 提出RePlan（区域对齐规划）框架，包含：(1) 基于逐步推理的视觉语言规划器，将指令分解并定位到目标区域；(2) 无需训练的注意力区域注入扩散编辑器，实现多区域并行编辑；(3) 使用GRPO强化学习（仅需1K指令样本）优化规划器的推理准确性和输出格式。
Result: 在IV-Complexity设置下，RePlan在区域精度和整体一致性上持续优于使用更大数据集训练的强基线模型。
Conclusion: RePlan通过显式规划与训练自由的区域注入机制，有效提升了复杂指令驱动的图像编辑精度，避免了迭代修补的低效。

papers.title: Subjective functions
papers.abstract_en: Where do objective functions come from? How do we select what goals to pursue? Human intelligence is adept at synthesizing new objective functions on the fly. How does this work, and can we endow artificial systems with the same ability? This paper proposes an approach to answering these questions, starting with the concept of a subjective function, a higher-order objective function that is endogenous to the agent (i.e., defined with respect to the agent's features, rather than an external task). Expected prediction error is studied as a concrete example of a subjective function. This proposal has many connections to ideas in psychology, neuroscience, and machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出主观函数（subjective function）的概念，即一种内生于智能体的高阶目标函数，区别于外部任务定义的目标函数。以预期预测误差为例，探讨了主观函数的可能工作机制，并联系心理学、神经科学和机器学习中的相关思想。
Motivation: 目标函数的来源和选择机制尚不清楚，人类能灵活合成新目标函数，而现有AI系统缺乏此能力。本文试图从理论层面解释这一过程。
Method: 提出主观函数作为内生于智能体的高阶目标函数，并以预期预测误差作为具体实例进行分析。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据或定量结果，主要提供概念框架和跨学科联系。
Conclusion: 该工作为理解目标函数的来源提供了新视角，但尚未给出可落地的算法或验证。

papers.title: Step-Tagging: Toward controlling the generation of Language Reasoning Models through step monitoring
papers.abstract_en: The field of Language Reasoning Models (LRMs) has been very active over the past few years with advances in training and inference techniques enabling LRMs to reason longer, and more accurately. However, a growing body of studies show that LRMs are still inefficient, over-generating verification and reflection steps. To address this challenge, we introduce the Step-Tagging framework, a lightweight sentence-classifier enabling real-time annotation of the type of reasoning steps that an LRM is generating. To monitor reasoning behaviors, we introduced ReasonType: a novel taxonomy of reasoning steps. Building on this framework, we demonstrated that online monitoring of the count of specific steps can produce effective interpretable early stopping criteria of LRM inferences. We evaluate the Step-tagging framework on three open-source reasoning models across standard benchmark datasets: MATH500, GSM8K, AIME and non-mathematical tasks (GPQA and MMLU-Pro). We achieve 20 to 50% token reduction while maintaining comparable accuracy to standard generation, with largest gains observed on more computation-heavy tasks. This work offers a novel way to increase control over the generation of LRMs, and a new tool to study behaviors of LRMs.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Resource-Adaptive Foundation Model Inference (AdaptFM), Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Step-Tagging 框架，通过轻量级句子分类器实时标注语言推理模型（LRM）生成的推理步骤类型，并基于此设计可解释的早停准则，减少 token 生成量。在 MATH500、GSM8K、AIME 等基准上，该方法在保持准确率的前提下实现了 20% 到 50% 的 token 减少。
Motivation: 现有 LRM 在推理过程中过度生成验证和反思步骤，导致效率低下，缺乏对生成过程的细粒度控制。
Method: 引入 ReasonType 推理步骤分类法，训练轻量级句子分类器对每一步进行实时标注，并基于步骤计数设计在线早停策略。
Result: 在开源推理模型上，该方法在 MATH500、GSM8K、AIME 以及非数学任务（GPQA、MMLU-Pro）上实现了 20%–50% 的 token 减少，且准确率基本不变。
Conclusion: Step-Tagging 提供了一种新的 LRM 生成控制手段，可用于行为研究，但未涉及其在降水或天气预报领域的应用。

papers.title: DualHNIE: Dual-Channel Hypergraph Learning for Node Importance Estimation in Heterogeneous Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Estimating node importance in heterogeneous knowledge graphs is a fundamental problem underlying recommendation, search, and knowledge decision systems. However, most existing methods rely on pairwise message passing mechanisms that fail to capture higher-order interactions induced by meta-relational structures. Furthermore, structural topology and semantic attributes are typically entangled within a unified embedding space, which obscures their distinct inductive biases and limits the discriminative capacity of learned importance representations. To address these limitations, we propose DualHNIE, a principled dual-channel hypergraph learning framework for node importance estimation. DualHNIE first constructs a higher-order knowledge graph by forming typed hyperedges from meta-path sequences, enabling explicit modeling of higher-order relational patterns. It then introduces two complementary encoders: a structure-aware hypergraph attention network that performs locally normalized aggregation over meta-path--induced hyperedges to capture localized structural dependencies, and a sparse--chunked hypergraph transformer that captures global semantic interactions while maintaining scalable computation. We further design a contrastive alignment mechanism with auxiliary supervision, ensuring cross-view consistency while preserving modality-specific representation. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that DualHNIE outperforms state-of-the-art methods, validating the effectiveness of explicit high-order modeling and disentangled dual-channel representation learning for heterogeneous knowledge graphs. Code and datasets are available\footnote[1]{https://github.com/jiawenchen10/DualHNIE}.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DualHNIE，一种双通道超图学习框架，用于异构知识图中的节点重要性估计。该方法通过从元路径序列构建类型化超边来建模高阶关系，并设计结构感知超图注意力网络和稀疏分块超图变压器分别捕捉局部结构依赖和全局语义交互，同时引入对比对齐机制保持跨视图一致性。实验表明，该方法在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有节点重要性估计方法依赖成对消息传递，无法捕获元路径结构引发的高阶交互，且结构拓扑与语义属性在统一嵌入空间中纠缠，限制了表示判别力。
Method: 首先从元路径序列构造类型化超边以显式建模高阶关系模式；然后设计双通道编码器：结构感知超图注意力网络进行局部归一化聚合，稀疏分块超图变压器实现全局语义交互并保持可扩展计算；最后使用对比对齐机制和辅助监督保持跨视图一致性并保留模态特定表示。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，DualHNIE 优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 显式高阶建模和解耦双通道表示学习对异构知识图节点重要性估计有效，代码和数据集已公开。

papers.title: Gaussian Process Aggregation for Root-Parallel Monte Carlo Tree Search with Continuous Actions
papers.abstract_en: Monte Carlo Tree Search is a cornerstone algorithm for online planning, and its root-parallel variant is widely used when wall clock time is limited but best performance is desired. In environments with continuous action spaces, how to best aggregate statistics from different threads is an important yet underexplored question. In this work, we introduce a method that uses Gaussian Process Regression to obtain value estimates for promising actions that were not trialed in the environment. We perform a systematic evaluation across 6 different domains, demonstrating that our approach outperforms existing aggregation strategies while requiring a modest increase in inference time.

TL;DR: 本文针对连续动作空间中根并行蒙特卡洛树搜索（root-parallel MCTS）的统计聚合问题，提出使用高斯过程回归（Gaussian Process Regression）来估计未尝试动作的价值。在6个不同领域的系统评估中，该方法优于现有聚合策略，且推理时间增加适中。
Motivation: 现有根并行MCTS在连续动作空间中对不同线程的统计聚合效果不佳，这是一个重要但未被充分探索的问题。
Method: 提出一种利用高斯过程回归（Gaussian Process Regression）来获取未在环境中试验的有前景动作的价值估计的方法。
Result: 在6个不同领域（如机器人控制等）的实验中，该方法优于现有聚合策略，且推理时间增加适中。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在连续动作空间中的有效性，但未讨论具体局限性。

papers.title: The Inductive Bottleneck: Data-Driven Emergence of Representational Sparsity in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) lack the hierarchical inductive biases inherent to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), theoretically allowing them to maintain high-dimensional representations throughout all layers. However, recent observations suggest ViTs often spontaneously manifest a "U-shaped" entropy profile-compressing information in middle layers before expanding it for the final classification. In this work, we demonstrate that this "Inductive Bottleneck" is not an architectural artifact, but a data-dependent adaptation. By analyzing the layer-wise Effective Encoding Dimension (EED) of DINO-trained ViTs across datasets of varying compositional complexity (UC Merced, Tiny ImageNet, and CIFAR-100), we show that the depth of the bottleneck correlates strongly with the semantic abstraction required by the task. We find that while texture-heavy datasets preserve high-rank representations throughout, object-centric datasets drive the network to dampen high-frequency information in middle layers, effectively "learning" a bottleneck to isolate semantic features.
papers.comment: This was just initial experiments but need more proofs for the things said in the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉Transformer（ViT）中出现的“归纳瓶颈”现象——中间层自发压缩表示信息，形成“U型”熵分布。通过对DINO训练的ViT在不同组成复杂度数据集（UC Merced、Tiny ImageNet、CIFAR-100）上的逐层有效编码维度（EED）分析，表明瓶颈深度与任务所需的语义抽象程度相关：纹理密集数据集保持高秩表示，而物体中心数据集则抑制中间层高频信息以隔离语义特征。
Motivation: 尽管ViT缺乏CNN的层次归纳偏置，理论上可在所有层保持高维表示，但观察发现其常出现中间层信息压缩。本文旨在探究这一“归纳瓶颈”是架构伪影还是数据依赖的适应。
Method: 通过分析DINO训练的ViT在三个不同复杂度数据集上的层间有效编码维度（EED），比较纹理密集型与物体中心型数据集下的表示秩变化。
Result: 发现瓶颈深度与任务所需语义抽象程度强相关：纹理密集型数据集保持高秩表示，而物体中心型数据集导致中间层高频信息被抑制。
Conclusion: 归纳瓶颈是数据驱动的适应，而非架构伪影，其深度由数据语义复杂度决定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JEEVHITAA -- An HCAI Ecosystem to Support Collective Care
papers.abstract_en: Current mobile health platforms are predominantly individual-centric and lack the support for coordinated, auditable multi-actor workflows. However, in many settings worldwide, health decisions are enacted through multi-actor coordination rather than individual users. We present JEEVHITAA, a cross-platform mobile system enabling role-aware sharing and verifiable information flows within permissioned care circles. JEEVHITAA ingests platform and device data, builds layered profiles from sensors and tiered onboarding, and enforces fine-grained, time-bounded access control across care graphs. Data stays secure both within the application and the cloud. Integrated retrieval-augmented Large Language Models produce structured, role-targeted summaries and action plans, offer evidence-grounded verification with provenance and confidence scores, and support advanced insights on reports. We describe the architecture, connector abstractions, and security primitives, and report robustness evaluations using synthetic, ontology-driven data and findings from a feasibility study with real-life care circles across 9-14 weeks. We outline plans for larger multi-site evaluations focusing on operational alignment, longitudinal trust & literacy impact, and relational friction & efforts to sink into the daily infrastructure.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables, 2 algorithms, 1 ontology description. Preprint of work under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍JEEVHITAA，一个跨平台移动健康系统，支持权限护理圈内的角色感知共享和可验证信息流。系统集成平台和设备数据，构建分层用户画像，执行细粒度时间受限的访问控制，并结合检索增强的大语言模型生成结构化、角色定向的摘要和行动计划。实验部分使用合成数据和9-14周的真实护理圈进行可行性评估，未来计划进行多站点研究。
Motivation: 当前移动健康平台以个体为中心，缺乏对多角色协调、可审计工作流的支持，而在许多实际场景中健康决策需要多角色协作。
Method: JEEVHITAA系统包括数据摄取、分层面板构建、细粒度时间受限访问控制、以及集成检索增强的大语言模型来生成角色定向摘要和行动方案，并支持证据源验证。
Result: 通过合成数据驱动的鲁棒性评估和9-14周真实护理圈可行性研究，展示了系统的有效性和可操作性。
Conclusion: 系统证明了支持多角色协调健康工作流的可行性，未来需进行更大规模多站点评估，关注操作对齐、纵向信任与素养影响以及日常基础设施融合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CluCERT: Certifying LLM Robustness via Clustering-Guided Denoising Smoothing
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have led to their widespread adoption in daily applications. Despite their impressive capabilities, they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks, as even minor meaning-preserving changes such as synonym substitutions can lead to incorrect predictions. As a result, certifying the robustness of LLMs against such adversarial prompts is of vital importance. Existing approaches focused on word deletion or simple denoising strategies to achieve robustness certification. However, these methods face two critical limitations: (1) they yield loose robustness bounds due to the lack of semantic validation for perturbed outputs and (2) they suffer from high computational costs due to repeated sampling. To address these limitations, we propose CluCERT, a novel framework for certifying LLM robustness via clustering-guided denoising smoothing. Specifically, to achieve tighter certified bounds, we introduce a semantic clustering filter that reduces noisy samples and retains meaningful perturbations, supported by theoretical analysis. Furthermore, we enhance computational efficiency through two mechanisms: a refine module that extracts core semantics, and a fast synonym substitution strategy that accelerates the denoising process. Finally, we conduct extensive experiments on various downstream tasks and jailbreak defense scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms existing certified approaches in both robustness bounds and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型面对同义词替换等对抗性提示的鲁棒性认证问题，提出 CluCERT 框架，利用聚类引导的去噪平滑 (clustering-guided denoising smoothing) 来获得更紧的认证界并降低计算成本。通过语义聚类过滤去除噪声样本、精炼模块提取核心语义以及快速同义词替换加速去噪，实验表明该方法在多种下游任务和越狱防御场景中均优于现有认证方法。
Motivation: 现有认证方法由于缺乏对扰动输出的语义验证导致鲁棒界松散，且因重复采样导致计算成本高昂。
Method: 提出 CluCERT，包含语义聚类过滤 (semantic clustering filter) 以减少噪声并保留有意义扰动，辅以理论分析；以及两个提升效率的机制：精炼模块 (refine module) 提取核心语义和快速同义词替换策略 (fast synonym substitution strategy) 加速去噪。
Result: 在多个下游任务和越狱防御场景上的实验表明，CluCERT 在鲁棒性界和计算效率两方面均优于现有认证方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CluCERT 通过语义聚类和去噪平滑实现了更紧的认证界和更高的计算效率，可有效提升 LLM 对抗认证能力。
Relevance: 10
