papers.title: Beyond Chain-of-Thought: Rewrite as a Universal Interface for Generative Multimodal Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as a promising foundation for universal multimodal embeddings. Recent studies have shown that reasoning-driven generative multimodal embeddings can outperform discriminative embeddings on several embedding tasks. However, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning tends to generate redundant thinking steps and introduce semantic ambiguity in the summarized answers in broader retrieval scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose Rewrite-driven Multimodal Embedding (RIME), a unified framework that jointly optimizes generation and embedding through a retrieval-friendly rewrite. Meanwhile, we present the Cross-Mode Alignment (CMA) to bridge the generative and discriminative embedding spaces, enabling flexible mutual retrieval to trade off efficiency and accuracy. Based on this, we also introduce Refine Reinforcement Learning (Refine-RL) that treats discriminative embeddings as stable semantic anchors to guide the rewrite optimization. Extensive experiments on MMEB-V2, MRMR and UVRB demonstrate that RIME substantially outperforms prior generative embedding models while significantly reducing the length of thinking. Code is available at https://github.com/PeppaWu/RIME.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Rewrite-driven Multimodal Embedding (RIME)，一种将重写 (rewrite) 作为统一接口的生成式多模态嵌入框架。RIME 通过检索友好的重写来联合优化生成与嵌入，引入跨模态对齐 (CMA) 连接生成与判别空间，并采用精炼强化学习 (Refine-RL) 以判别嵌入作为稳定锚点指导重写优化。实验表明 RIME 在 MMEB-V2、MRMR 和 UVRB 基准上显著优于先前生成式嵌入模型，同时大幅缩短推理思考长度。
Motivation: 链式推理 (CoT) 在生成式多模态嵌入中会产生冗余思考步骤，并在广泛检索场景中引入语义歧义，限制检索性能。
Method: 提出 RIME 框架，包含三个关键设计：检索友好的重写作为生成与嵌入的统一接口；跨模态对齐 (CMA) 桥接生成式与判别式嵌入空间以实现灵活互检索；精炼强化学习 (Refine-RL) 利用判别式嵌入作为稳定语义锚点来优化重写策略。
Result: 在 MMEB-V2、MRMR 和 UVRB 等多个多模态嵌入基准上，RIME 超越此前最优的生成式嵌入模型，同时显著减少模型输出的思考长度。
Conclusion: 重写作为通用接口可以有效统一生成式多模态嵌入，为平衡效率与准确性提供新方案，但论文未提及在气象等特定领域中的适用性。

papers.title: Provable Coordination for LLM Agents via Message Sequence Charts
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) are difficult to reason about. Coordination errors such as deadlocks or type-mismatched messages are often hard to detect through testing. We introduce a domain-specific language for specifying agent coordination based on message sequence charts (MSCs). The language separates message-passing structure from LLM calls, tool calls, and human control points, whose outcomes remain unpredictable. We define the syntax and semantics of the language and present a syntax-directed projection that generates deadlock-free local agent programs from global coordination specifications. We illustrate the approach with a diagnosis consensus protocol and show how coordination properties can be established independently of LLM nondeterminism. We also describe a runtime planning extension in which an LLM dynamically generates a coordination workflow for which the same structural guarantees apply. An open-source Python implementation of our framework is available as ZipperGen.

papers.title: Animating Petascale Time-varying Data on Commodity Hardware with LLM-assisted Scripting
papers.abstract_en: Scientists face significant visualization challenges as time-varying datasets grow in speed and volume, often requiring specialized infrastructure and expertise to handle massive datasets. Petascale climate models generated in NASA laboratories require a dedicated group of graphics and media experts and access to high-performance computing resources. Scientists may need to share scientific results with the community iteratively and quickly. However, the time-consuming trial-and-error process incurs significant data transfer overhead and far exceeds the time and resources allocated for typical post-analysis visualization tasks, disrupting the production workflow. Our paper introduces a user-friendly framework for creating 3D animations of petascale, time-varying data on a commodity workstation. Our contributions: (i) Generalized Animation Descriptor (GAD) with a keyframe-based adaptable abstraction for animation, (ii) efficient data access from cloud-hosted repositories to reduce data management overhead, (iii) tailored rendering system, and (iv) an LLM-assisted conversational interface as a scripting module to allow domain scientists with no visualization expertise to create animations of their region of interest. We demonstrate the framework's effectiveness with two case studies: first, by generating animations in which sampling criteria are specified based on prior knowledge, and second, by generating AI-assisted animations in which sampling parameters are derived from natural-language user prompts. In all cases, we use large-scale NASA climate-oceanographic datasets that exceed 1PB in size yet achieve a fast turnaround time of 1 minute to 2 hours. Users can generate a rough draft of the animation within minutes, then seamlessly incorporate as much high-resolution data as needed for the final version.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个用户友好的框架，可在普通工作站上创建超过PB量级的时变数据（如NASA气候-海洋数据集）的3D动画。核心贡献包括通用动画描述符（GAD）、云端高效数据访问、定制渲染系统以及基于大语言模型（LLM）的对话式脚本界面，使无可视化经验的领域科学家也能生成动画。案例显示，在超过1PB的数据上，动画生成时间从1分钟到2小时不等。
Motivation: 随着时变数据集规模和产生速度的增长，科学家面临可视化挑战：现有方案需要专用高性能计算资源和专家团队，且迭代试错过程耗时且数据迁移开销大，打乱生产工作流。
Method: 提出框架包含：(i) 基于关键帧的可扩展动画抽象——通用动画描述符（GAD）；(ii) 从云托管存储高效访问数据以减少管理开销；(iii) 定制渲染系统；(iv) LLM辅助的对话式脚本模块，允许科学家通过自然语言指定采样参数。
Result: 在NASA超过1PB的气候-海洋数据集上，动画生成时间在1分钟到2小时之间。用户可在几分钟内生成动画草稿，随后无缝融入高分辨率数据制作最终版本。
Conclusion: 该框架降低了大规模时变数据可视化的门槛，使普通工作站上的快速迭代成为可能，但摘要未提及对降水预报（Precipitation）、临近预报（Nowcasting）等具体气象任务的直接验证。

papers.title: Native Extrapolation Awareness in Flow-Based Conditional Generation
papers.abstract_en: The ability of Flow Matching (FM) to model complex conditional distributions has established it as the state-of-the-art for prediction tasks (e.g., robotics, weather forecasting). However, deployment in safety-critical settings is hindered by a critical extrapolation hazard: driven by smoothness biases, flow models yield plausible outputs even for off-manifold conditions, resulting in silent failures indistinguishable from valid predictions. In this work, we introduce Diverging Flows, a novel approach that enables a single model to simultaneously perform conditional generation and native extrapolation detection by structurally enforcing inefficient transport for off-manifold inputs. We evaluate our method on synthetic manifolds, cross-domain style transfer, and weather temperature forecasting, demonstrating that it achieves effective detection of extrapolations without compromising predictive fidelity or inference latency. These results establish Diverging Flows as a robust solution for trustworthy flow models, paving the way for reliable deployment in domains such as medicine, robotics, and climate science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于流的条件生成模型（Flow Matching）在安全关键场景中的外推风险，提出了一种名为Diverging Flows的方法。该方法通过结构性地强制对离流形输入进行低效传输，使得单个模型能同时执行条件生成和原生外推检测。在合成流形、跨域风格迁移和天气预报等任务上验证了其有效性，表明在不牺牲预测精度或推理延迟的情况下，能有效检测外推。
Motivation: Flow Matching模型虽在复杂条件分布建模中表现出色，但其平滑性偏差会导致对离流形输入产生看似合理的输出，造成静默失败，阻碍其在安全关键领域（如医疗、机器人、气候预测）的部署。
Method: 提出Diverging Flows方法，在流模型中引入结构化机制，使模型对于离流形输入的低效传输成为检测外推的信号，从而在不改变原生成质量的前提下实现原生外推检测。
Result: 在合成流形、跨域风格迁移和温度预报任务上，该方法能有效检测外推样本，且不降低预测保真度或推理延迟。
Conclusion: Diverging Flows为构建可信赖的流模型提供了鲁棒方案，有望推动流模型在医疗、机器人和气候科学等安全关键领域的可靠部署。

papers.title: Stabilizing Native Low-Rank LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have achieved remarkable success, yet their growing parameter counts pose significant computational and memory challenges. Low-rank factorization offers a promising route to reduce training and inference costs, but the community lacks a stable recipe for training models from scratch using exclusively low-rank weights while matching the performance of the dense model. We demonstrate that Large Language Models (LLMs) can be trained from scratch using exclusively low-rank factorized weights for all non-embedding matrices without auxiliary "full-rank" guidance required by prior methods. While native low-rank training often suffers from instability and loss spikes, we identify uncontrolled growth in the spectral norm (largest singular value) of the weight matrix update as the dominant factor. To address this, we introduce Spectron: Spectral renormalization with orthogonalization, which dynamically bounds the resultant weight updates based on the current spectral norms of the factors. Our method enables stable, end-to-end factorized training with negligible overhead. Finally, we establish compute-optimal scaling laws for natively low-rank transformers, demonstrating predictable power-law behavior and improved inference efficiency relative to dense models.

TL;DR: 本文证明大语言模型（LLM）可以使用全低秩分解权重从头训练，无需辅助全秩指导，并提出Spectron方法通过谱归一化和正交化稳定训练，避免损失尖峰。实验表明该方法能实现稳定的端到端因子化训练，并建立了低秩Transformer的计算最优缩放定律，提升推理效率。
Motivation: 低秩分解可降低训练和推理成本，但缺乏稳定训练配方法，现有方法通常需要辅助全秩权重指导。
Method: 识别出权重矩阵更新的谱范数失控是训练不稳定的主因，提出Spectron：基于因子当前谱范数动态约束权重更新的谱归一化与正交化方法。
Result: 实现了稳定的全低秩LLM训练，无需全秩辅助，建立了计算最优缩放定律，推理效率优于密集模型。
Conclusion: 低秩LLM从头训练可行且高效，Spectron提供了稳定训练方案。

papers.title: Neural Architectures for Amortized Bayesian Inference: Statistical Foundations and Empirical Assessments
papers.abstract_en: Since the turn of the century, approximate Bayesian inference has steadily evolved as new computational techniques have been incorporated to handle increasingly complex, large-scale predictive problems. The recent success of deep neural networks and foundation models has now given rise to a new paradigm in statistical modeling, in which Bayesian inference can be amortized through large-scale learned predictors. In amortized inference, substantial computation is required at the beginning to train a neural network, but it can subsequently produce approximate posteriors or predictions at much lower computational cost across a wide range of tasks. While the typical Bayesian inference procedures are computationally expensive due to repeated likelihood calculations and Monte Carlo steps for each new dataset, amortized inference provides a much lower computational cost at deployment. Despite the growing popularity of amortized inference, its statistical interpretation and position within Bayesian inference remain poorly explored. In this paper, we present a statistical perspective on several major neural architectures, including feedforward networks, Deep Sets, and Transformers, and examine how they naturally support amortized Bayesian inference. We explore how these models perform structured approximation and also probabilistic reasoning in ways that yield controlled generalization error throughout a wide range of deployment scenarios, and how these properties can be harnessed for Bayesian computation. Via simulation studies, we evaluate the accuracy, robustness, and uncertainty quantification of amortized inference across varying sample sizes, varying noise distributional families, varying sparsity levels, and multimodality, highlighting its strengths and limitations.

Result: 通过仿真研究评估了摊销推断在不同场景下的准确性、鲁棒性和不确定性量化，指出了其优势和局限性。
Conclusion: 论文强调了摊销贝叶斯推断的统计基础，并指出了其在广泛部署场景中的性质。

papers.title: Fundamental Recovery Bounds for SPAD Signals under Stationary Flux
papers.abstract_en: Single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) record light as a discrete stream of individual detections. The signal is stochastic. Its statistical structure depends on the sensor's operation mode: binary detection in fixed bins, timestamped detection in fixed bins, or free-running timestamped detection. We derive the likelihood score function for each of these three passive modes. From this single object, stem both fundamental limits of recovery (Cramer-Rao bounds) and practical recovery algorithms based on diffusion posterior sampling. The paper further generalizes fundamental limits to Bayesian Cramer-Rao lower bounds. This generalization makes use of a learned approximation of the score function of signal priors. In prior art, analyses and diffusion-based reconstruction for SPAD data have treated individual modes in isolation. Our unified treatment shows a qualitative high-flux gap between modes: binary counts saturate exponentially, while timestamped modes degrade only linearly. We further extend diffusion posterior sampling, previously restricted to binary SPAD data, to a full timestamped case using the suitable score function. We demonstrate experimentally that matching the score to the operation mode is beneficial for high-fidelity reconstruction. By tying the recovery bounds and diffusion to the score function, this work aims to establish a common foundation for both asking what is recoverable in single-photon sensing, and building methods that approach the bound.

papers.title: Large language models can effectively convince people to believe conspiracies
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to be persuasive across a variety of contexts. But it remains unclear whether this persuasive power advantages accuracy, or if bad actors can just as easily use LLMs to promote misbeliefs. Here, we investigate this question across four experiments in which participants (N = 3996 Americans) discussed a conspiracy theory they were uncertain about with an LLM we instructed to either argue against ("debunking") or for ("bunking") that conspiracy. Across several frontier models (with standard guardrails but prompted to allow lying), we did not find consistent evidence of a truth advantage: the LLMs were able to both substantially increase and decrease average conspiracy belief, and participants in the bunking condition rated the LLM as more informative and collaborative, and reported greater trust in AI, than those who were in the debunking condition. More encouragingly, however, debunking induced more large changes in belief, and subsequent corrections were able to reverse the bunking effect. Furthermore, simply prompting the model to only provide accurate information dramatically reduced bunking effectiveness, and one powerful frontier model (GPT 5.2) almost entirely refused to promote conspiracies, suggesting that it is possible for the right guardrails to favor accurate beliefs. Finally, we did find a stark truth asymmetry in the context of information sharing: debunking had a large positive impact on mock social media posts composed by participants, while bunking had little effect. Overall, our findings show that people are not inherently less susceptible to AI that misleads than to AI that informs, but that potential technical solutions exist to mitigate this risk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过四项实验（N=3996美国人）研究大型语言模型（LLM）在说服人们相信阴谋论方面的能力。发现LLM既能显著增加也能降低平均阴谋论信念，且没有一致的真实优势；支持阴谋论条件下参与者更信任AI。但引导模型只提供准确信息或使用适当护栏可大幅降低误导效果，且反驳能引起更大信念变化并可逆转。
Motivation: 了解LLM的说服力是否总是利于真相，还是坏人也能利用LLM推广错误信念。
Method: 让参与者与LLM讨论他们不确定的阴谋论，LLM被指示要么反驳（debunking）要么支持（bunking）该阴谋论，测试多种前沿模型。
Result: LLM能显著增加或降低平均阴谋论信念；支持条件下参与者认为AI更信息丰富和合作；反驳引起更大信念变化且后续纠正可逆转；提示模型只提供准确信息大幅降低支持效果；GPT 5.2几乎拒绝支持阴谋论；反驳对社交媒体帖子有积极影响。
Conclusion: 人们并不天然对误导性AI更不敏感，但存在技术解决方案（如提示准确信息）来缓解风险。

papers.title: Sparse-LaViDa: Sparse Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked Discrete Diffusion Models (MDMs) have achieved strong performance across a wide range of multimodal tasks, including image understanding, generation, and editing. However, their inference speed remains suboptimal due to the need to repeatedly process redundant masked tokens at every sampling step. In this work, we propose Sparse-LaViDa, a novel modeling framework that dynamically truncates unnecessary masked tokens at each inference step to accelerate MDM sampling. To preserve generation quality, we introduce specialized register tokens that serve as compact representations for the truncated tokens. Furthermore, to ensure consistency between training and inference, we design a specialized attention mask that faithfully matches the truncated sampling procedure during training. Built upon the state-of-the-art unified MDM LaViDa-O, Sparse-LaViDa achieves up to a 2x speedup across diverse tasks including text-to-image generation, image editing, and mathematical reasoning, while maintaining generation quality.
papers.comment: 18 pages (12 pages for the main paper and 6 pages for the appendix), 9 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sparse-LaViDa，一种通过动态截断冗余掩码标记来加速掩码离散扩散模型 (MDM) 推理的框架。该方法引入专用注册标记 (register tokens) 作为截断标记的紧凑表示，并设计匹配截断采样的注意力掩码以保证训练与推理一致。基于统一 MDM 模型 LaViDa-O，Sparse-LaViDa 在文本到图像生成、图像编辑和数学推理等任务上实现了最高 2 倍的加速，同时保持生成质量。
Motivation: 掩码离散扩散模型 (MDM) 在推理时需要重复处理冗余掩码标记，导致速度欠佳，限制了其实用性。
Method: 提出动态截断不必要的掩码标记，并使用专门的注册标记作为紧凑表示；设计专门的注意力掩码以模拟截断采样过程，确保训练与推理一致。
Result: 在文本到图像生成、图像编辑和数学推理任务上，相比于基线 LaViDa-O，实现了最高 2 倍的加速，且生成质量得以保持。
Conclusion: Sparse-LaViDa 通过稀疏化处理有效提升了 MDM 的推理效率，为多模态离散扩散模型的实用化提供了新思路。

papers.title: A Weak Penalty Neural ODE for Learning Chaotic Dynamics from Noisy Time Series
papers.abstract_en: The accurate forecasting of complex, high-dimensional dynamical systems from observational data is a fundamental task across numerous scientific and engineering disciplines. A significant challenge arises from noise-corrupted measurements, which severely degrade the performance of data-driven models. In chaotic dynamical systems, where small initial errors amplify exponentially, it is particularly difficult to develop a model from noisy data that achieves short-term accuracy while preserving long-term invariant properties. To overcome this, we consider the weak formulation as a complementary approach to the classical $L2$-loss function for training models of dynamical systems. We empirically verify that the weak formulation, with a proper choice of test function and integration domain, effectively filters noisy data. This insight explains why a weak form loss function is analogous to fitting a model to filtered data and provides a practical way to parameterize the weak form. Subsequently, we demonstrate how this approach overcomes the instability and inaccuracy of standard Neural ODE (NODE) in modeling chaotic systems. Through numerical examples, we show that our proposed training strategy, the Weak Penalty NODE, is computationally efficient, solver-agnostic, and yields accurate and robust forecasts across benchmark chaotic systems and a real-world climate dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对噪声污染下混沌动力系统的预测难题，提出弱惩罚神经ODE（Weak Penalty NODE），通过弱形式损失函数有效过滤噪声，在保持长期不变性的同时实现短期准确预测。数值实验表明该方法在基准混沌系统和真实气候数据集上计算高效、求解器无关且鲁棒。
Motivation: 噪声污染的观测数据严重破坏数据驱动模型在混沌动力系统中的性能，传统L2损失难以同时兼顾短期精度和长期不变性。
Method: 采用弱形式（weak formulation）作为L2损失的补充，通过适当选择测试函数和积分域来过滤噪声，并将弱形式损失参数化，训练弱惩罚NODE。
Result: 在基准混沌系统和真实气候数据集上，弱惩罚NODE克服了标准NODE的不稳定性和不准确性，实现了准确且鲁棒的预测。
Conclusion: 弱惩罚NODE计算高效、求解器无关，适用于噪声混沌系统的预测。
Relevance: 50

papers.title: What Do Temporal Graph Learning Models Learn?
papers.abstract_en: Learning on temporal graphs has become a central topic in graph representation learning, with numerous benchmarks indicating the strong performance of state-of-the-art models. However, recent work has raised concerns about the reliability of benchmark results, noting issues with commonly used evaluation protocols and the surprising competitiveness of simple heuristics. This contrast raises the question of which characteristics of the underlying graphs temporal graph learning models actually use to form their predictions. We address this by systematically evaluating eight models on their ability to capture eight fundamental characteristics related to the link structure of temporal graphs. These include structural characteristics such as density, temporal patterns such as recency, and edge formation mechanisms such as homophily. Using both synthetic and real-world datasets, we analyze how well models learn these characteristics. Our findings reveal a mixed picture: models capture some characteristics well but fail to reproduce others. With this, we expose important limitations. Overall, we believe that our results provide practical insights for the application of temporal graph learning models and motivate more interpretability-driven evaluations in graph learning research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了八种时间图学习模型捕捉时间图链路结构八种基本特征（如密度、时效性、同质性等）的能力。通过合成和真实数据集实验，发现模型能良好捕捉部分特征但在其他特征上表现失败，揭示了模型的局限性，并推动可解释性驱动的评估。
Motivation: 现有时间图学习基准的可靠性受到质疑，简单启发式方法表现惊人，引发对模型实际依赖何种图特征的疑问。
Method: 设计八种特征（包括结构特征、时间模式和边形成机制），在合成和真实数据集上评估八种主流时间图模型学习这些特征的能力。
Result: 模型对某些特征（如密度）捕捉较好，但对其他特征（如某些时间模式）再现失败，体现混合结果。
Conclusion: 结果为时间图学习模型的应用提供实践见解，并呼吁更多可解释性驱动的图学习评估。

papers.title: Verbalized Sampling: How to Mitigate Mode Collapse and Unlock LLM Diversity
papers.abstract_en: Post-training alignment often reduces LLM diversity, leading to a phenomenon known as mode collapse. Unlike prior work that attributes this effect to algorithmic limitations, we identify a fundamental, pervasive data-level driver: typicality bias in preference data, whereby annotators systematically favor familiar text as a result of well-established findings in cognitive psychology. We formalize this bias theoretically, verify it on preference datasets empirically, and show that it plays a central role in mode collapse. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce Verbalized Sampling, a simple, training-free prompting strategy to circumvent mode collapse. VS prompts the model to verbalize a probability distribution over a set of responses (e.g., "Generate 5 jokes about coffee and their corresponding probabilities"). Comprehensive experiments show that VS significantly improves performance across creative writing (poems, stories, jokes), dialogue simulation, open-ended QA, and synthetic data generation, without sacrificing factual accuracy and safety. For instance, in creative writing, VS increases diversity by 1.6-2.1x over direct prompting. We further observe an emergent trend that more capable models benefit more from VS. In sum, our work provides a new data-centric perspective on mode collapse and a practical inference-time remedy that helps unlock pre-trained generative diversity.
papers.comment: 83 pages, 31 figures, 44 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/CHATS-lab/verbalize-sampling
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现后训练对齐导致LLM模式坍塌的根本原因是偏好数据中的典型性偏差（typicality bias），即注释者系统性地偏好熟悉文本。作者形式化该偏差，在偏好数据集中验证，并提出一种无需训练的提示策略Verbalized Sampling（VS），通过让模型口头化输出分布来提升多样性。实验表明VS在创意写作、对话模拟、开放问答等方面显著提升多样性，例如创意写作多样性提升1.6-2.1倍，且不牺牲事实准确性和安全性。
Motivation: 现有工作将模式坍塌归因于算法限制，但本文识别出其数据层面的驱动因素：偏好数据中的典型性偏差。需要缓解这种偏差以解锁LLM的生成多样性。
Method: 提出Verbalized Sampling（VS）提示策略，无需训练，在推理时通过让模型口头化输出一组响应及其概率分布（例如'生成5个关于咖啡的笑话及其对应概率'）来绕过典型性偏差。
Result: 实验显示VS在多项任务上显著提升多样性：创意写作多样性提升1.6-2.1倍；对话模拟、开放问答、合成数据生成等也有改善，且不损失事实准确性和安全性。更强大的模型从VS中获益更多。
Conclusion: 本文提供了对模式坍塌的新数据视角（典型性偏差），并给出实用的推理时补救方法，有助于解锁预训练模型的生成多样性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EEG-based AI-BCI Wheelchair Advancement: Transformer-Based Learning with Motor Imagery for Brain Computer Interface
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an Artificial Intelligence (AI) integrated approach to Brain-Computer Interface (BCI)-based wheelchair development, utilizing a motor imagery right-left-hand movement mechanism for control. The system is designed to simulate wheelchair navigation based on motor imagery right and left-hand movements using electroencephalogram (EEG) data. A pre-filtered dataset, obtained from an open-source EEG repository, was segmented into arrays of 19x200 to capture the onset of hand movements. The data was acquired at a sampling frequency of 200Hz. The system integrates a Tkinter-based interface for simulating wheelchair movements, offering users a functional and intuitive control system. We propose TFormerEEG, a Transformer-driven deep learning architecture, for motor imagery EEG classification. The model achieves a test accuracy of 93.04% compared with various machine learning baseline models, including XGBoost, EEGNet, and an EEG-Deformer model. The TFormerEEG achieved a mean accuracy of 91.18% through stratified cross-validation, showcasing the effectiveness of this model.

papers.title: Lavida-O: Elastic Large Masked Diffusion Models for Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: We propose Lavida-O, a unified Masked Diffusion Model (MDM) for multimodal understanding and generation. Unlike existing multimodal MDMs such as MMaDa and Muddit which only support simple image-level understanding tasks and low-resolution image generation, Lavida-O presents a single framework that enables image-level understanding, object grounding, image editing, and high-resolution (1024px) text-to-image synthesis. Lavida-O incorporates a novel Elastic Mixture-of-Transformers (Elastic-MoT) architecture that couples a lightweight generation branch with a larger understanding branch, supported by token compression, universal text conditioning and stratified sampling for efficient and high-quality generation. Lavida-O further incorporates planning and iterative self-reflection in image generation and editing tasks, seamlessly boosting generation quality with its understanding capabilities. Lavida-O achieves state-of-the-art performance on a wide range of benchmarks including RefCOCO object grounding, GenEval text-to-image generation, and ImgEdit image editing, outperforming existing autoregressive models and continuous diffusion models such as Qwen2.5-VL and FluxKontext-dev, while offering considerable speedup at inference. These advances establish Lavida-O as a new paradigm for scalable multimodal reasoning and generation.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 提出 Elastic-MoT 架构，包含轻量生成分支和较大理解分支，结合 token 压缩、通用文本条件化和分层采样；在生成和编辑任务中引入规划与迭代自反思机制。

papers.title: L-MARS: Legal Multi-Agent System with Agentic Search and Citation-Faithfulness Audit
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed for legal question answering, where evaluations typically focus on multiple-choice accuracy. This measure overlooks a common failure: whether the citation source attached to an answer exists and supports the rule the system attributes to it. We present L-MARS, an open multi-agent legal QA system with agentic search and judge-driven evidence checks, and audit it claim by claim against its cited source. Each atomic claim is labelled with a six-class taxonomy and scored with strict-ALCE under cross-provider judging, where the answerer and verifier come from different model families. On a stratified 100-question Bar Exam audit, retrieval barely moves accuracy, yet the multi-turn judge loop lifts strict citation F1 from 0.13 (naive RAG) to 0.25 and cuts the no-citation rate from 34% to 13%. We further introduce Faith-Search, a post-draft step that re-verifies and repairs unreachable citations; it drops the unreachable rate below 1% but does not improve F1 over the multi-turn loop, so we report it as a targeted reachability intervention rather than a faithfulness breakthrough. A 50-question LegalSearchQA case study confirms the picture: retrieve-then-draft pipelines saturate near 0.75 citation F1, while a single-agent web-search baseline collapses to 0.22 under external audit.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AI4Law Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对法律问答系统中引用来源存在且支持所陈述规则这一常见失败模式，本文提出 L-MARS，一个开放的多智能体法律问答系统，融合智能搜索和法官驱动的证据检查。在分层抽样的 100 题律师资格考试审计中，多轮法官循环将严格引用 F1 从 0.13 提升至 0.25，无引用率从 34% 降至 13%，并进一步引入 Faith-Search 步骤将不可达率降至 1% 以下。
Motivation: 现有法律问答评估只关注多项选择准确率，忽略了引用是否存在以及是否支持所陈述规则的问题。
Method: 提出 L-MARS 多智能体系统，包含智能搜索（agentic search）和法官驱动的证据检查（judge-driven evidence checks）。每个原子声明被标注为六类分类，并在跨提供者评判（答案器和验证器来自不同模型家族）下以严格-ALCE 评分。还引入 Faith-Search 作为后写步骤重新验证并修复不可达引用。
Result: 在 100 题律师资格考试审计中，多轮法官循环将严格引用 F1 从 0.13（朴素 RAG）提升至 0.25，无引用率从 34% 降至 13%。Faith-Search 将不可达率降至 1% 以下，但未进一步提升 F1。LegalSearchQA 案例研究表明检索-生成流程的引用 F1 接近 0.75，而单智能体网页搜索基线在外部审计下降至 0.22。
Conclusion: 多轮法官循环能显著改善引用忠实性，但 Faith-Search 作为针对性可达性干预而非忠实性突破。论文强调对法律问答系统进行细粒度引用审计的必要性。

papers.title: GSVisLoc: Generalizable Visual Localization for Gaussian Splatting Scene Representations
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GSVisLoc, a visual localization method designed for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scene representations. Given a 3DGS model of a scene and a query image, our goal is to estimate the camera's position and orientation. We accomplish this by robustly matching scene features to image features. Scene features are produced by downsampling and encoding the 3D Gaussians while image features are obtained by encoding image patches. Our algorithm proceeds in three steps, starting with coarse matching, then fine matching, and finally by applying pose refinement for an accurate final estimate. Importantly, our method leverages the explicit 3DGS scene representation for visual localization without requiring modifications, retraining, or additional reference images. We evaluate GSVisLoc on both indoor and outdoor scenes, demonstrating competitive localization performance on standard benchmarks while outperforming existing 3DGS-based baselines. Moreover, our approach generalizes effectively to novel scenes without additional training.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICCV 2025 Workshops (CALIPOSE). Project page: https://gsvisloc.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GSVisLoc 是一种针对 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 场景表示的视觉定位方法，通过鲁棒匹配场景特征和图像特征来估计相机位姿，无需修改、重训练或额外参考图像。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 方法在视觉定位任务上性能有限，且通常需要场景微调或额外数据，缺乏泛化能力。
Method: 三阶段流程：粗匹配、细匹配、位姿精化；场景特征通过对 3D 高斯下采样和编码得到，图像特征通过编码图像块得到。
Result: 在室内外基准上达到有竞争力的定位性能，优于现有基于 3DGS 的基线方法，且能泛化到未见场景。
Conclusion: GSVisLoc 利用显式 3DGS 表示实现无需修改的视觉定位，但仅评估了标准定位基准。

papers.title: Addressing Benchmarking Gaps in Large Language Models for Health and Medicine with Dynamic Red-Teaming
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to answer health-related questions and support healthcare workflows, yet evidence for their safety still relies heavily on static benchmarks that can rapidly become obsolete or be optimized against. Here we introduce a Dynamic, Automatic, and Systematic (DAS) red-teaming audit framework that continuously stress-tests LLMs for health across four safety-critical axes: robustness, privacy, bias/fairness, and hallucination/factual inaccuracies. Validated against board-certified clinicians with high concordance, a suite of adversarial agents autonomously mutates health-related test cases to uncover vulnerabilities in real time. Applying DAS to 15 proprietary and open-source LLMs revealed a profound gap between high static benchmark performance and low dynamic reliability--the "Benchmarking Gap". Despite median MedQA accuracy exceeding 80\%, 94\% of previously correct answers failed under dynamic robustness testing. This brittleness generalized to the realistic, open-ended HealthBench dataset, where top-tier models exhibited failure rates exceeding 70\% and sharp shifts in model rankings across evaluations, suggesting that high scores on established static benchmarks may reflect superficial memorization. We observed similarly high failure rates across other domains: privacy leaks were elicited in 86\% of scenarios, cognitive-bias priming altered recommendations in 81\% of fairness tests, and hallucination rates exceeded 74\% in widely used models. By converting LLM safety evaluation for health from a static checklist into a living adversarial audit, DAS provides a scalable framework for surfacing latent risks before such systems are deployed in consumer-facing health assistants, clinician-facing tools, and broader healthcare workflows. Code is available at https://github.com/JZPeterPan/DAS-Medical-Red-Teaming-Agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态、自动、系统（DAS）红队测试框架，用于持续压力测试大语言模型在健康领域的鲁棒性、隐私、偏见/公平性和幻觉/事实准确性。通过对抗代理自动变异健康相关测试用例，在15个专有和开源LLM上评估，发现静态基准（如MedQA）准确率中位数超过80%，但94%的先前正确答案在动态鲁棒性测试中失败，揭示了静态高表现与动态低可靠性之间的“基准差距”。顶级模型在开放式HealthBench数据集上失败率超过70%，且模型排名在评估间发生剧变，表明高静态分数可能反映表面记忆。
Motivation: 现有静态基准容易过时或被对抗优化，无法充分评估LLM在健康领域的安全性，亟需一种可动态、自动、系统地暴露潜在风险的审计框架。
Method: 提出DAS（Dynamic, Automatic, Systematic）框架，包含一组对抗代理，可自主变异健康相关测试用例，在鲁棒性、隐私、偏见/公平性和幻觉四个安全关键轴上进行实时压力测试，并经委员会认证临床医生验证具有高一致性。
Result: 在15个LLM上，94%的先前正确答案在动态鲁棒性测试中失败；HealthBench数据集中顶级模型失败率超过70%；隐私泄露在86%的场景中被触发，认知偏差诱导改变81%公平性测试中的推荐，常用模型幻觉率超过74%。
Conclusion: DAS将LLM健康安全评估从静态清单转变为动态对抗审计，提供可扩展框架以在部署前暴露潜在风险，适用于面向消费者的健康助手、临床工具及更广泛的医疗工作流程。

papers.title: A Machine Learning Benchmarking Framework for Lipid Nanoparticle Transfection Efficiency Prediction
papers.abstract_en: The discovery of new ionizable lipids for efficient lipid nanoparticle (LNP)-mediated RNA delivery remains a major bottleneck in RNA therapeutics development. Recent advances demonstrate the potential of machine learning (ML) models to predict transfection efficiency directly from lipid structure, enabling high-throughput virtual screening and accelerating lead identification. However, as new models for LNP transfection prediction continue to emerge, the lack of rigorous and standardized benchmarking poses a significant risk and may undermine confidence in their reliability for discovery. Here, we present a robust ML benchmarking framework for evaluating transfection prediction models based on ionizable lipid structures. This framework systematically benchmarks diverse molecular representations paired with a broad range of ML architectures spanning traditional models, feedforward neural networks, and state-of-the-art graph-based methods. In addition, the presented framework supports assessment of model generalization and evaluates prediction reliability beyond standard regression metrics. Using a curated dataset of 1,100 unique ionizable lipid structures derived from the HeLa transfection dataset originally reported by Xu et al., we show that within this framework, models leveraging explicit molecular substructure encoding consistently achieve the highest predictive accuracy and should serve as essential baselines for the development of new, more sophisticated models. In contrast, some current graph-based models, including AGILE, Chemprop, and KPGT, tend to show comparatively lower accuracy. The presented framework provides a standardized, transparent, and comprehensive benchmarking resource that enables meaningful comparison of emerging architectures and establishes strong baselines for future development of predictive models in lipid-based RNA delivery.
papers.comment: Published in Communications AI & Computing (Nature Portfolio), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个机器学习基准框架，用于评估基于可电离脂质结构预测脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）转染效率的模型。框架系统比较了多种分子表示和ML架构，包括传统模型、前馈神经网络和图方法。使用Xu等人原始HeLa转染数据集的1100个脂质结构，发现显式分子子结构编码的模型预测精度最高，而AGILE、Chemprop、KPGT等当前图模型精度较低。框架提供了标准化、透明的基准资源。
Motivation: 高效可电离脂质的发现是RNA递送的主要瓶颈，但现有LNP转染预测模型缺乏严格标准的基准测试，可能损害对其可靠性的信心。
Method: 提出一个ML基准框架，系统评估多种分子表示（指纹、描述符、图等）与ML架构（传统模型、前馈网络、图方法）的组合，支持模型泛化评估和超出标准回归指标的可靠性评估，使用由1,100个脂质结构组成的精心策划数据集。
Result: 框架内，利用显式分子子结构编码的模型持续达到最高预测精度；相比之下，AGILE、Chemprop、KPGT等图模型精度较低。

papers.title: Fully Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline RL (ORL) promises safe and sample-efficient deployment but existing methods rely on undocumented online interactions for hyperparameter tuning and lack reliable fully offline estimates of initial online performance. We introduce SOReL, a fully offline Bayesian model-based RL method that learns a posterior over dynamics, estimates policy value via predictive uncertainty, and enables complete offline hyperparameter selection. We further propose TOReL, which extends this tuning framework to arbitrary model-free and model-based ORL algorithms. We provide a regret analysis showing that Bayesian offline RL achieves the minimax-optimal parametric rate under standard regularity conditions. Together, our methods establish a practical and theoretically grounded framework for fully offline RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对离线强化学习（ORL）中依赖在线交互进行超参数调优的问题，提出了完全离线的贝叶斯模型方法SOReL，以及可扩展的调优框架TOReL，并给出了遗憾分析，证明在标准正则条件下达到极小极大最优参数率。
Motivation: 现有离线RL方法需要未记录的在线交互进行超参数调优，且缺乏可靠的全离线初始性能估计。
Method: 提出SOReL，一种完全离线的贝叶斯模型方法，学习动力学后验，通过预测不确定性估计策略价值，实现完全离线的超参数选择；并提出TOReL，将该调优框架扩展到任意无模型和基于模型的离线RL算法。
Result: 提供了遗憾分析，证明贝叶斯离线RL在标准正则条件下达到极小极大最优参数率。
Conclusion: 共同建立了实用且理论完备的完全离线RL框架。

papers.title: Generalized Fisher-Weighted SVD: Scalable Kronecker-Factored Fisher Approximation for Compressing Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The Fisher information is a fundamental concept for characterizing the sensitivity of parameters in neural networks. However, leveraging the full observed Fisher information is too expensive for large models, so most methods rely on simple diagonal approximations. While efficient, this approach ignores parameter correlations, often resulting in reduced performance on downstream tasks. In this work, we mitigate these limitations and propose Generalized Fisher-Weighted SVD (GFWSVD), a post-training LLM compression technique that accounts for both diagonal and off-diagonal elements of the Fisher information matrix, providing a more accurate reflection of parameter importance. To make the method tractable, we introduce a scalable adaptation of the Kronecker-factored approximation algorithm for the observed Fisher information. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on LLM compression, showing improvements over existing compression baselines. For example, at a 20 compression rate on the MMLU benchmark, our method outperforms FWSVD, which is based on a diagonal approximation of the Fisher information, by 5 percent, SVD-LLM by 3 percent, and ASVD by 6 percent compression rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Generalized Fisher-Weighted SVD (GFWSVD)，一种后训练 LLM 压缩方法，利用 Fisher 信息矩阵的 Kronecker 因子化近似来同时考虑对角和非对角元素，更准确地反映参数重要性。在 MMLU 基准上，20 倍压缩率下，GFWSVD 比基于对角近似的 FWSVD 提升 5%，比 SVD-LLM 提升 3%，比 ASVD 提升 6%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 压缩方法大多使用 Fisher 信息的对角近似，忽略参数相关性，导致下游任务性能下降。需要一种既考虑对角又考虑非对角元素的可扩展方法。
Method: 提出 GFWSVD，采用 Kronecker 因子化近似算法来估计观测 Fisher 信息矩阵，实现可扩展的后训练压缩。
Result: 在 MMLU 基准上，20 倍压缩率下，GFWSVD 优于 FWSVD（+5%）、SVD-LLM（+3%）和 ASVD（+6%）。
Conclusion: GFWSVD 通过更精确的 Fisher 近似提高了 LLM 压缩性能，尤其在考虑参数相关性时表现出优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LaViDa: A Large Diffusion Language Model for Multimodal Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can solve a wide range of tasks requiring visual reasoning. In real-world scenarios, desirable properties for VLMs include fast inference and controllable generation (e.g., constraining outputs to adhere to a desired format). However, existing autoregressive (AR) VLMs like LLaVA struggle in these aspects. Discrete diffusion models (DMs) offer a promising alternative, enabling parallel decoding for faster inference and bidirectional context for controllable generation through text-infilling. While effective in language-only settings, DMs' potential for multimodal tasks is underexplored. We introduce LaViDa, a family of VLMs built on DMs. We build LaViDa by equipping DMs with a vision encoder and jointly fine-tune the combined parts for multimodal instruction following. To address challenges encountered, LaViDa incorporates novel techniques such as complementary masking for effective training, prefix KV cache for efficient inference, and timestep shifting for high-quality sampling. Experiments show that LaViDa achieves competitive or superior performance to AR VLMs on multi-modal benchmarks such as MMMU, while offering unique advantages of DMs, including flexible speed-quality tradeoff, controllability, and bidirectional reasoning. On COCO captioning, LaViDa surpasses Open-LLaVa-Next-8B by +4.1 CIDEr with 1.92x speedup. On bidirectional tasks, it achieves +59% improvement on Constrained Poem Completion. These results demonstrate LaViDa as a strong alternative to AR VLMs. Code and models will be released in the camera-ready version.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LaViDa，一种基于离散扩散模型（discrete diffusion model）的视觉语言模型（VLM）家族，旨在克服自回归VLM推理慢和可控性差的缺点。LaViDa通过结合视觉编码器与扩散模型，并引入互补掩码、前缀KV缓存和时间步偏移等新技术，在多模态基准（如MMMU）上取得与自回归VLM相当或更优的性能，同时实现灵活的速度-质量权衡、可控生成和双向推理。在COCO captioning上，LaViDa以1.92倍加速超越Open-LLaVa-Next-8B，CIDEr提升4.1；在约束诗歌补全任务上提升59%。
Motivation: 现有自回归VLM（如LLaVA）推理慢且难以实现可控生成（如约束输出格式），而离散扩散模型在纯语言任务中已展现出并行解码和双向上下文的优势，但其在多模态领域的潜力未被充分探索。
Method: 将离散扩散模型与视觉编码器结合，构建LaViDa模型，并通过联合微调实现多模态指令跟随；提出互补掩码（complementary masking）用于高效训练、前缀KV缓存（prefix KV cache）用于加速推理、时间步偏移（timestep shifting）用于提升采样质量。
Result: 在多模态基准MMMU上取得与自回归VLM竞争力或更优的性能；在COCO captioning上以1.92倍加速超越Open-LLaVa-Next-8B，CIDEr提升4.1；在约束诗歌补全（双向任务）上提升59%。
Conclusion: LaViDa证明了扩散模型作为自回归VLM强替代方案的潜力，兼具快速推理、可控生成和双向推理优势，代码与模型将在后续版本开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conditioning Residuals for Diffusion Models via Representation Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models now serve as a common foundation for multimedia generation, and useful intermediate representations emerge during their generative training. Standard architectures, however, propagate these representations through the main feature stream, without explicitly reintroducing their encoded semantics to later denoising layers. Meanwhile, such backbones already provide a conditioning pathway for global modulation by predefined inputs. This work examines whether this native pathway can also route internally inferred semantics as evolving, sample-dependent cues. We propose Conditioning Residuals, a lightweight feedback mechanism that converts aggregated features into residuals added to condition embeddings. By feeding back compact feature summaries, it provides adaptive generative guidance and encourages a tighter semantic bottleneck, without external encoders, auxiliary objectives, or sampling-time changes. It supports feedback at one or multiple depths in UNet and DiT backbones, with negligible overhead. Across diffusion formulations, backbone configurations, and datasets, experiments show consistent gains in generative performance, along with stronger representations in downstream linear probing and segmentation. Mechanistic analyses reveal improved generative training dynamics and reshaped feature structure, suggesting a grounded, generalizable way to enhance diffusion backbones from within.
papers.comment: Substantially revised and retitled. Code available at https://github.com/FutureXiang/ddae_plus_plus
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Conditioning Residuals，一种轻量级反馈机制，将扩散模型内部特征聚合为残差添加到条件嵌入中，无需外部编码器或辅助目标，即可提供自适应生成指导。实验在 UNet 和 DiT 骨干上，多种扩散公式和数据集下均取得一致的生成性能提升，并改善了线性探测和分割表征。
Motivation: 标准扩散架构未将中间表示中编码的语义显式重新引入后续去噪层，而本工作中作者研究是否可以利用已有的条件路径来路由内部推理出的语义作为随样本变化的线索。
Method: 提出 Conditioning Residuals，将聚合特征转换为加到条件嵌入上的残差，通过反馈紧凑特征摘要提供自适应生成指导，支持一个或多个深度的反馈，开销可忽略。
Result: 实验表明在多种扩散公式、骨干配置和数据集上，生成性能一致提升，下游线性探测和分割表征也更强。
Conclusion: 机制分析显示改进的生成训练动态和重塑的特征结构，表明一种从内部增强扩散骨干的通用方法。

papers.title: Distributionally Robust Optimization via Iterative Algorithms in Continuous Probability Spaces
papers.abstract_en: We study distributionally robust optimization (DRO) for robust inference when the worst-case distribution is continuous, leading to significant computational challenges due to the infinite-dimensional nature of the optimization problem. Unlike traditional discrete DRO approaches, which often suffer from scalability issues, limited generalization, and costly worst-case inference, our framework exploits Brenier's theorem to characterize the least favorable distribution as the pushforward of a transport map from a continuous reference measure. This characterization motivates our study of the minimax problem in Wasserstein space. We propose an iterative algorithmic framework with multiple variants and establish global convergence guarantees under mild assumptions, deriving complexity bounds in terms of subgradient evaluations and inexact Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto updates. Numerical results with neural network-based transport maps demonstrate that the proposed method enables both stable training of robust classifiers and effective worst-case inference for classification tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续概率空间中的分布鲁棒优化（DRO），通过 Brenier 定理将最坏情况分布表示为连续参考测度经传输映射推前，从而将问题转化为 Wasserstein 空间上的极小极大问题。提出了多种迭代算法变体，在温和假设下证明全局收敛性，并给出了基于次梯度评估和不精确 Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto 更新的复杂度界。使用神经网络传输映射的数值实验表明，该方法能稳定训练鲁棒分类器并进行有效的 worst-case 推断。
Motivation: 传统离散 DRO 方法面临可扩展性差、泛化有限及最坏情况推断成本高等问题；连续最坏情况分布导致优化问题无限维，带来巨大计算挑战。
Method: 利用 Brenier 定理将最坏情况分布表示为连续参考测度通过传输映射推前，将极小极大问题转化为 Wasserstein 空间上的优化。提出迭代算法框架及其多个变体，并建立全局收敛理论。
Result: 在温和假设下推导了次梯度评价和不精确 Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto 更新的复杂度界；基于神经网络传输映射的数值实验表明方法能稳定训练鲁棒分类器并实现有效的最坏情况推断。
Conclusion: 该工作为连续概率空间下的 DRO 提供了理论保证与实用算法，尤其适用于神经网络驱动的传输映射场景。

papers.title: Decoupled Alignment for Robust Plug-and-Play Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a training-free safety enhancement method for aligning large language models (LLMs) without the need for supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning from human feedback. Our main idea is to provide a robust plug-and-play approach to prevent shadow alignment when models are adapted to downstream tasks. Specifically, we leverage knowledge distillation to extract alignment signals from well-aligned LLMs and inject them into shadow-aligned models via model fusion, enabling plug-and-play alignment correction. In our methodology, we employ delta debugging to identify the critical components of knowledge necessary for effective distillation. On the harmful question dataset, our method significantly enhances the average defense success rate by approximately 14.42%, reaching as high as 51.39% across 17 influenced LLMs, without compromising performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/NWULIST/DAPA.

Result: 在有害问题数据集上，平均防御成功率提升约14.42%，在17个受影响LLM上最高达51.39%，且不牺牲模型原有性能。

papers.title: Deep-learning Causal Retrieval Optimization for Efficient e-commerce Distribution in Pinterest
papers.abstract_en: Pinterest is where people turn inspiration into action as users browse ideas, then take steps toward realization, often by discovering shoppable content. To support this journey, we must distribute commerce content when it helps, not when it distracts. We frame this as a causal decision of triggering shopping candidate generators in early retrieval and deploy a production system at Pinterest that learns personalized and contextualized triggering policies. A deep multi-task model jointly predicts outcomes and uplift of multiple events, trained with a doubly-robust pseudo-outcome alongside calibrated outcome losses for stable, single-robust uplift learning. A randomized data logging supplies counterfactual coverage, and the model is evaluated by both regular and reverse metrics for full assessment. A linear-time offline replay is designed to select thresholds and forecast policy impact with extremely high consistency with online results. For productionization, the model runs in parallel with remote retrieval calls without end-to-end latency regression. At web scale, we cut shopping triggers by up to 85% while holding key shopping sessions neutral, improving important total sessions (+0.26%) and Pin saves (+1.10%), with significant infrastructure savings. By unifying deep causal learning with reliable offline replay and demonstrating production-grade deployment, this work provides a generally practical recipe for early-retrieval optimizations in modern cascading recommenders beyond shopping, aligning exploration and cost with user intent at scale.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个在Pinterest电商早期检索阶段进行因果触发优化的生产系统。该系统使用深度多任务模型联合预测多个事件的结果和提升，结合双稳健伪结果和校准损失进行训练，并设计线性时间离线重放来模拟策略影响。在web规模上，该系统减少了85%的购物触发，同时保持关键购物会话中性，显著提升了总会话数和Pin保存量，并节省了基础设施成本。
Motivation: 在Pinterest上，需要在不干扰用户的前提下分发电商内容，因此需要决策何时触发购物候选生成器。这被建模为一个因果决策问题，旨在优化触发策略。
Method: 提出一个生产级系统，采用深度多任务模型联合预测多个事件的标准结果和提升（uplift）。训练时使用双稳健（doubly-robust）伪结果和校准的损失函数，通过随机数据日志提供反事实覆盖。设计线性时间离线重放机制用于选择阈值并预测策略影响，与在线结果高度一致。
Result: 在web规模上，购物触发量减少高达85%，关键购物会话保持中性，总会话数提升0.26%，Pin保存提升1.10%，同时实现了显著的基础设施节省。
Conclusion: 通过将深度因果学习与可靠的离线重放相结合并实现生产级部署，这项工作为现代级联推荐系统中的早期检索优化提供了一个通用实用的方法，可扩展到购物之外的领域。

papers.title: QFireNet: A Quantum-Enhanced U-Net for Wildfire Segmentation from Sentinel-2 Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Wildfire detection from satellite imagery is a semantic image segmentation problem that has proven to be difficult due to challenges such as class imbalance, feature complexity, and atmospheric interference. In this paper, we build on the foundational U-Net image segmentation model to develop a quantum-hybrid solution in hopes of more effectively modeling the high-dimensional spectral feature space of the Sen2Fire dataset. We inject a variational quantum circuit in the bottleneck portion of U-Net, specifically the QuFeX and QB-Net ansatzes. We test a classical Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) for further comparative analysis of the model, and we also explore classical improvements to the U-Net model and its training process, including a compression of parameters, alternative loss functions, and uniform mixing of input data. Our primary finding is that under matched conditions, both QB-Net (with an $F_1$ score of 31.18) and QuFeX ($F_1 = 30.79$) outperformed the classical U-Net baseline results ($F_1 = 28.71$). Additionally, the classical FPN achieved a comparable score of 31.13. A crucial finding was that data mixing removed a significant domain shift between the geographically-separated train and test sets, which boosted the classical FPN $F_1$ score to 39.76. We validate the architecture's robustness and generalizability to the wildfire detection problem via cross-dataset transfer on the California Burned Areas (CaBuAr) dataset. Overall, we find that quantum machine learning has potential to provide an advantage in the problem of wildfire image segmentation, and further experiments will continue to validate and expand upon this finding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QFireNet，一种量子增强U-Net模型，用于从Sentinel-2影像中分割野火区域。在Sen2Fire数据集上，量子变分电路（QB-Net和QuFeX）在F1分数上优于经典U-Net基线，数据混合进一步提升了经典FPN的F1分数。跨数据集验证在CaBuAr上证明了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 卫星影像野火检测受类别不平衡、特征复杂和大气干扰影响，传统U-Net难以有效建模高维光谱特征空间。
Method: 在U-Net瓶颈层注入变分量子电路（QuFeX和QB-Net ansatzes），并探索参数压缩、替代损失函数和数据混合等经典改进。
Result: QB-Net（F1=31.18）和QuFeX（F1=30.79）超越经典U-Net基线（F1=28.71）；数据混合将FPN的F1提升至39.76。
Conclusion: 量子机器学习在野火图像分割中具有潜力，但需要进一步实验验证。

papers.title: MemoHarness: Agent Harnesses That Learn from Experience
papers.abstract_en: An agent harness is the external control layer that turns a base LLM into an executable agent by managing context, tools, orchestration, memory, decoding, and output handling. While harness design strongly affects agent behavior, most automatic improvement methods optimize narrower artifacts such as prompts, pipelines, or workflows, and deployed agents usually reuse a single global harness for all cases. We introduce MemoHarness, an adaptive harness optimization framework that learns from its own executions. MemoHarness decomposes the harness into six editable control dimensions, stores per-case diagnoses and distilled global patterns in a dual-layer experience bank, and adapts the learned harness to each test case using retrieved experience without test-time labels, feedback, or additional search. In our evaluation across shell-agent, code-generation, and analytical-reasoning benchmarks, MemoHarness improves over the fixed harnesses we compare against and shows selective transfer to unseen suites and base models. Its additional context can also remain cost-competitive when much of the retrieved experience is cacheable. These results provide evidence that execution experience is a practical substrate for building agent harnesses that are more adaptive than a single static configuration, while leaving broader claims about statistical robustness and component attribution to future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemoHarness是一个自适应代理框架，通过从执行经验中学习来优化基础LLM的外部控制层（harness）。它将harness分解为六个可编辑维度，利用双层经验库存储案例诊断和全局模式，并在测试时通过检索调整harness，无需标签或额外搜索。在shell-agent、代码生成和分析推理基准上，它相比固定harness实现了改进，并显示出对未见套件和基础模型的选择性迁移能力。
Motivation: 现有代理大多数使用单一的全局harness，而自动改进方法多针对提示或工作流等更窄的组件，缺乏从执行经验中自适应调整harness的能力。
Method: 提出MemoHarness框架，将harness分解为六个可编辑控制维度，构建双层经验库（每案例诊断和全局模式），通过检索经验自适应调整harness，无需测试时标签或额外搜索。
Result: 在shell-agent、代码生成和分析推理基准上，MemoHarness优于固定harness对比项，并展现出对未见套件和基础模型的选择性迁移，且当经验可缓存时额外上下文成本可控。
Conclusion: 执行经验可作为构建比单一静态配置更自适应的代理harness的实用基础，但统计鲁棒性和组件归因等更广泛的主张留待未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Orchestrating Power Grid Studies with Multi-Agent AI and MCP Servers
papers.abstract_en: This position paper explores how Agentic AI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) can support power-grid studies in a Transmission System Operator (TSO) context. We focus on integrating Large Language Models with numerical simulation tools, structured workflows, and human supervision. We identify key industrial requirements for agent assisted grid studies and introduce pypowsybl-mcp, an MCP-based interface exposing selected capabilities of our simulation tool, pypowsybl to AI agents. This first step provides a testbed to study how agents can setup simulations, execute analyses, retrieve results, and interact with power-system simulators through standardized tool calls. We also discuss principles for human-in-the-loop, multi-agent workflows and outline an evaluation strategy combining technical metrics and practitioner feedback. The paper positions MCP-based tool integration as a step toward more interactive, auditable, and scalable grid-study environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，探讨在多智能体AI (Agentic AI) 和模型上下文协议 (MCP) 框架下支持输电系统运营商 (TSO) 的电网研究。论文提出了pypowsybl-mcp接口，通过标准化工具调用使AI智能体能够设置仿真、执行分析、检索结果并与电力系统模拟器交互。同时讨论了人在回路中、多智能体工作流的原则，以及结合技术指标和实践者反馈的评估策略。
Motivation: 现有电网研究环境缺乏交互性、可审计性和可扩展性，需要将大语言模型与数值仿真工具、结构化工作流和人类监督有效整合，以提升研究效率。
Method: 提出pypowsybl-mcp，一个基于MCP的接口，暴露仿真工具pypowsybl的选定功能供AI智能体调用；并设计多智能体工作流原则，包括人在回路中的监督机制。
Result: 论文未报告具体实验数值，但定位MCP工具集成是迈向更交互、可审计和可扩展的电网研究环境的一步。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于MCP的工具集成能够支持更高效、更可靠的电网研究，并提出了结合技术指标和从业者反馈的评估策略。

papers.title: Certified Domain Consistency for Multi-Domain Retrieval: Label-Free Per-Domain Contamination Control with Conformal Risk Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval over corpora that mix several domains often returns relevant but wrong-domain evidence that ranking metrics miss and that conformal risk control bounds only marginally, under-covering the worst domains. This work introduces C3R, a drop-in control layer that, from an inferred domain posterior and no query-time label, certifies a per-domain contamination budget where feasible and otherwise abstains rather than silently violating; on the hardest domains it guarantees a reduction, not a tight bound. The core is a two-split scheme built on risk-controlling prediction sets, whose finite-sample transfer bound crosses from the inferred to the true domain with fully estimable slack, supports heterogeneous budgets, and inverts for deployment. Population validity rests on this bound and a controlled simulation; across a thousand resampled calibrations the certificate never violates (a stability result) while marginal control violates the most-contaminated domain in every draw, and soft demotion retains more recall than the strongest calibrated cascade at equal certified contamination. The method replicates across open testbeds including an independent one from public federal regulations, and an LLM-judged downstream probe indicates wrong-authority grounding rises with contamination and falls under control. The layer is frozen-stack and reranker-agnostic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出C3R控制层，用于多域检索中基于域后验的逐域污染预算认证，通过风险控制预测集的两分裂方案，在有限样本下保证域一致性并减少最坏域污染，实验表明其稳定性优于传统边际控制方法。
Motivation: 多域检索常返回相关但错误域的文档，导致排名指标失效且置信风险控制边界不足，尤其对最坏域覆盖差；现有方法无法在无查询标签情况下逐域保证污染控制。
Method: 基于风险控制预测集的两分裂方案，从推断的域后验推导有限样本迁移界，支持异构预算与部署反转，通过可估计松弛量实现逐域污染认证，必要时弃权而非违规。
Result: 在千次重采样校准中，C3R证书从未违规（稳定性），而边际控制在每次实验中均违反最污域；软降级在同等认证污染下比最强校准级联保留更多召回率，并在联邦法规等开放测试集上复现。
Conclusion: C3R作为冻结堆栈、重排器无关的控制层，能有效减少多域检索中的错误域证据污染，尤其对最困难域提供保证性降低。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出C3R控制层，用于多域检索中基于域后验的逐域污染预算认证，通过风险控制预测集的两分裂方案，在有限样本下保证域一致性并减少最坏域污染，实验表明其稳定性优于传统边际控制方法。

summary_sections.method: 基于风险控制预测集的两分裂方案，从推断的域后验推导有限样本迁移界，支持异构预算与部署反转，通过可估计松弛量实现逐域污染认证，必要时弃权而非违规。
summary_sections.result: 在千次重采样校准中，C3R证书从未违规（稳定性），而边际控制在每次实验中均违反最污域；软降级在同等认证污染下比最强校准级联保留更多召回率，并在联邦法规等开放测试集上复现。
summary_sections.conclusion: C3R作为冻结堆栈、重排器无关的控制层，能有效减少多域检索中的错误域证据污染，尤其对最困难域提供保证性降低。

papers.title: "Trust Junk" Leads to Unjustified Support for Highly Discriminatory Predictive Models
papers.abstract_en: The persuasive power of data visualizations can go awry: for instance, in an explainable AI (XAI) context, visualizations can produce over-trust of predictive models. In this paper, we use a crowdsourced study to show that providing accurate (but superfluous or irrelevant) data in a model explanation can, in fact, result in unjustified trust and other positive beliefs about a model, even when the model is patently discriminatory and unfair. Our results suggest that XAI designers and developers need to consider the implicit or explicit rhetorics of their work, and beware of the potential of visualizations to imbue models with unearned trust.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 通过众包实验发现，向用户展示歧视性预测模型时，提供准确但无关的附加数据会使用户对模型产生不合理的信任和正面评价。研究警示可解释AI（XAI）的可视化设计需警惕隐性说服力，避免赋予模型不应得的信任。
Motivation: 现有研究关注可解释AI可视化可能引发过度信任，但未充分检验当模型本身具有歧视性时，无关但准确的信息是否仍能诱导信任。
Method: 设计众包实验，向参与者展示一个明显歧视性（如基于种族）的预测模型，并在解释中包含与预测无关的准确数据（如图表、统计量），测量参与者对模型的信任度、公平性感知等态度。
Result: 即使模型明显歧视，提供额外准确数据仍使参与者显著提升对模型的信任、能力评价和公平性感知，形成“信任垃圾”（trust junk）效应。
Conclusion: 可解释AI的设计者必须反思可视化工具隐含的修辞力量，避免因表面上的数据准确性而误导用户忽略模型本身的歧视性行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhancing Small Language Models Reasoning through Knowledge Graph Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Although large language models (LLMs) have set benchmarks for zero-shot reasoning, their deployment remains cost-prohibitive and environmentally taxing. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a sustainable alternative, but prone to errors, on tasks requiring complex, multi-hop logical grounding. We investigate a neuro-symbolic agentic framework to enhance the reasoning capabilities of SLMs, specifically Gemma 3 (1B, 4B) and Llama 3.2 (3B), using the CLUTRR kinship benchmark. Our approach transforms the SLM into a minimalist agent utilizing two specialized tool calls: extract_facts for symbolic triplet extraction and get_hint for expert reasoning via a Relational Graph Convolutional Network (RGCN). We evaluate these models across two configurations, both in an Oracle scenario with ground-truth triplets and a Realistic scenario relying on self-extracted knowledge. Our results reveal that while RGCN-derived hints provide a 1.5 - 2x performance gain over story-only baselines, the system is constrained by the extraction bottleneck and sequential deductive fragility, where early extraction errors compound over multi-hop chains. Furthermore, we identify a "distraction effect" in specific architectures where noisy, self-generated facts degrade performance despite the presence of expert hints. This work characterizes the challenges of symbolic grounding in low-resource agentic systems and provides a roadmap for iterative verification in neuro-symbolic agentic pipelines.
papers.comment: Presented at the 2nd Causal Neuro-symbolic Artificial Intelligence (Causal NeSy): Toward Agentic LLMs with Neuro-Symbolic and Graph Based Reasoning Workshop @ ESWC2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究通过知识图谱接地增强小语言模型（SLM）的推理能力，使用CLUTRR数据集和神经符号代理框架，在Gemma 3（1B, 4B）和Llama 3.2（3B）上评估。实验揭示RGCN推理提示带来1.5-2倍性能提升，但受限于提取瓶颈和顺序演绎脆弱性，早期误差在多跳链中累积。
Motivation: 大语言模型推理成本高且环境负担重，小语言模型是可持续替代但复杂多跳逻辑推理容易出错，现有方法缺乏符号接地能力。
Method: 提出神经符号代理框架，将SLM转换为最小代理，使用两个工具调用：extract_facts用于符号三元组提取，get_hint通过关系图卷积网络（RGCN）进行专家推理。
Result: RGCN提示在Oracle场景下对故事基线有1.5-2倍性能提升，但系统受限于提取瓶颈和顺序演绎脆弱性，且某些架构中自生成噪声事实产生“分心效应”降低性能。
Conclusion: 工作刻画了低资源代理系统中符号接地的挑战，为神经符号代理流水线的迭代验证提供路线图。

papers.title: ITGPT: A Transformer Based Architecture for the Generation of Dance Dance Revolution and In the Groove Charts
papers.abstract_en: Dance Dance Revolution and In the Groove are rhythm games consisting of songs and accompanying choreography, referred to as charts. Players press arrows on a device referred to as a dance pad in time with steps determined by the song's chart. The process of manual chart generation is timestaking and difficult, motivating interest in automation. We propose ITGPT, a new transformer based architecture for the generation of DDR/ITG charts, and demonstrate significant improvements to generation accuracy and computational cost in comparison to predecessor work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ITGPT，一种基于Transformer的架构，用于自动生成Dance Dance Revolution和In the Groove节奏游戏的舞步图（charts）。相比前期工作，该方法在生成准确性和计算成本上均有显著改进。
Motivation: 手动为节奏游戏生成舞步图耗时且困难，因此需要自动化方法。
Method: 提出ITGPT，一种新的基于Transformer的架构，专门用于DDR/ITG舞步图的生成。
Result: 相比前期工作，ITGPT在生成准确性和计算成本上取得了显著改进。
Conclusion: ITGPT为节奏游戏舞步图的自动化生成提供了一种更优的方案，但具体改进幅度和局限性需参考全文。

papers.title: Breaking Refusal in the First Half: A Mechanistic Study of the Prefill Jailbreak
papers.abstract_en: Aligned language models refuse harmful requests, but a one-line prefill ("Sure, here is") strips the refusal. We ask where and how it fails. The harm representation stays intact: on the prompts the attack flips to compliance, a linear probe reads harm as high as on the refused ones (0.91-0.98), while behavioral refusal drops to chance. This holds across four models and three families (1.5-3.8B, and at 14B). Refusal is therefore a shallow, response-site computation. We localize it to an early window: a dose-matched position control shows the first half of the response suffices to break refusal, while the second half is nearly inert. Three causal probes converge on that window. Restoring the harm direction there partially re-engages refusal. Injecting the model's own refuse-state reverses the jailbreak (74%, held-out). And knocking out the early response's attention to the prefill, but not an equal attention mass elsewhere, selectively collapses the harmful continuation. A base-model control identifies the mechanism: the same knockout collapses the continuation prefill-specifically even in a non-safety-tuned base model (64% to 25% harmful content vs a matched control's 64%, replicated at 7B). So the prefill's grip is generic autoregressive conditioning, not safety-specific suppression, and "refusal restoration" is a model-dependent fallback. The dominant mechanism is passive. A small safety-specific attractor remains on top (logit-trace concentration 0.24 vs 0.03), whose active-vs-passive character we size but do not fully separate. No single direction or component is a clean handle either: the decision is decodable but distributed, and refusal tracks harm rather than scary surface. The consequence is structural: a monitor reading the untouched prompt-side representation is immune by construction, but only to response-site attacks. The mechanism is diffuse; the failure surface is local.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 3 figures. Code and derived artifacts: https://github.com/collapseindex/breaking-refusal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究对齐语言模型在接受有害请求时，通过预填充（prefill）即可破解其拒绝机制。实验表明，即使模型内部有害表示依然存在，行为层面的拒绝率却降至随机水平，且拒绝行为仅依赖于响应早期部分的计算。通过因果干预可部分恢复拒绝，但预填充的破坏力主要源于通用的自回归条件作用，而非安全对齐的特异性抑制。
Motivation: 对齐语言模型通常能拒绝有害请求，但简单的预填充技术可以完全绕过这一机制。现有研究对这种失效模式的内部机制缺乏理解，本文旨在深入探究预填充攻击为何有效、在何处失效。
Method: 使用线性探针、剂量匹配位置控制、因果敲除（causal knockout）和状态注入等机械性解释方法，在多个模型（1.5B-14B）上定位拒绝计算发生的窗口，并分析预填充攻击对内部表示的影响。
Result: 预填充攻击下，模型内部的有害表示仍然强烈（线性探针得分0.91-0.98），但行为拒绝消失；拒绝计算集中在响应前一半；通过在早期恢复有害方向可部分重拾拒绝；注入模型自身的拒绝状态可逆转74%的样本（held-out）；敲除早期响应与预填充的注意力可选择性破坏有害延续，该效应在非安全微调的基模型中也存在。
Conclusion: 预填充攻击的机制是通用的自回归条件作用，而非安全特异性的抑制；拒绝恢复是模型依赖的补救手段。拒绝计算在内部是分布式的而非集中于单一方向或组件，但失效面是局部的（响应早期）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ToolAnchor: Anchoring Counterfactual Context to Boost Agentic Tool-use Capability
papers.abstract_en: Tool-augmented large language model agents excel at long-horizon tasks, yet they are typically post-trained on fixed toolsets. When tasks demand new tools, these agents struggle to incorporate them effectively, and retraining from scratch is often impractical. We identify the core obstacle in such toolset expansion problem as behavioral inertia: the tendency of agents to fall back on familiar tools and established reasoning patterns despite having access to new ones. We demonstrate that injecting counterfactual anchor contexts at critical decision points can break this inertia, recovering failed trajectories by eliciting suppressed agent capabilities. To scale this insight, we propose ToolAnchor, a framework that uses teacher models to hypothesize these counterfactual contexts, verifies them via student rollouts, and internalizes the successful interventions through agentic post-training. Extensive evaluations across general AI assistant (GAIA), textual search (BrowseComp), and visual search (VDR-Bench) tasks demonstrate that ToolAnchor consistently exhibits competitive performance under expanded toolsets. Our work bridges the gap between static post-training and dynamic adaptation, charting a new path for scalable agentic reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工具增强的大语言模型代理在工具集扩展时面临的行为惯性问题，提出 ToolAnchor 框架，通过注入反事实锚定上下文打破惯性。教师模型假设反事实上下文，学生 rollout 验证后，通过代理后训练内化成功干预。在 GAIA、BrowseComp、VDR-Bench 等任务上，扩展工具集下表现有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有工具增强代理通常在固定工具集上后训练，当需要新工具时难以有效融入，且从头重新训练不现实。核心障碍是行为惯性——代理倾向使用熟悉工具和既有推理模式。
Method: 提出 ToolAnchor 框架：教师模型在关键决策点假设反事实锚定上下文，通过学生 rollout 验证，并将成功干预通过代理后训练内化。
Result: 在通用 AI 助手（GAIA）、文本搜索（BrowseComp）和视觉搜索（VDR-Bench）任务中，ToolAnchor 在扩展工具集下持续展现有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 本文弥合了静态后训练与动态适应之间的差距，为可扩展的代理强化学习开辟新路径。

papers.title: Capability from Access Structure, Not Scale: Lower Bounds and Pre-Registered Tests for Hybrid Sequence Models
papers.abstract_en: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) holds that as models scale, representations of heterogeneous networks converge toward a shared model of reality. We propose its sequel and boundary, the Capability Convergence Hypothesis (CCH): under a fixed per-token inference budget, representational convergence does not entail capability convergence. Capability instead converges toward a class, the access-complete hybrid: any architecture holding both a compressive O(1)-state channel and a scalable verbatim-index channel. We anchor it on a witness task, the Newton's-apple problem in an infinite stream, and name three resource walls: a Shannon wall barring any o(Nb)-state architecture, a horizon wall barring any fixed window, and a circuit wall barring fixed-depth attention-only composition (conditional on TC0 != NC1). Under an explicit separability assumption a hybrid crosses all three by paying each wall's price, so capability is strictly super-additive under composition. We separate what we prove from what we conjecture: the access-completeness principle rests on information-theoretic lower bounds and pre-registered experiments, while the field-level convergence trend is an economics-motivated conjecture. We report the first pre-registered small-scale tests under criteria frozen before the data: the predicted scissors gap is measured (exact-retrieval error 0.994 vs. 0.000 once a 64-scalar state gains one global-attention layer), the state-tracking bifurcation lands at the registered boundary, and a conjunction witness shows an irreducibly two-channel solution; one prediction failed with its direction reversed and is reported as such. Representational convergence is given freely by scale; capability convergence must be purchased by access structure.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 16 figures. Pre-registered small-scale experiments (scorecard: 11 supported, 7 partial, 1 failed). Information-theoretic lower bounds plus controlled trained witnesses. Jianlin Chen and Ziyao Lin contributed equally. Corresponding author: Chi Man Vong (cmvong@um.edu.mo)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出能力收敛假设（CCH），挑战普拉托表示假设（PRH）：在固定每token推理预算下，表示收敛并不保证能力收敛，能力收敛于拥有压性O(1)状态通道和可扩展逐字索引通道的访问完全混合模型。通过无限流中的牛顿苹果问题，揭示三个资源墙：香农墙、视界墙和电路墙，并依赖信息论下界和预注册实验支持该假设。实验显示剪刀间隙、状态跟踪分叉和双通道解的存在。
Motivation: 普拉托表示假设认为模型规模增大导致表示收敛，但能力可能并不随规模而收敛。本文旨在区分表示收敛与能力收敛，揭示能力收敛依赖于访问结构而非规模。
Method: 定义访问完全混合模型，通过信息论下界证明其能力边界，并在预注册实验中用小规模模型验证剪刀间隙、状态跟踪分叉和双通道解等预测。
Result: 预注册实验测量到精确检索误差0.994 vs 0.000的剪刀间隙，状态跟踪分叉落于预注册边界，合取见证显示不可约的双通道解；一个预测失败且方向反转。
Conclusion: 表示收敛由规模自由赋予，能力收敛必须通过访问结构购买。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Photonic convolutional neural network with pre-trained in situ training
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have transformed image processing, but the energy consumption and inference latency of electronic based implementations remain fundamental bottlenecks. These limitations have motivated the search for alternative hardware architectures beyond Complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) chips. Optical systems can perform linear matrix operations at the speed of light with extremely low energy dissipation, making them attractive for CNN acceleration. However, building a fully coherent photonic CNN that performs both linear and nonlinear operations and training it efficiently remains an open challenge. Here we present a fully photonic convolutional neural network (PCNN) that executes image classification in the optical domain, including convolution, max-pooling, nonlinear activation, and fully connected layers. The network achieves 94.49 percent accuracy on the MNIST dataset distributed across Mach Zehnder Interferometer (MZI) meshes, weighted Multimode Interferometer (MMI) trees, and a microring resonator based nonlinearity. A mathematically exact differentiable digital twin, enables backpropagation for ex situ pre training, reaches 97.45 percent digital accuracy. Trained phases are transferred one-to-one to the photonic hardware and refined via a gradient free algorithm that estimates the full gradient with only two forward passes. The architecture exhibits inherent robustness to non idealities, under the compound effect of propagation loss, MZI insertion loss, fabrication disorder, and thermal crosstalk. A bottom-up power analysis yields 10.83 W static chip consumption and 843 ns inference latency, translating to 220 to 330 times greater energy efficiency than state of the art electronic GPUs for single-image inference.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, plus Supplementary Information (8 pages)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种全光子卷积神经网络（PCNN），在光学域中完成卷积、最大池化、非线性激活和全连接层，用于图像分类。在MNIST数据集上达到94.49%的硬件精度，数字孪生预训练精度达97.45%。通过无梯度算法进行原位训练，静态功耗10.83 W，推理延迟843 ns，能效比最先进的电子GPU高220-330倍。
Motivation: 基于电子的卷积神经网络在能耗和推理延迟上存在瓶颈，光学系统能以光速低能耗执行线性矩阵运算，但构建并高效训练完全相干的光子CNN仍是挑战。
Method: 采用Mach-Zehnder干涉仪（MZI）网格、加权多模干涉仪（MMI）树和微环谐振器非线性实现全光子CNN；通过可微数字孪生进行预训练，再将相位逐像素转移到硬件，并使用仅需两次前向传播的梯度自由算法进行精调。
Result: MNIST数据集上硬件精度94.49%，数字孪生精度97.45%；静态功耗10.83 W，推理延迟843 ns，能效比GPU高220-330倍；对传播损耗、MZI插入损耗、制造无序和热串扰具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该PCNN架构展示了全光子神经网络在图像分类中的可行性，并具有高能效和硬件非理想鲁棒性，为未来光学加速计算提供了路径。

papers.title: The Planar Case of Thomas Positive Circuits Conjecture
papers.abstract_en: The notion of circuit refers to a cyclic oriented influence between the elements of a dynamical system. There are two classes of circuit: positive and negative. R. Thomas conjectured that a necessary condition of multi stationarity is the existence of positive circuits. In this paper we use dynamical system tools and planar analysis to find conditions for which the conjecture holds for planar systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究动力系统中正电路与多稳态性的关系，利用平面分析证明了Thomas猜想在平面系统中的成立条件。
Motivation: Thomas猜想认为多稳态性的必要条件是存在正电路，但证明尚不完整。本文致力于在平面系统中验证该猜想。
Method: 使用动力系统工具和平面分析（planar analysis）来寻找平面系统满足Thomas猜想的条件。
Result: 摘要未提及具体数值结果，只说明找到了成立的条件。
Conclusion: 本文证明了在平面系统中，多稳态性需要正电路存在的条件是成立的。

papers.title: Human AI Construction of Bayesian Networks for Operational Decision Support -- A Virtual Survey Approach
authors: Shovan Chowdhury (2) ((1) Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian Belief Networks (BBNs) are powerful tools for decision-making under uncertainty. However, building their structures and estimating parameters are difficult. Currently, researchers must choose between relying on expert judgement or using large datasets to learn the structure and parameters of the network. We propose a new methodology using Large Language Models to bridge the gap between expert opinion and data-driven learning. This approach uses a panel of AI agents to estimate probabilities based on specific personas and context. We then apply a trimmed-mean rule to remove noise from these responses. We develop a six step BBN framework and illustrate it to model customer intention to consult a doctor in an alternative healthcare system. The model reveals that while self efficacy appears to be a major factor, its actual causal impact is small. In contrast, subjective norms have a much stronger effect in modelling customers' intention. The most effective strategy is to improve both confidence and community norms simultaneously.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合大语言模型（LLM）与专家判断的贝叶斯信念网络（BBN）构建方法，通过AI智能体面板模拟不同角色估计概率，并采用截尾均值去除噪声。在替代医疗系统的客户就诊意图建模案例中，发现主观规范的实际因果影响远大于自我效能，同时提升信心和社区规范是最有效的策略。
Motivation: 传统BBN构建依赖专家判断或大数据学习，两者难以兼顾。需要一种能融合专家知识与数据驱动的方法。
Method: 提出六步BBN框架：利用LLM生成多个AI智能体，赋予特定角色和上下文，收集概率估计后使用截尾均值聚合，以降低噪声。
Result: 在客户就诊意图模型中，自我效能虽感知重要但实际因果影响小，主观规范影响更强；联合提升信心与社区规范效果最佳。
Conclusion: 该方法可有效结合专家意见与数据学习，适用于运营决策支持中的不确定性建模。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Falsifiable Release Gates for Self-Improving Systems
papers.abstract_en: Safety claims on self-improving agent runtimes are almost always self-graded: a policy file, a guardrail, or a README commitment. We describe falsifiable release gates, and a methodology to build and validate such systems, such that every new capability must pass a pre-specified, machine-verifiable acceptance suite before it ships, and a fixed set of standing invariants is preserved at each gate. I think we applied the method in the Antahkarana, an open runtime, via seven gates from basic observability into a self governing loop that suggests changes to its own policy. no action goes to an effector without a safety-critical property capability token minted by a control ring is exhaustively machine-checked over the one million recorded reachable state space of a bounded model and re-checked against execution traces. A purposely broken model gives the shortest counterexample, so the checker has teeth, is apparent. The self-enhancement loop is positively Constrained: the entire write surface is policy rules, tightening changes. may auto-apply loosening changes always require a human merge and a proposal autoclosed is one that mispredicts its own effect; We publish the acceptance measured results for all the seven gates, define precisely the scope of each claim (a bounded of the coordination skeleton (not the learned components) and free the runtime, either command line tools and the gate suite, so the results reproduce, and gates can run against other agent frameworks. Reviewers may repeat the single command central non-bypass in seconds.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 8 figures. Software, gate suite, run artifacts, and TLA+ specification are open source
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可证伪的发布门（falsifiable release gates）方法，用于自改进系统的安全验证。该方法要求每次新能力上线前必须通过预先指定的机器可验证的验收套件，并在每个门处保持一组固定不变的不变量。作者在开源运行时Antahkarana上应用了该方法，通过七个门从基本可观测性到自治理循环，确保任何动作在进入效应器前必须由控制环签发安全关键属性能力令牌，并在有界模型的一百万可达状态空间上穷举检查，再与执行轨迹重新核对。发布门套件和运行时均为开源，结果可复现。
Motivation: 自改进智能体运行时的安全声明几乎都是自我评级的（如策略文件、护栏或README承诺），缺乏严格的可验证保证。
Method: 描述可证伪的发布门方法论，要求每个新能力必须通过预先指定、机器可验证的验收套件，且每个门处保持一组固定不变量；在Antahkarana运行时中通过七个门实现，包括基本可观测性门、自治理循环门等，并使用有界模型检查验证安全关键令牌。
Result: 作者发布了七个门的接受度测量结果，并提供了命令行工具和门套件以便复现；使用故意破坏的模型给出了最短反例，证明检查器有效。
Conclusion: 该方法卡住了自增强循环的写表面为策略规则，收紧变更可自动应用，而放宽变更需人工合并；自改进循环被积极约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Volition Elicitation: Operational Semantics for People and Their Machines
papers.abstract_en: The most prevalent distributed systems today include people and their personal machines (smartphones). In such systems, computations are driven by people's volitions: a payment when a person wishes to pay someone, befriending when two people wish to become friends, etc. Volition-Guarded Multiagent Atomic Transactions were proposed as an abstract specification language for such systems, in which each agent consists of a person and their machine, and a transaction can be guarded by both the machine states and the personal volitions of its participating agents. Here, we define the programming language volition-guarded GLP (vGLP), which extends GLP with volition-guarded clauses, and define its operational semantics as an instance of Communicating Volitional Agents. As the semantics requires the person to will a volition-guarded clause reduction, a correct implementation must elicit the person's volitions: finding out ``what's in the person's head'' is the sole rationale for the UI, which is realised accordingly by standard constructs. We demonstrate the approach on the grassroots social graph, social network, and currencies: each platform is a vGLP program, generated by AI from volition-guarded multiagent atomic transactions; the implementation of vGLP, also created by AI, then maps its volition-guarded clauses into the user-interface constructs, resulting in a single working app deployed on a physical smartphone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为包含人和其个人机器的分布式系统定义了vGLP编程语言，其操作语义基于通信意愿智能体（Communicating Volitional Agents）。在vGLP中，计算步骤由人的意愿守卫，UI的唯一功能是引发用户的意愿。作者在草根社交图、社交网络和货币三个场景展示了该方法的可行性，每个场景的vGLP程序由AI从原子事务规范自动生成，并最终在物理智能手机上部署为单一应用。
Motivation: 现有分布式系统中最广泛的是包含人和其个人机器（如智能手机）的系统，但现有抽象规范语言未能充分表达人的意愿作为计算驱动因素。需要一种语言和语义来正确建模和实现这类系统。
Method: 定义vGLP（volition-guarded GLP）语言，扩展了GLP并引入意愿守卫子句。其操作语义由通信意愿智能体（CVA）实例化，其中智能体由人和机器组成。正确实现必须通过UI引发人的意愿。
Result: 论文在草根社交图、社交网络和货币三个平台演示了该方法：每个平台被表述为vGLP程序，由AI从意愿守卫的多智能体原子事务生成，然后vGLP实现映射为UI构造，最终在智能手机上部署为单一工作应用。未提供量化实验结果。
Conclusion: 本文提出的框架为包含人的分布式系统提供了形式化基础，将UI设计置于意愿引发的核心位置。方法在三个社会计算场景中验证了可行性，但需进一步评估实际部署效率和用户体验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explainable Geospatial AI for Satellite Ground Station Siting Using LiDAR-Derived Terrain Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Representative clutter height (RCH) is a key parameter in radio propagation and interference analysis because it captures the dominant height of local obstructions that drive terminal clutter loss. Current practice often relies on fixed clutter heights assigned to land use classes in Recommendation ITU-R P.452-18, but this misses within class variation and can lead to conservative exclusion zones and poor site ranking for low Earth orbit ground station siting and spectrum coordination. We present an interpretable, globally deployable machine learning framework for predicting RCH from open geospatial data. The model is trained using LiDAR derived labels from the U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program and inference time features from global land-cover, terrain, demographic, thermal, and optical remote sensing products. We define RCH using a robust 75th percentile clutter height statistic, evaluate multiple regressors, and select LightGBM for its accuracy, efficiency, and compatibility with feature attribution analysis. The final model achieves a mean absolute error of 1.79m and an R^2=0.765, reducing absolute error by more than 60% relative to the ITU baseline. Beyond aggregate fit, we evaluate domain facing criteria relevant to RF planning, including meter scale error, tolerance band accuracy, over and under estimation tails, agreement with ITU clutter height regimes, and SHAP-based physical plausibility. SHAP identifies tree canopy cover, land-cover semantics, and spectral reflectance as the most influential predictors. Studies on segmentation derived features, non-forest ablations, and land-cover matched international validation show that open geospatial data can improve clutter modeling at scale without sacrificing interpretability or deployability.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释、全球可部署的机器学习框架，用于从开放地理空间数据预测代表性杂波高度（RCH），以改进低地球轨道地面站选址和频谱协调。使用美国地质调查局3D Elevation Program的LiDAR标签和全球土地覆盖、地形、人口、热和光学遥感产品作为特征，最终选择LightGBM模型，在测试集上达到1.79m的平均绝对误差和0.765的R²，相对ITU基线降低超过60%的绝对误差。SHAP分析表明树冠覆盖、土地覆盖语义和光谱反射率是最重要的预测因子。
Motivation: 当前ITU-R P.452-18推荐的做法依赖固定杂波高度分配给土地覆盖类别，忽视了类内变异，导致保守的排除区和糟糕的站点排名，影响低轨卫星地面站选址与频谱协调。
Method: 使用LiDAR真实标签（75百分位杂波高度）训练多种回归模型，选择LightGBM作为最终模型，并从全球土地覆盖、地形、人口、热和光学遥感数据中提取特征；结合SHAP进行特征归因分析。
Result: 模型在测试集上达到MAE=1.79m，R²=0.765，绝对误差相比ITU基线降低超过60%；通过域外验证、非森林消融实验、土地覆盖匹配的国际验证等评估了RF规划相关指标及物理合理性。
Conclusion: 开放地理空间数据可以大规模改进杂波建模，同时保持可解释性和可部署性，为地面站选址和频谱协调提供更准确的工具。
